     613|     async fetchModelsFromServer() {
     614|         const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     615|         const ollamaUrls = this._services.getOllamaUrls(cfg);
     616|         this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer: ${ollamaUrls.join(', ')}`);
     617|         // 清除 context length 快取，讓 LM Studio 等 context 設定變更立即生效
     618|         if (this._services.clearModelCtxCache) {
     619|             this._services.clearModelCtxCache();
     620|         }
     621|         const liveModels = [];
     622|         let copilotModels = [];
     623|         let connectionOk = false;
     624|         let connectionMessage = '連線失敗';
     625|         let connectionUrl = ollamaUrls[0];
     626|         for (const url of ollamaUrls) {
     627|             try {
     628|                 const models = await this._services.ollamaListModels(url);
     629|                 for (const model of models) {
     630|                     liveModels.push({
     631|                         id: this._services.encodeOllamaModelId(url, model, ollamaUrls),
     632|                         label: this._services.ollamaDisplayLabel(url, model, ollamaUrls),
     633|                     });
     634|                 }
     635|                 if (!connectionOk) {
     636|                     connectionOk = true;
     637|                     connectionMessage = ollamaUrls.length > 1 ? `${ollamaUrls.length} 台伺服器已連線` : 'OK';
     638|                     connectionUrl = url;
     639|                 }
     640|                 this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer OK from ${url}`);
     641|             }
     642|             catch (error) {
     643|                 const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
     644|                 if (!connectionOk) {
     645|                     connectionMessage = message;
     646|                     connectionUrl = url;
     647|                 }
     648|                 this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer error from ${url}: ${message}`);
     649|             }
     650|         }
     651|         const openaiUrls = cfg.get('openaiUrls') ?? [];
     652|         const openaiApiKey = cfg.get('openaiCompatApiKey', '');
     653|         for (const url of openaiUrls) {
     654|             try {
     655|                 const models = await this._services.fetchOpenAiCompatModels(url, openaiApiKey);
     656|                 for (const model of models) {
     657|                     const sep = model.indexOf('||');
     658|                     const cleanLabel = sep !== -1 ? model.slice(sep + 2) : model.replace(/^openai::/, '');
     659|                     liveModels.push({ id: model, label: cleanLabel });
     660|                 }
     661|                 if (!connectionOk) {
     662|                     connectionOk = true;
     663|                     connectionMessage = 'OpenAI-compatible OK';
     664|                     connectionUrl = url;
     665|                 }
     666|                 this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer OpenAI-compatible OK from ${url}`);
     667|             }
     668|             catch (error) {
     669|                 const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
     670|                 if (!connectionOk) {
     671|                     connectionMessage = message;
     672|                     connectionUrl = url;
     673|                 }
     674|                 this._callbacks.log(`fetchModelsFromServer OpenAI-compatible error from ${url}: ${message}`);
     675|             }
     676|         }
     677|         try {
     678|             const chatModels = await vscode.lm.selectChatModels({ vendor: 'copilot' });
     679|             const seen = new Set();
     680|             for (const model of chatModels) {
     681|                 if (!seen.has(model.id)) {
     682|                     seen.add(model.id);
     683|                     const name = (model.name || model.family).replace(/\s+\d+x\b|\s+x\d+\b/gi, '').trim();
     684|                     copilotModels.push({ id: model.id, name, multiplier: this._services.getCopilotMultiplier(model) });
     685|                 }
     686|             }
     687|         }
     688|         catch {
     689|             // Copilot not available
     690|         }
     691|         const currentModel = this.normalizeConfiguredModelId(cfg.get('model') ?? liveModels[0]?.id ?? '');
     692|         if (currentModel && (0, ProviderRegistry_1.isOllamaModel)(currentModel)) {
     693|             const { url, model } = this._services.decodeOllamaModel(currentModel, ollamaUrls);
     694|             this._services.ollamaWarmupModel(url, model);
     695|             this._callbacks.log(`Model warmup: ${model} @ ${url}`);
     696|         }
     697|         const models = this.normalizeModelOptions(liveModels, copilotModels);
     698|         this._callbacks.postToWebview({
     699|             type: 'modelList',
     700|             models,
     701|             current: currentModel,
     702|             providerInfo: this.buildProviderInfo(currentModel, models),
     703|         });
     704|         this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'connectionStatus', ok: connectionOk, url: connectionUrl, message: connectionMessage });
     705|         this._callbacks.log('fetchModelsFromServer postMessage done');
     706|     }

     714|     async ensureModelReady(baseUrl, model) {
     715|         if (!(0, ProviderRegistry_1.isOllamaModel)(model)) {
     716|             return;
     717|         }
     718|         const previousUrl = this._lastOllamaUrl;
     719|         const previousModel = this._lastOllamaModel;
     720|         this._lastOllamaUrl = baseUrl;
     721|         this._lastOllamaModel = model;
     722|         if (!previousModel || previousModel === model) {
     723|             return;
     724|         }
     725|         if (previousUrl && previousUrl !== baseUrl) {
     726|             this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel}@${previousUrl} -> ${model}@${baseUrl}，不同 server，跳過 VRAM 釋放`);
     727|             return;
     728|         }
     729|         const fromShort = previousModel.split('/').pop();
     730|         const toShort = model.split('/').pop();
     731|         // 先查目前執行中的模型 VRAM 用量，決定是否需要強制卸載
     732|         const runningInfo = await this._services.ollamaGetRunningModels(baseUrl);
     733|         const prevFamily = previousModel.split(':')[0];
     734|         const newFamily = model.split(':')[0];
     735|         const oldModelInfo = runningInfo.find(m => m.name === previousModel || m.name.startsWith(prevFamily));
     736|         const newAlreadyLoaded = runningInfo.some(m => m.name === model || m.name.startsWith(newFamily));
     737|         if (newAlreadyLoaded) {
     738|             this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel} -> ${model}，新模型已載入，跳過卸載`);
     739|             return;
     740|         }
     741|         if (!oldModelInfo || oldModelInfo.size_vram === 0) {
     742|             this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel} -> ${model}，舊模型不佔 VRAM（CPU 模式），跳過卸載`);
     743|             return;
     744|         }
     745|         this._callbacks.log(`Model switch: ${previousModel} -> ${model}，舊模型佔用 VRAM ${(oldModelInfo.size_vram / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(1)} GB，正在卸載`);
     746|         await this._services.ollamaUnloadModel(baseUrl, previousModel);
     747|         this._callbacks.postToWebview({
     748|             type: 'assistant',
     749|             text: `⏳ 模型切換 ${fromShort} → ${toShort}，等待 VRAM 釋放…`,
     750|         });
     751|         for (let seconds = 90; seconds > 0; seconds--) {
     752|             const runningModels = await this._services.ollamaListRunningModels(baseUrl);
     753|             const stillLoaded = runningModels.some((name) => name === previousModel || name.startsWith(prevFamily));
     754|             if (!stillLoaded) {
     755|                 const waited = 90 - seconds;
     756|                 this._callbacks.log(`VRAM 已釋放，等待結束（用時 ${waited}s）`);
     757|                 this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'assistant', text: `✅ VRAM 釋放完成（${waited}s），載入 ${toShort}…` });
     758|                 break;
     759|             }
     760|             await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
     761|         }
     762|     }

     821|

     852|                 const resp = await this._services.ollamaGenerate(baseUrl, model, summaryMessages[0].content + '\n\n' + summaryMessages[1].content);

     854|             }
     855|         }
     856|         catch { /* fall through to trim fallback */ }
     857|         if (!summary) {
     858|             // fallback：直接裁除舊訊息
     859|             const trimmed = chatHistory.slice(-Math.floor(chatHistory.length / 2));
     860|             chatHistory.splice(0, chatHistory.length, ...trimmed);
     861|             this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentStep', icon: '⚠️', title: '摘要失敗，改用裁剪模式', fullPath: '' });
     862|             return;
     863|         }
     864|         const compressed = [
     865|             { role: 'user', content: `[自動摘要—先前 ${toSummarize.length} 則對話重點]\n${summary}` },
     866|             { role: 'assistant', content: '已了解先前對話的進度與重要資訊，繼續回答。' },
     867|             ...keepTail,
     868|         ];
     869|         chatHistory.splice(0, chatHistory.length, ...compressed);
     870|         this._callbacks.postToWebview({
     871|             type: 'agentStep',
     872|             icon: '✅',
     873|             title: `Ask 模式歷史摘要完成：${toSummarize.length} 則壓縮為 1 則摘要`,
     874|             fullPath: '',
     875|         });
     876|     }
     877| }

     131| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     132| // Whitelist — 若命中任一條，該 pattern 的計分歸零
     133| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     134| const WHITELIST_PATTERNS = [
     135|     // 正在「引用」拒絕語句（教學 / 文件 / 回覆用戶提問）
     136|     '拒絕回應',
     137|     'refusal detector',
     138|     'refusal pattern',
     139|     '以下為範例',
     140|     'example:',
     141|     // 實際執行成功的語境

     144|     'build succeeded',
     145|     'completed successfully',
     146|     '操作完成',
     147|     // 說明 read-only 但非拒絕（描述屬性）
     148|     'read-only attribute',
     149|     '唯讀屬性',
     150|     'read-only file system 的特性',
     151| ];
     152| function CP(str, weight) {
     153|     return { re: null, str: str.toLowerCase(), weight };
     154| }
     155| function CR(src, weight) {
     156|     return { re: new RegExp(src, 'i'), weight };
     157| }
     158| /**
     159|  * 收緊判定：需同時滿足「選擇指示詞」+「待執行動作」才計分。
     160|  * 單一 "option a" 不足以判定。
     161|  */
     162| const CHOICE_INDICATORS = [
     163|     P2('選項 a', 3), P2('選項 b', 3), P2('選項 c', 3),
     164|     P2('option a', 3), P2('option b', 3), P2('option c', 3),
     165|     P2('若無異議', 3), P2('若您同意', 3), P2('如果您同意', 3),
     166|     P2('如果沒有問題', 2), P2('請確認是否', 3), P2('請問是否要', 3),
     167|     P2('是否要我', 3), P2('shall i', 4), P2('should i', 4),
     168|     P2('do you want me to', 3), P2('would you like me to', 3),
     169|     P2('please confirm if', 3), P2('可以開始嗎', 3),
     170|     P2('我可以開始', 3), P2('可以繼續嗎', 3),
     171| ];
     172| function P2(str, weight) {
     173|     return { re: null, str: str.toLowerCase(), weight };
     174| }
     175| /** 必須搭配「待執行動詞」才有效 */
     176| const CHOICE_ACTION_VERBS = [
     177|     '執行', '建立', '修改', '重構', '部署', '建置',
     178|     'run', 'build', 'create', 'modify', 'refactor', 'deploy',
     179|     '開始', '動手', 'proceed', 'start', 'begin',
     180| ];
     181| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     182| // Scoring thresholds
     183| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     184| const REFUSAL_THRESHOLD = 8; // ≥ 8 判定為拒絕
     185| const CHOICE_THRESHOLD = 6; // ≥ 6 判定為等確認
     186| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     187| // Public API
     188| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     189| /**
     190|  * 完整偵測：回傳分數、類別、命中清單。
     191|  */
     192| function detectRefusal(text) {
     193|     const lower = text.toLowerCase();
     194|     // Whitelist check
     195|     const whitelistHits = WHITELIST_PATTERNS.filter(w => lower.includes(w));
     196|     if (whitelistHits.length > 0) {
     197|         // 命中 whitelist → 強制非拒絕
     198|         return {
     199|             isRefusal: false,
     200|             score: 0,
     201|             category: null,
     202|             matched: [],
     203|             whitelistHits,
     204|         };
     205|     }
     206|     let totalScore = 0;
     207|     const matched = [];
     208|     const categoryScores = new Map();
     209|     for (const pat of REFUSAL_PATTERNS) {
     210|         let hit = false;
     211|         if (pat.re) {
     212|             hit = pat.re.test(text);
     213|         }
     214|         else if (pat.str) {
     215|             hit = lower.includes(pat.str);
     216|         }
     217|         if (hit) {
     218|             totalScore += pat.weight;
     219|             matched.push(pat.str ?? pat.re.source);
     220|             const prev = categoryScores.get(pat.category) ?? 0;
     221|             categoryScores.set(pat.category, prev + pat.weight);
     222|         }
     223|     }
     224|     const isRefusal = totalScore >= REFUSAL_THRESHOLD;
     225|     const topCategory = (() => {
     226|         let best = null;
     227|         let bestScore = 0;
     228|         for (const [cat, sc] of categoryScores) {
     229|             if (sc > bestScore) {
     230|                 best = cat;
     231|                 bestScore = sc;
     232|             }
     233|         }
     234|         return best;
     235|     })();
     236|     return { isRefusal, score: totalScore, category: topCategory, matched, whitelistHits: [] };
     237| }
     238| /**
     239|  * 收緊版 choice 偵測：選擇指示詞 + 動作動詞同時出現才計分。
     240|  */
     241| function detectChoice(text) {
     242|     const lower = text.toLowerCase();
     243|     // 先確認有動作動詞
     244|     const hasActionVerb = CHOICE_ACTION_VERBS.some(v => lower.includes(v));
     245|     if (!hasActionVerb) {
     246|         return { isChoice: false, score: 0, matched: [] };
     247|     }
     248|     let score = 0;
     249|     const matched = [];
     250|     for (const pat of CHOICE_INDICATORS) {
     251|         let hit = false;
     252|         if (pat.re) {
     253|             hit = pat.re.test(text);
     254|         }
     255|         else if (pat.str) {
     256|             hit = lower.includes(pat.str);
     257|         }
     258|         if (hit) {
     259|             score += pat.weight;
     260|             matched.push(pat.str ?? pat.re.source);
     261|         }
     262|     }
     263|     // 有動作動詞加 2 分 bonus
     264|     if (score > 0)
     265|         score += 2;
     266|     return { isChoice: score >= CHOICE_THRESHOLD, score, matched };
     267| }
     268| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     269| // Backward-compatible shims（舊呼叫端可直接切換）
     270| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     271| function isRefusalResponse(text) {
     272|     return detectRefusal(text).isRefusal;
     273| }
     274| function isChoiceConfirmation(text) {
     275|     return detectChoice(text).isChoice;
     276| }

      25|         task.status = 'claimed';
      26|         task.workerIdx = workerIdx;
      27|         task.claimedAt = Date.now();
      28|         return task;
      29|     }
      30|     /** Transitions claimed → completed | failed | blocked. */
      31|     resolve(taskId, status, result, errorDetails) {
      32|         const task = this._tasks.get(taskId);
      33|         if (!task)
      34|             return;
      35|         task.status = status;
      36|         task.result = result;
      37|         task.errorDetails = errorDetails;
      38|         task.resolvedAt = Date.now();
      39|     }
      40|     get(taskId) {
      41|         return this._tasks.get(taskId);
      42|     }
      43|     getAll() {
      44|         return Array.from(this._tasks.values());
      45|     }
      46|     /** Formatted task board for LLM / webview display. */
      47|     format() {
      48|         const tasks = this.getAll();
      49|         if (!tasks.length)
      50|             return '（無任務）';
      51|         return tasks.map(t => {
      52|             const lines = [`${STATUS_ICON[t.status]} [${t.id}] ${t.description}`];
      53|             if (t.status === 'claimed' && t.workerIdx !== undefined)
      54|                 lines.push(`  → Worker #${t.workerIdx} 處理中`);
      55|             if (t.result)
      56|                 lines.push(`  結果：${t.result.slice(0, 150)}`);
      57|             if (t.errorDetails)
      58|                 lines.push(`  錯誤：${t.errorDetails.slice(0, 80)}`);
      59|             return lines.join('\n');
      60|         }).join('\n');
      61|     }
      62| }

      45| function microCompact(messages, options = {}) {
      46|     const compactable = options.compactableTools ?? exports.DEFAULT_COMPACTABLE_TOOLS;
      47|     const perResultMax = options.perResultMaxTokens ?? exports.PER_RESULT_MAX_TOKENS;
      48|     const staleMs = options.staleThresholdMs ?? 10 * 60 * 1000;
      49|     const now = Date.now();
      50|     let trimmed = 0;
      51|     let freed = 0;
      52|     const out = messages.map((msg, idx) => {
      53|         if (msg.role !== 'tool')
      54|             return msg;
      55|         if (!msg.toolName || !compactable.has(msg.toolName))
      56|             return msg;
      57|         const ts = options.getMessageTimestamp?.(msg, idx);
      58|         const isStale = ts !== undefined && now - ts > staleMs;
      59|         // 過時：整段清除
      60|         if (isStale && msg.content) {
      61|             freed += (0, TokenBudgetManager_1.estimateTokensRough)(msg.content);
      62|             trimmed++;
      63|             return { ...msg, content: exports.TIME_BASED_MC_CLEARED_MESSAGE };
      64|         }
      65|         // 圖片過大：清除
      66|         let images = msg.images;
      67|         if (images && images.length > 0) {
      68|             const totalImgTokens = images.reduce((s, i) => s + (0, TokenBudgetManager_1.estimateTokensRough)(i), 0);
      69|             if (totalImgTokens > exports.IMAGE_MAX_TOKEN_SIZE) {
      70|                 freed += totalImgTokens;
      71|                 images = undefined;
      72|                 trimmed++;
      73|             }
      74|         }
      75|         // 內容過大：保留頭尾 + 中間替換摘要
      76|         if (msg.content) {
      77|             const tokens = (0, TokenBudgetManager_1.estimateTokensRough)(msg.content);
      78|             if (tokens > perResultMax) {
      79|                 const headChars = Math.floor((perResultMax - exports.PER_RESULT_PREVIEW_TAIL_TOKENS) * 3);
      80|                 const tailChars = Math.floor(exports.PER_RESULT_PREVIEW_TAIL_TOKENS * 3);
      81|                 const head = msg.content.slice(0, headChars);
      82|                 const tail = msg.content.slice(-tailChars);
      83|                 const collapsed = `${head}\n\n...[truncated ${tokens - perResultMax} tokens]...\n\n${tail}`;
      84|                 freed += tokens - (0, TokenBudgetManager_1.estimateTokensRough)(collapsed);
      85|                 trimmed++;
      86|                 return { ...msg, content: collapsed, images };
      87|             }
      88|         }
      89|         if (images !== msg.images)
      90|             return { ...msg, images };
      91|         return msg;
      92|     });
      93|     return { messages: out, trimmedCount: trimmed, tokensFreed: freed };
      94| }

      71|     return consecutiveFailures >= exports.MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTOCOMPACT_FAILURES;
      72| }
      73| /**
      74|  * 預估字串 token 數。粗略估算：英文約 4 char / token，中文約 1.5 char / token。
      75|  * 若上層已有更精準的 estimator（如 tiktoken），可從外部注入並覆蓋。
      76|  */
      77| function estimateTokensRough(text) {
      78|     if (!text)
      79|         return 0;
      80|     // 中文字元算 1 token，其他每 4 char 算 1 token
      81|     let cjk = 0;
      82|     let other = 0;
      83|     for (const ch of text) {
      84|         if (/[\u4e00-\u9fff\u3000-\u303f\uff00-\uffef]/.test(ch))
      85|             cjk++;
      86|         else
      87|             other++;
      88|     }
      89|     return Math.ceil(cjk + other / 4);
      90| }
      91| /**
      92|  * 強制截斷字串以符合 Token 限制。
      93|  * 為確保絕對安全，我們採取「最保守估算」：將字串截斷至 maxTokens 個字元。
      94|  * 因為即使全為中文字，token 數也只會等於字元數，絕不會超過 maxTokens。
      95|  */
      96| function truncateToTokenLimit(text, maxTokens) {
      97|     if (estimateTokensRough(text) <= maxTokens)
      98|         return text;
      99|     return text.substring(0, maxTokens);
     100| }

     153|             const newContent = Buffer.from(existing + entry, 'utf8');
     154|             await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(logUri, newContent);
     155|             todoLog.appendLine(`[onTodoComplete] 已寫入 ${logUri.fsPath}（+${entry.length} 字）`);
     156|             vscode.window.setStatusBarMessage(`📝 AmiClaw：對話已記錄到 AmiClawTodoLog.md`, 5000);
     157|         }
     158|         catch (e) {
     159|             todoLog.appendLine(`[onTodoComplete] 寫入失敗: ${e?.message ?? e}`);
     160|         }
     161|     };
     162|     let _todoDebounce;
     163|     async function processTodoFile(uri) {
     164|         clearTimeout(_todoDebounce);
     165|         _todoDebounce = setTimeout(async () => {
     166|             try {
     167|                 todoLog.appendLine(`[processTodoFile] 觸發: ${uri.fsPath}`);
     168|                 const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
     169|                 const prompt = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8').trim();
     170|                 if (!prompt) {
     171|                     todoLog.appendLine('[processTodoFile] 檔案為空，跳過');
     172|                     return;
     173|                 }
     174|                 todoLog.appendLine(`[processTodoFile] 內容長度=${prompt.length}，送入 agentSend`);
     175|                 // 確保 panel 已建立，再進入 todo 模式
     176|                 await ollama_chat_1.OllamaChatPanel.createOrShow(context);
     177|                 ollama_chat_1.OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel?.enterTodoMode(prompt);
     178|                 const send = () => ollama_chat_1.OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel?.postMessageToWebview({ type: 'externalAgentSend', prompt });
     179|                 if (ollama_chat_1.OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) {
     180|                     send();
     181|                 }
     182|                 else {
     183|                     setTimeout(send, 700);
     184|                 }
     185|                 vscode.window.setStatusBarMessage(`🤖 AmiClaw：已讀取 AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md (${prompt.length} 字)`, 5000);
     186|             }
     187|             catch (e) {
     188|                 const msg = e?.message ?? String(e);
     189|                 todoLog.appendLine(`[processTodoFile] 錯誤: ${msg}`);
     190|                 vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`AmiClaw 讀取 AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md 失敗：${msg}`);
     191|             }
     192|         }, 500);
     193|     }
     194|     // 對每個 workspace folder 分別建立 RelativePattern watcher（multi-root 最可靠作法）
     195|     function registerTodoWatchers(folders) {
     196|         for (const folder of folders) {
     197|             const pattern = new vscode.RelativePattern(folder, 'AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md');
     198|             const w = vscode.workspace.createFileSystemWatcher(pattern, false, false, true);
     199|             w.onDidCreate(processTodoFile);
     200|             w.onDidChange(processTodoFile);
     201|             context.subscriptions.push(w);
     202|             todoLog.appendLine(`[init] 監聽 ${folder.uri.fsPath}/AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md`);
     203|         }
     204|     }
     205|     registerTodoWatchers(vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? []);
     206|     // 若之後動態加入 workspace folder，也自動加 watcher
     207|     context.subscriptions.push(vscode.workspace.onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders((e) => {
     208|         registerTodoWatchers(e.added);
     209|     }));

     561|             if (!vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders || vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders.length === 0) {
     562|                 vscode.window.showInformationMessage('No workspace folder is open.');
     563|                 return;
     564|             }
     565|             const activeUri = vscode.window.activeTextEditor?.document.uri;
     566|             const wf = (activeUri && vscode.workspace.getWorkspaceFolder(activeUri)) ?? vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders[0];
     567|             const root = wf.uri.fsPath;
     568|             let cmd;
     569|             if (process.platform === 'win32') {
     570|                 // Use PowerShell for reliable recursive file count
     571|                 cmd = `powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-ChildItem -Path '${root.replace(/'/g, "''")}' -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count"`;
     572|             }
     573|             else {
     574|                 // POSIX: use ls -R | wc -l
     575|                 cmd = `sh -c "ls -R '${root.replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}' | wc -l"`;
     576|             }
     577|             const oc = vscode.window.createOutputChannel('AmiClaw');
     578|             oc.appendLine(`Running: ${cmd}`);
     579|             oc.show(true);
     580|             try {
     581|                 const { stdout, stderr } = await exec(cmd, { windowsHide: true, maxBuffer: 50 * 1024 * 1024 });
     582|                 if (stderr && String(stderr).trim())

     584|                 const n = parseInt(String(stdout).trim().split(/\r?\n/).pop() || '', 10);
     585|                 if (!Number.isNaN(n)) {
     586|                     const msg = `Shell file count: ${n.toLocaleString()} (path: ${root})`;
     587|                     oc.appendLine(msg);
     588|                     vscode.window.showInformationMessage(msg);
     589|                     return;
     590|                 }
     591|             }
     592|             catch (e) {
     593|                 oc.appendLine('Shell command failed: ' + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
     594|             }
     595|             // Fallback to JS counting via workspace.findFiles
     596|             oc.appendLine('Falling back to workspace.findFiles count...');
     597|             const exclude = '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/dist/**,**/out/**}';
     598|             const uris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles('**/*', exclude);
     599|             const count = uris.length;
     600|             const msg = `Fallback file count: ${count.toLocaleString()} (excludes node_modules, .git, dist, out)`;
     601|             oc.appendLine(msg);
     602|             vscode.window.showInformationMessage(msg);
     603|         }
     604|         catch (e) {
     605|             vscode.window.showErrorMessage('Failed to execute file-count: ' + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
     606|         }
     607|     }));

     210|                                 this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect close: code=' + statusCode);
     211|                                 if (statusCode === 515) {
     212|                                     this._waSock = null;
     213|                                     this._waConnected = false;
     214|                                     setTimeout(() => { startSock().catch(e2 => this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect restart err: ' + String(e2))); }, 500);
     215|                                     return;
     216|                                 }
     217|                                 // 440 = connectionReplaced — 同一帳號在另一處開啟了 WA Web，等 30s 後重連
     218|                                 if (statusCode === 440) {
     219|                                     this._wa440RetryCount++;
     220|                                     this._cb.log(`WA auto-reconnect: connectionReplaced (440), retryCount=${this._wa440RetryCount}`);
     221|                                     this._waSock = null;
     222|                                     this._waConnected = false;
     223|                                     this._waConnecting = false;
     224|                                     this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'waDisconnected' });
     225|                                     if (this._wa440RetryCount <= 1) {
     226|                                         // 第一次被踢：等 30s 後試一次（對方 tab 可能已關閉）
     227|                                         this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect: will retry once in 30s...');
     228|                                         setTimeout(() => {
     229|                                             if (!this._waConnected && !this._waConnecting) {
     230|                                                 this._waConnecting = true;
     231|                                                 startSock().catch(e2 => { this._waConnecting = false; this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect 440-retry err: ' + String(e2)); });
     232|                                             }
     233|                                         }, 30000);
     234|                                     }
     235|                                     else {
     236|                                         // 重試也被踢：對方 session 仍存活，放棄不出跨註釋放
     237|                                         this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect: another session still active, giving up to avoid loop (440x' + this._wa440RetryCount + ')');
     238|                                     }
     239|                                     return;
     240|                                 }
     241|                                 this._waSock = null;
     242|                                 this._waConnected = false;
     243|                                 this._waConnecting = false;
     244|                                 if (statusCode === DisconnectReason.loggedOut) {
     245|                                     try {
     246|                                         fs.rmSync(waAuthDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
     247|                                     }
     248|                                     catch { /* ignore */ }
     249|                                 }
     250|                                 this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'waDisconnected' });
     251|                             }
     252|                         });
     253|                         sockEv.on('creds.update', saveCreds);
     254|                         sockEv.on('messages.upsert', async (...evArgs) => {
     255|                             const upsert = evArgs[0];
     256|                             this._cb.log(`WA upsert [auto-reconnect] type=${upsert.type} count=${upsert.messages?.length}`);
     257|                             for (const msg of upsert.messages) {
     258|                                 const k = msg['key'];
     259|                                 const fromMe = !!(k?.['fromMe']);
     260|                                 const remoteJid = String(k?.['remoteJid'] ?? '');
     261|                                 this._cb.log(`WA msg: fromMe=${fromMe} jid=${remoteJid} type=${upsert.type}`);
     262|                                 if (upsert.type !== 'notify' && !fromMe) {
     263|                                     continue;
     264|                                 }
     265|                                 this.handleIncoming(msg).catch(e => this._cb.log('WA handleIncoming error: ' + String(e)));
     266|                             }
     267|                         });
     268|                     };
     269|                     await startSock();
     270|                     // 60 秒靜默重連逾時（若憑證有效應在 20s 內完成）
     271|                     setTimeout(() => {
     272|                         if (this._waConnecting) {
     273|                             this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect: timed out (60s)');
     274|                             try {
     275|                                 this._waSock?.end?.(undefined);
     276|                             }
     277|                             catch { /* ignore */ }
     278|                             this._waSock = null;
     279|                             this._waConnecting = false;
     280|                         }
     281|                     }, 60000);
     282|                 }
     283|                 catch (e) {
     284|                     this._waConnecting = false;
     285|                     this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect inner error: ' + String(e));
     286|                 }
     287|             }).catch(e => {
     288|                 this._waConnecting = false;
     289|                 this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect Baileys load error: ' + String(e));
     290|             });
     291|         }
     292|         catch (e) {
     293|             this._waConnecting = false;
     294|             this._cb.log('WA auto-reconnect outer error: ' + String(e));
     295|         }
     296|     }
     297|     /**
     298|      * 處理 WhatsApp 收到的訊息：顯示在聊天視窗，並自動送入 Agent 執行。
     299|      * 由 messages.upsert 事件觸發（兩個 socket：whatsapp_connect 和 tryAutoReconnect 共用）。
     300|      */
     301|     async handleIncoming(msg) {
     302|         if (this._cb.isDisposed()) {
     303|             return;
     304|         } // panel 已關閉，跳過（WA socket 仍在運行）
     305|         const msgKey = msg['key'];
     306|         const fromMe = !!(msg['key'] && msgKey['fromMe']);
     307|         const remoteJid = String(msgKey['remoteJid'] ?? '');
     308|         if (!remoteJid) {
     309|             return;
     310|         }
     311|         this._cb.log(`WA _handleWaIncoming: fromMe=${fromMe} jid=${remoteJid}`);
     312|         // fromMe=true 表示自己送出的訊息；但若 remoteJid 是自己的號碼（Note to self），仍允許觸發 Agent
     313|         if (fromMe) {
     314|             let myPhone = this._context.globalState.get('amiAiClaw.waPhone', '');
     315|             // remoteJid 可能含設備號 :N（如 886919327569:5@s.whatsapp.net），需一併去除
     316|             const remotePhone = remoteJid.replace(/@.+/, '').replace(/:.*/, '');
     317|             // 若 waPhone 尚未儲存（auto-reconnect 在 debug log 開啟前完成），嘗試從 socket 讀取
     318|             if (!myPhone && this._waSock) {
     319|                 try {
     320|                     const creds = this._waSock['authState'];
     321|                     const meObj = (creds?.['creds']?.['me']);
     322|                     const meId = String(meObj?.['id'] ?? '');
     323|                     myPhone = meId.replace(/:.*/, '').replace(/@.*/, '');
     324|                     if (myPhone) {
     325|                         void this._context.globalState.update('amiAiClaw.waPhone', myPhone);
     326|                         this._cb.log(`WA _handleWaIncoming: recovered waPhone=${myPhone}`);
     327|                     }
     328|                 }
     329|                 catch { /* ignore */ }
     330|             }
     331|             this._cb.log(`WA _handleWaIncoming: myPhone=${myPhone} remotePhone=${remotePhone}`);
     332|             // @lid 是 WhatsApp LID 格式（隱私保護的混淆 ID），fromMe=true 時必然是自己的設備，直接放行
     333|             const isLid = remoteJid.endsWith('@lid');
     334|             if (!isLid && (!myPhone || remotePhone !== myPhone)) {
     335|                 return;
     336|             } // 發給別人的訊息：忽略
     337|             // Note to self：繼續往下處理
     338|         }
     339|         let msgContent = msg['message'];
     340|         if (!msgContent) {
     341|             this._cb.log(`WA _handleWaIncoming: no msgContent, keys=${Object.keys(msg).join(',')}`);
     342|             return;
     343|         }
     344|         // Note-to-self 訊息可能包在 deviceSentMessage 裡
     345|         if (msgContent['deviceSentMessage']) {
     346|             const dsm = msgContent['deviceSentMessage'];
     347|             const inner = dsm?.['message'];
     348|             if (inner) {
     349|                 this._cb.log('WA _handleWaIncoming: unwrapping deviceSentMessage');
     350|                 msgContent = inner;
     351|             }
     352|         }
     353|         // 取出文字內容（支援各種訊息類型）
     354|         const text = String(msgContent['conversation'] ?? '') ||
     355|             String(msgContent['extendedTextMessage']?.['text'] ?? '') ||
     356|             String(msgContent['imageMessage']?.['caption'] ?? '') ||
     357|             String(msgContent['videoMessage']?.['caption'] ?? '') ||
     358|             '';
     359|         this._cb.log(`WA _handleWaIncoming: text="${text.slice(0, 50)}" msgKeys=${Object.keys(msgContent).join(',')}`);
     360|         if (!text.trim()) {
     361|             return;
     362|         } // 非文字訊息（語音、貼圖等）忽略
     363|         // 過濾連線建立前的歷史同步訊息（type=append 歷史同步）：只處理連線後到達的訊息
     364|         const msgTs = Number(msg['messageTimestamp'] ?? 0) * 1000; // Baileys 時間戳是秒數
     365|         if (msgTs > 0 && this._waConnectedAt > 0 && msgTs < this._waConnectedAt - 3000) {
     366|             this._cb.log(`WA _handleWaIncoming: skipping pre-connection message ts=${new Date(msgTs).toISOString()}`);
     367|             return;
     368|         }
     369|         // 若是 extension 自己送出訊息的 echo（fromMe=true），略過不處理
     370|         if (fromMe && this._waSentTexts.has(text)) {
     371|             this._cb.log('WA _handleWaIncoming: skipping self-sent echo');
     372|             return;
     373|         }
     374|         // ── /module 內建指令（優先於 Agent，白名單前處理）──────────────────────
     375|         const trimmed = text.trim();
     376|         if (/^\/(?:module|model|llm)\b/i.test(trimmed)) {
     377|             await this.handleModuleCommand(trimmed, msg);
     378|             return;
     379|         }
     380|         // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     381|         // @lid 是 WhatsApp 隱私混淆 ID，fromMe=true 時必然是自己，senderPhone 改用已知的 myPhone
     382|         const isLidJid = remoteJid.endsWith('@lid');
     383|         // 去除 remoteJid 中的設備號 :N（如 886919327569:5@s.whatsapp.net → 886919327569）
     384|         const rawSenderPhone = remoteJid.replace(/@.+/, '').replace(/:.*/, '');
     385|         const ownPhone = this._context.globalState.get('amiAiClaw.waPhone', '');
     386|         const senderPhone = (fromMe && isLidJid)
     387|             ? (ownPhone || rawSenderPhone)
     388|             : rawSenderPhone;
     389|         // @lid JID 無法用於 sendMessage（靜默失敗）；改用自己的 @s.whatsapp.net JID
     390|         const sendJid = isLidJid && ownPhone ? `${ownPhone}@s.whatsapp.net` : remoteJid;
     391|         const pushName = String(msg['pushName'] ?? '');
     392|         const displaySender = pushName ? `${pushName} (+${senderPhone})` : `+${senderPhone}`;
     393|         this._cb.log(`WA incoming from ${displaySender}${fromMe ? ' [note-to-self]' : ''}: ${text} (sendJid=${sendJid})`);
     394|         // 記住最後可回覆的 JID，供 notifyOwner 主動推送使用
     395|         if (sendJid)
     396|             this._lastActiveSendJid = sendJid;
     397|         // 更新職天對話清單
     398|         const chatKey = sendJid || remoteJid;
     399|         if (chatKey) {
     400|             const existing = this._chatList.get(chatKey);
     401|             this._chatList.set(chatKey, {
     402|                 jid: chatKey, phone: senderPhone,
     403|                 name: pushName || existing?.name || '',
     404|                 lastMsg: text.slice(0, 80),
     405|                 lastTs: Date.now(),
     406|                 msgCount: (existing?.msgCount ?? 0) + 1,
     407|             });
     408|         }
     409|         // 在聊天視窗顯示收到的訊息（panel 可能已關閉，try-catch 防止拋出）
     410|         try {
     411|             this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'waIncoming', sender: displaySender, text, remoteJid });
     412|         }
     413|         catch { /* disposed */ }
     414|         // 白名單過濾：fromMe+@lid 必然是本人，直接放行；其他號碼需比對白名單
     415|         const pcfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     416|         const allowedSenders = pcfg.get('waAgentAllowedSenders', []);
     417|         const skipWhitelist = fromMe && isLidJid;
     418|         if (!skipWhitelist && allowedSenders.length > 0 && !allowedSenders.includes(senderPhone)) {
     419|             this._cb.log(`WA incoming: ${senderPhone} 不在白名單，略過 Agent`);
     420|             return;
     421|         }
     422|         // 自動送入 Agent 執行（若 agent 正在執行中則略過，避免衝突）
     423|         if (this._cb.isAgentRunning()) {
     424|             this._cb.log('WA incoming: agent busy, skipping auto-run');
     425|             // fromMe（自己發給自己）不需要回「正在忙碌」，本人自知
     426|             const now = Date.now();
     427|             if (!fromMe && now - this._waBusyRepliedAt > 60000) {
     428|                 this._waBusyRepliedAt = now;
     429|                 try {
     430|                     if (this._waSock && sendJid) {
     431|                         const busyText = '[AmiClaw] ⏳ 我目前正在處理另一個任務，請稍候再試。';
     432|                         this._waSentTexts.add(busyText);
     433|                         setTimeout(() => { this._waSentTexts.delete(busyText); }, 30000);
     434|                         await this._waSock
     435|                             .sendMessage(sendJid, { text: busyText });
     436|                     }
     437|                 }
     438|                 catch (e) {
     439|                     this._cb.log('WA busy-reply error: ' + String(e));
     440|                 }
     441|             }
     442|             return;
     443|         }
     444|         // 優先使用 _waModelOverride（/model 指令記憶體內切換），其次 waAgentModel 設定，最後 fallback 到 UI 當前 model
     445|         const waAgentModel = this._waModelOverride || pcfg.get('waAgentModel', '') || pcfg.get('model') || '';
     446|         this._cb.log(`WA incoming: using model="${waAgentModel}"`);
     447|         // 先回傳「正在思考」提示，讓對方知道已收到指令
     448|         try {
     449|             if (this._waSock && sendJid) {
     450|                 const thinkingText = '[AmiClaw] 🤔 收到指令，正在處理中…';
     451|                 this._waSentTexts.add(thinkingText);
     452|                 setTimeout(() => { this._waSentTexts.delete(thinkingText); }, 30000);
     453|                 await this._waSock
     454|                     .sendMessage(sendJid, { text: thinkingText });
     455|             }
     456|         }
     457|         catch (e) {
     458|             this._cb.log('WA thinking-reply error: ' + String(e));
     459|         }
     460|         const agentPrompt = `[WhatsApp 指令，來自 ${displaySender}]\n${text}\n\n請處理此指令，完成後給出精簡清晰的結果調。結果將自動回傳給 ${displaySender}。`;
     461|         // waTriggered=true：工具執行時自動允許（不等待 UI 點擊）
     462|         this._cb.onAgentTrigger(agentPrompt, waAgentModel).catch(e => this._cb.log('WA agent error: ' + String(e)));
     463|     }
     464|     /**
     465|      * 處理 WhatsApp /module 內建指令（不走 Agent，直接同步回覆）。
     466|      * 支援：
     467|      *   /module list              → 列出所有可用 Ollama + Copilot 模型（帶編號）
     468|      *   /module <N>               → 切換 waAgentModel 為第 N 個模型
     469|      *   /module <name>            → 切換 waAgentModel 為名稱模糊相符的模型
     470|      */
     471|     async handleModuleCommand(text, msg) {
     472|         this._cb.log(`WA /module command: "${text}"`);
     473|         // 取得回覆 JID（原訊息的 remoteJid）
     474|         // @lid JID 是 WhatsApp 隱私混淆 ID，sendMessage 到 @lid 靜默失敗；
     475|         // 改用自己的 @s.whatsapp.net JID（Note-to-self 模式）
     476|         const msgKey = msg['key'];
     477|         let replyJid = String(msgKey?.['remoteJid'] ?? '');
     478|         if (replyJid.endsWith('@lid')) {
     479|             const ownPhone = this._context.globalState.get('amiAiClaw.waPhone', '');
     480|             if (ownPhone)
     481|                 replyJid = `${ownPhone}@s.whatsapp.net`;
     482|         }
     483|         this._cb.log(`WA /module replyJid: ${replyJid}`);
     484|         const send = async (body) => {
     485|             const prefixed = body.startsWith('[AmiClaw]') ? body : `[AmiClaw] ${body}`;
     486|             try {
     487|                 if (this._waSock && replyJid) {
     488|                     this._waSentTexts.add(prefixed);
     489|                     setTimeout(() => { this._waSentTexts.delete(prefixed); }, 30000);
     490|                     await this._waSock
     491|                         .sendMessage(replyJid, { text: prefixed });
     492|                     this._cb.log(`WA /module sent OK (${prefixed.length} chars) -> ${replyJid}`);
     493|                 }
     494|             }
     495|             catch (e) {
     496|                 this._cb.log(`WA /module reply error: ${String(e)}`);
     497|             }
     498|         };
     499|         // 建立完整模型清單（Ollama + Copilot）— Ollama URLs 並行查詢
     500|         const buildModuleList = async () => {
     501|             const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     502|             const urls = WhatsAppManager._getOllamaUrls(cfg);
     503|             this._cb.log(`WA /module buildModuleList: ${urls.length} Ollama URL(s)`);
     504|             const list = [];
     505|             // 並行查詢所有 Ollama URLs（避免串行等待每個 8s timeout）
     506|             const results = await Promise.allSettled(urls.map(url => WhatsAppManager._ollamaListModels(url).then(models => ({ url, models }))));
     507|             for (const r of results) {
     508|                 if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
     509|                     for (const m of r.value.models) {
     510|                         list.push({ id: WhatsAppManager._encodeOllamaModelId(r.value.url, m, urls), label: WhatsAppManager._ollamaDisplayLabel(r.value.url, m, urls) });
     511|                     }
     512|                 }
     513|             }
     514|             try {
     515|                 const lms = await vscode.lm.selectChatModels({ vendor: 'copilot' });
     516|                 const seen = new Set();
     517|                 for (const m of lms) {
     518|                     if (!seen.has(m.id)) {
     519|                         seen.add(m.id);
     520|                         const name = (m.name || m.family).replace(/\s+\d+x\b|\s+x\d+\b/gi, '').trim();
     521|                         list.push({ id: `copilot::${m.id}`, label: `[Copilot] ${name}` });
     522|                     }
     523|                 }
     524|             }
     525|             catch { /* Copilot not available */ }
     526|             this._cb.log(`WA /module buildModuleList: ${list.length} models total`);
     527|             return list;
     528|         };
     529|         const parts = text.trim().split(/\s+/);
     530|         // 移除第一個 token（/module、/model、/llm 都視為同一指令）
     531|         const sub = parts[1]?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
     532|         // /module list
     533|         if (!sub || sub === 'list') {
     534|             const list = await buildModuleList();
     535|             if (list.length === 0) {
     536|                 await send('⚠️ 目前沒有可用的模型（Ollama 未連線且 Copilot 不可用）');
     537|                 return;
     538|             }
     539|             const cfg2 = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     540|             const current = this._waModelOverride || cfg2.get('waAgentModel', '') || cfg2.get('model', '');
     541|             const lines = list.map((m, i) => {
     542|                 const active = (m.id === current || m.label === current) ? ' ✅' : '';
     543|                 return `${i + 1}. ${m.label}${active}`;
     544|             });
     545|             await send(`📋 可用模型（/module <編號> 切換）：\n\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\n目前 WA Agent 使用：${current || '(同 UI 選擇)'}`);
     546|             return;
     547|         }
     548|         // /module <N> 或 /module <name>
     549|         const list2 = await buildModuleList();
     550|         if (list2.length === 0) {
     551|             await send('⚠️ 目前沒有可用的模型');
     552|             return;
     553|         }
     554|         let target;
     555|         const num = parseInt(sub, 10);
     556|         if (!isNaN(num) && num >= 1 && num <= list2.length) {
     557|             target = list2[num - 1];
     558|         }
     559|         else {
     560|             // 模糊比對 label 或 id
     561|             const q = parts.slice(1).join(' ').toLowerCase();
     562|             target = list2.find(m => m.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.id.toLowerCase().includes(q));
     563|         }
     564|         if (!target) {
     565|             await send(`❌ 找不到模型「${parts.slice(1).join(' ')}」，請用 /module list 查看清單`);
     566|             return;
     567|         }
     568|         // 寫入設定，同時更新記憶體內覆蓋値（讓下一條指令立即生效）
     569|         try {
     570|             this._waModelOverride = target.id;
     571|             const cfg3 = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     572|             await cfg3.update('waAgentModel', target.id, vscode.ConfigurationTarget.Global);
     573|             this._cb.log(`WA /module: switched waAgentModel to "${target.id}"`);
     574|             await send(`✅ WA Agent 模型已切換為：\n${target.label}\n\n（ID: ${target.id}）`);
     575|         }
     576|         catch (e) {
     577|             this._waModelOverride = '';
     578|             await send(`❌ 切換失敗：${String(e)}`);
     579|         }
     580|     }
     581|     /**
     582|      * 主動推送文字訊息給最後聯絡的 WA 對象（心跳回報 / Agent 完成通知）。
     583|      * 若未連線或無 sendJid 紀錄則靜默忽略。
     584|      */
     585|     notifyOwner(text) {
     586|         if (!this._waSock || !this._waConnected || !this._lastActiveSendJid)
     587|             return;
     588|         this._waSentTexts.add(text);
     589|         setTimeout(() => { this._waSentTexts.delete(text); }, 30000);
     590|         // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
     591|         this._waSock.sendMessage(this._lastActiveSendJid, { text }).catch((e) => {
     592|             this._cb.log('WA notifyOwner error: ' + String(e));
     593|         });
     594|     }
     595|     /**
     596|      * Handle all whatsapp_* tool calls dispatched from OllamaChatPanel.executeTool().
     597|      * Returns the tool result string.
     598|      */
     599|     async handleTool(name, args) {
     600|         switch (name) {
     601|             case 'whatsapp_connect': {
     602|                 if (this._waConnecting)
     603|                     return '⏳ WhatsApp Web 正在連線中，請等待 QR Code 顯示後掃描';
     604|                 // 若 auto-reconnect 已成功建立有效連線，直接回報狀態
     605|                 if (this._waConnected && this._waSock) {
     606|                     const savedPhone = this._context.globalState.get('amiAiClaw.waPhone', '');

    1104|     _listChats() {
    1105|         if (!this._waConnected) {
    1106|             return '⚠️ WhatsApp Web 未連線。請先呼叫 whatsapp_connect。';
    1107|         }
    1108|         if (this._chatList.size === 0) {
    1109|             return '（尚無已知職天）——有訊息互動後會自動建立清單';
    1110|         }
    1111|         const sorted = Array.from(this._chatList.values())
    1112|             .sort((a, b) => b.lastTs - a.lastTs);
    1113|         const now = Date.now();
    1114|         const rows = sorted.map((c, i) => {
    1115|             const elapsed = Math.round((now - c.lastTs) / 60000);
    1116|             const age = elapsed < 60 ? `${elapsed}m ago` : elapsed < 1440 ? `${Math.round(elapsed / 60)}h ago` : `${Math.round(elapsed / 1440)}d ago`;
    1117|             const name = c.name ? `${c.name} (+${c.phone})` : `+${c.phone}`;
    1118|             return `${i + 1}. ${name}\n   JID: ${c.jid}\n   最後: ${c.lastMsg} (${age}, ${c.msgCount} 則)`;
    1119|         });
    1120|         return `已知職天 ${sorted.length} 個（依最新活動排序）：\n\n${rows.join('\n\n')}`;
    1121|     }

    1123|     /** 讀取所有設定的 Ollama 伺服器 URL（amiAiClaw.urls）。 */
    1124|     static _getOllamaUrls(cfg) {
    1125|         const arr = (cfg.get('urls') ?? []).filter((u) => u.trim());
    1126|         if (arr.length > 0) {
    1127|             // 重複出現的 URL 視為停用：只保留恰好出現一次的 URL
    1128|             const count = new Map();
    1129|             for (const u of arr)
    1130|                 count.set(u, (count.get(u) ?? 0) + 1);
    1131|             const enabled = arr.filter(u => count.get(u) === 1);
    1132|             return enabled.length > 0 ? enabled : [];
    1133|         }
    1134|         return [cfg.get('url') ?? 'http://localhost:11434'];
    1135|     }
    1136|     /** 編碼 Ollama model ID：多伺服器時加 URL 前綴，單伺服器時返回原始 model 名稱（向後相容）。 */
    1137|     static _encodeOllamaModelId(url, model, allUrls) {
    1138|         return allUrls.length > 1 ? `${url}||${model}` : model;
    1139|     }
    1140|     /** 顯示標籤：多伺服器時加上 [hostname:port] 前綴。 */
    1141|     static _ollamaDisplayLabel(url, model, allUrls) {
    1142|         if (allUrls.length <= 1)
    1143|             return model;
    1144|         try {
    1145|             const u = new url_1.URL(url);
    1146|             return `[${u.hostname}:${u.port || '11434'}] ${model}`;
    1147|         }
    1148|         catch {
    1149|             return model;
    1150|         }
    1151|     }
    1152|     /** GET /api/tags → 傳回模型名稱清單。 */
    1153|     static _ollamaListModels(baseUrl) {
    1154|         return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    1155|             try {
    1156|                 const url = new url_1.URL('/api/tags', baseUrl);
    1157|                 const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    1158|                 const options = {
    1159|                     hostname: url.hostname,
    1160|                     port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
    1161|                     path: url.pathname,
    1162|                     method: 'GET',
    1163|                 };
    1164|                 const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
    1165|                     let data = '';
    1166|                     res.on('data', (chunk) => { data += chunk; });
    1167|                     res.on('end', () => {
    1168|                         if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
    1169|                             reject(new Error('HTTP ' + res.statusCode));
    1170|                             return;
    1171|                         }
    1172|                         try {
    1173|                             const json = JSON.parse(data);
    1174|                             const names = (json.models ?? []).map((m) => m.name).sort();
    1175|                             resolve(names);
    1176|                         }
    1177|                         catch {
    1178|                             reject(new Error('Invalid JSON from /api/tags'));
    1179|                         }
    1180|                     });
    1181|                 });
    1182|                 req.on('error', (e) => reject(WhatsAppManager._ollamaConnectError(url.hostname, e)));
    1183|                 req.setTimeout(8000, () => { req.destroy(new Error('ETIMEDOUT')); });
    1184|                 req.end();
    1185|             }
    1186|             catch (e) {
    1187|                 reject(e);
    1188|             }
    1189|         });
    1190|     }
    1191|     static _ollamaConnectError(hostname, e) {
    1192|         if (e.code === 'ENOTFOUND') {
    1193|             return new Error('主機名稱 \'' + hostname + '\' 無法解析（DNS），請確認 /etc/hosts 或 DNS 設定');
    1194|         }
    1195|         if (e.code === 'ECONNREFUSED') {
    1196|             return new Error('連線被拒絕（port 未開放），請確認 Ollama 伺服器已啟動：' + hostname + ':11434');
    1197|         }
    1198|         if (e.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' || e.message === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
    1199|             return new Error('連線逾時，請確認防火牆設定或主機 \'' + hostname + '\' 可達');
    1200|         }
    1201|         if (e.code === 'EHOSTUNREACH') {
    1202|             return new Error('無法到達主機 \'' + hostname + '\'，請確認網路路由設定');
    1203|         }
    1204|         return new Error((e.code ? e.code + ': ' : '') + e.message);
    1205|     }

     122|     // 建立一個 Proxy 用以攔截陣列變更並標記為需要儲存
     123|     createHistoryProxy(arr, sessionId) {
     124|         const that = this;
     125|         const target = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
     126|         const handler = {
     127|             set(t, prop, value) {
     128|                 const res = Reflect.set(t, prop, value);
     129|                 // 設定長度或數字索引時視為修改
     130|                 if (typeof prop === 'string' && (prop === 'length' || /^\d+$/.test(prop))) {
     131|                     that._chatDirty = true;
     132|                     that.schedulePersistChatHistories();
     133|                 }
     134|                 return res;
     135|             },
     136|             get(t, prop, receiver) {
     137|                 const v = Reflect.get(t, prop, receiver);
     138|                 if (typeof v === 'function') {
     139|                     const name = String(prop);
     140|                     if (['push', 'pop', 'shift', 'unshift', 'splice', 'sort', 'reverse', 'fill', 'copyWithin'].includes(name)) {
     141|                         return function (...args) {
     142|                             const r = Array.prototype[name].apply(t, args);
     143|                             that._chatDirty = true;
     144|                             that.schedulePersistChatHistories();
     145|                             return r;
     146|                         };
     147|                     }
     148|                 }
     149|                 return v;
     150|             }
     151|         };
     152|         const proxy = new Proxy(target, handler);
     153|         proxy.__isProxy = true;
     154|         return proxy;
     155|     }

     225|     /** 記錄一次 API 呼叫的 token 使用量，並推送更新到前端。 */
     226|     trackUsage(model, tokens, multiplier = '', toolCall = false) {
     227|         if (!toolCall && (!tokens || tokens <= 0)) {
     228|             return;
     229|         }
     230|         const isCopilot = model.startsWith('copilot::') || model.startsWith('copilot/');
     231|         const key = model.replace(/^copilot[::\/]+/, '');
     232|         const existing = this._usageStats[key];
     233|         if (existing) {
     234|             existing.tokens += tokens;
     235|             if (tokens > 0)
     236|                 existing.calls = (existing.calls || 0) + 1;
     237|             if (toolCall)
     238|                 existing.toolCalls = (existing.toolCalls || 0) + 1;
     239|         }
     240|         else {
     241|             this._usageStats[key] = { tokens, isCopilot, multiplier, calls: tokens > 0 ? 1 : 0, toolCalls: toolCall ? 1 : 0 };
     242|         }
     243|         // 持久化累計值
     244|         const saved = this._context.globalState.get('amiAiClaw.usageStats') ?? {};
     245|         const sk = saved[key];
     246|         if (sk) {
     247|             sk.tokens += tokens;
     248|             if (tokens > 0)
     249|                 sk.calls = (sk.calls || 0) + 1;
     250|             if (toolCall)
     251|                 sk.toolCalls = (sk.toolCalls || 0) + 1;
     252|         }
     253|         else {
     254|             saved[key] = { tokens, isCopilot, multiplier, calls: tokens > 0 ? 1 : 0, toolCalls: toolCall ? 1 : 0 };
     255|         }
     256|         this._context.globalState.update('amiAiClaw.usageStats', saved);
     257|         this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'usageUpdate', stats: this._usageStats });
     258|     }
     259|     /** 記錄一次請求的延遲，並推送到前端。 */

    1247|     /** Send any message to the webview from outside the class (e.g. from extension.ts commands) */

    1255|     /** 顯示稽核日誌（Quick Pick 清單）—列出最近 200 筆 Agent 工具呼叫紀錄 */
    1256|     showAuditLog() {
    1257|         const entries = this._tools.getAuditLog();
    1258|         if (entries.length === 0) {
    1259|             vscode.window.showInformationMessage('稽核日誌為空 — 尚未有 Agent 工具呼叫記錄');
    1260|             return;

    1262|         const items = entries.slice().reverse().slice(0, 200).map(e => ({
    1263|             label: `${e.error ? '❌' : '✅'} ${e.tool}`,
    1264|             description: new Date(e.ts).toLocaleString('zh-TW'),
    1265|             detail: e.argsSnippet,
    1266|         }));
    1267|         void vscode.window.showQuickPick(items, {
    1268|             title: `稽核日誌（共 ${entries.length} 筆工具呼叫）`,
    1269|             placeHolder: '工具呼叫歷程…',
    1270|         });
    1271|     }
    1272|     static async createOrShow(context) {
    1273|         // 優先：focus 側邊欄 view —— activity bar 內的 view 不會被使用者意外關掉，可常駐
    1274|         try {
    1275|             await vscode.commands.executeCommand('amiAiClaw.chatView.focus');
    1276|             // resolveWebviewView 會在 view 首次顯示時被 VS Code 呼叫，由 createFromView 建立實例
    1277|             if (OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) {
    1278|                 return;
    1279|             }
    1280|         }
    1281|         catch (e) {
    1282|             OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createOrShow: chatView.focus failed, falling back to editor panel', e);
    1283|         }
    1284|         // 已存在的實例（不論是 WebviewView 或 editor panel）：直接 reveal
    1285|         if (OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) {
    1286|             OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel._panel.reveal?.(vscode.ViewColumn.One, true);
    1287|             return;
    1288|         }
    1289|         // 最後備援：傳統 editor-column panel（注意：使用者關閉此 tab 後實例會 dispose）
    1290|         const panel = vscode.window.createWebviewPanel(OllamaChatPanel.viewType, 'AmiClaw', { viewColumn: vscode.ViewColumn.Beside, preserveFocus: false }, { enableScripts: true, retainContextWhenHidden: true });
    1291|         try {
    1292|             OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel = new OllamaChatPanel(panel, context);
    1293|             OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createOrShow: fallback editor panel created');
    1294|         }
    1295|         catch (e) {
    1296|             OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createOrShow: fallback editor panel init failed', e);
    1297|             try {
    1298|                 panel.dispose();
    1299|             }
    1300|             catch { /* ignore */ }
    1301|             OllamaChatPanel.revealDiagnostics();
    1302|             void vscode.window.showErrorMessage('AmiClaw 啟動失敗，請查看輸出視窗「AmiClaw Diagnostics」。');
    1303|             throw e;
    1304|         }
    1305|     }
    1306|     /** 由 WebviewViewProvider.resolveWebviewView 呼叫，建立固定側邊欄實例 */
    1307|     static createFromView(view, context) {
    1308|         view.webview.options = { enableScripts: true, localResourceRoots: [] };
    1309|         if (OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) {
    1310|             OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createFromView: replacing existing panel instance for sidebar re-resolve');
    1311|             try {
    1312|                 OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel.dispose();
    1313|             }
    1314|             catch (e) {
    1315|                 OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createFromView: disposing existing panel failed', e);
    1316|             }
    1317|         }
    1318|         const adapter = new ChatPanelAdapter_1.WebviewViewAdapter(view);
    1319|         try {
    1320|             OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel = new OllamaChatPanel(adapter, context);
    1321|             OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createFromView: sidebar panel created');
    1322|         }
    1323|         catch (e) {
    1324|             OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('createFromView: sidebar panel init failed', e);
    1325|             OllamaChatPanel.revealDiagnostics();
    1326|             throw e;
    1327|         }
    1328|     }
    1329|     /**
    1330|      * 静默建立（不顯示 panel，不切換焦點）—— VS Code 開啟時自動呼叫，目的是發動 WA 自動重連。
    1331|      * 若 panel 已存在則跳過。
    1332|      *
    1333|      * 注意：以前會在 1.5s 後 fallback 建立 editor panel，但 editor panel 可以被使用者意外關掉、
    1334|      * 之後 currentPanel = undefined，造成「AmiClaw 無法常駐」。新版只觸發 sidebar view 解析
    1335|      * （VS Code 在 view 首次顯示時才會呼叫 resolveWebviewView），不再建立 editor panel。
    1336|      * WA 自動重連會等到使用者第一次開啟 AmiClaw 側邊欄時才啟動。
    1337|      */
    1338|     static createSilent(_context) {
    1339|         if (OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) {
    1340|             return;
    1341|         }
    1342|         // 不主動 focus（會搶走使用者焦點），等使用者點 activity bar 圖示時自然解析
    1343|         OllamaChatPanel.log('AmiClaw 等待使用者開啟側邊欄；開啟後 WhatsApp 等服務會自動初始化');
    1344|     }
    1345|     /**
    1346|      * 進入「工作檔模式」：後續 agentChunk / assistant 訊息都會被累積，
    1347|      * 直到 agentStatus.running===false 後觸發 onTodoComplete 回呼。
    1348|      * 注意：streamDone 只代表單次串流結束，Agent 可能還有多輪工具呼叫，不作為觸發條件。
    1349|      * 由 extension.ts 的 processTodoFile 呼叫。
    1350|      */
    1351|     enterTodoMode(prompt) {
    1352|         this._todoModePrompt = prompt;
    1353|         this._todoAccumulator = '';
    1354|     }
    1355|     /** 統一的 postToWebview 入口，在 todo 模式下攔截訊息以累積回應文字。 */
    1356|     _postToWebview(msg) {
    1357|         // 累積 agent / ask 的回應文字
    1358|         if (this._todoModePrompt !== undefined) {
    1359|             if (msg.type === 'agentChunk' && typeof msg.text === 'string') {
    1360|                 this._todoAccumulator += msg.text;
    1361|             }
    1362|             else if (msg.type === 'assistant' && typeof msg.text === 'string') {
    1363|                 this._todoAccumulator += msg.text;
    1364|             }
    1365|             else if (msg.type === 'agentStatus' && msg.running === false) {
    1366|                 // Agent 全部輪次結束 → 觸發回呼（agentStatus.running===false 才是最終完成信號）
    1367|                 const prompt = this._todoModePrompt;
    1368|                 const response = this._todoAccumulator.trim();
    1369|                 this._todoModePrompt = undefined;
    1370|                 this._todoAccumulator = '';
    1371|                 if (response && OllamaChatPanel.onTodoComplete) {
    1372|                     OllamaChatPanel.onTodoComplete(prompt, response);
    1373|                 }
    1374|             }
    1375|         }
    1376|         this._panel.webview.postMessage(msg);
    1377|     }
    1378|     broadcastHeartbeat() {

    1380|     }

    1385|     switchChatSession(sessionId) {

    1396|         this._agentExecutor.switchSession(id);
    1397|     }
    1398|     /**
    1399|      * Send one or more URIs (files or folders) to the open chat panel as context.
    1400|      * Call AFTER createOrShow so currentPanel is guaranteed to exist.
    1401|      */
    1402|     static async sendUrisToChat(uris) {
    1403|         const panel = OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel;
    1404|         if (!panel) {
    1405|             return;
    1406|         }
    1407|         await panel.waitForWebviewReady();
    1408|         for (const uri of uris) {
    1409|             let stat;
    1410|             try {
    1411|                 stat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(uri);
    1412|             }
    1413|             catch {
    1414|                 continue;
    1415|             }
    1416|             if (stat.type & vscode.FileType.Directory) {
    1417|                 // Send directory listing
    1418|                 const entries = await vscode.workspace.fs.readDirectory(uri);
    1419|                 const listing = entries.map(([name, type]) => (type & vscode.FileType.Directory) ? name + '/' : name).join('\n');
    1420|                 panel._panel.webview.postMessage({
    1421|                     type: 'fileAttached',
    1422|                     name: uri.fsPath,
    1423|                     content: `[目錄列表]\n${listing}`
    1424|                 });
    1425|             }
    1426|             else {
    1427|                 // Send file content (limit to 500 KB)
    1428|                 const MAX = 500 * 1024;
    1429|                 const raw = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
    1430|                 const content = raw.byteLength > MAX
    1431|                     ? Buffer.from(raw).toString('utf8', 0, MAX) + '\n...(截斷)'
    1432|                     : Buffer.from(raw).toString('utf8');
    1433|                 panel._panel.webview.postMessage({
    1434|                     type: 'fileAttached',
    1435|                     name: uri.fsPath,
    1436|                     content
    1437|                 });
    1438|             }
    1439|         }
    1440|     }
    1441|     dispose() {
    1442|         if (this._disposed) {
    1443|             return;
    1444|         }
    1445|         this._disposed = true;
    1446|         if (this._latestWebviewSessions) {
    1447|             if (this._webviewSessionsPersistTimer) {
    1448|                 clearTimeout(this._webviewSessionsPersistTimer);
    1449|                 this._webviewSessionsPersistTimer = null;
    1450|             }
    1451|             void this._context.workspaceState.update('amiAiClaw.webviewSessions', this._latestWebviewSessions);
    1452|         }
    1453|         OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel = undefined;
    1454|         try {
    1455|             this._panel.dispose();
    1456|         }
    1457|         catch (e) {
    1458|             OllamaChatPanel.reportDiagnostic('dispose: panel dispose failed', e);
    1459|         }
    1460|         while (this._disposables.length) {
    1461|             const d = this._disposables.pop();
    1462|             if (d) {
    1463|                 d.dispose();
    1464|             }
    1465|         }
    1466|     }

    1707|     async handleApplyToFile(code) {
    1708|         const editor = vscode.window.activeTextEditor;
    1709|         if (!editor) {
    1710|             vscode.window.showWarningMessage('沒有開啟的編輯器');
    1711|             return;
    1712|         }
    1713|         const doc = editor.document;
    1714|         const fullRange = new vscode.Range(doc.positionAt(0), doc.positionAt(doc.getText().length));
    1715|         const lines = doc.getText().split('\n').length;
    1716|         if (lines > 50) {
    1717|             const ans = await vscode.window.showWarningMessage(`將替換 ${doc.fileName.split(/[\\/]/).pop()} (${lines} 行) 的全部內容，確定?`, '確定替換', '取消');
    1718|             if (ans !== '確定替換') {
    1719|                 return;
    1720|             }
    1721|         }
    1722|         await editor.edit(eb => eb.replace(fullRange, code));
    1723|         vscode.window.showInformationMessage('已套用到檔案');
    1724|     }

    1731| /** 過濾輸出文字中的敏感資訊（API key、token、密碼等），避免模型學習或外洩憑證。 */
    1732| function filterSensitiveInfo(text) {
    1733|     return text
    1734|         // JWT tokens (Header.Payload.Signature)
    1735|         .replace(/eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{5,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{5,}/g, '[JWT_REDACTED]')
    1736|         // AWS access key IDs
    1737|         .replace(/\bAKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}\b/g, '[AWS_KEY_REDACTED]')
    1738|         // PEM private key blocks
    1739|         .replace(/-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z ]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END (?:[A-Z ]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----/g, '[PRIVATE_KEY_REDACTED]')
    1740|         // Authorization Bearer headers
    1741|         .replace(/(Authorization:\s*Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9_\-.+/]{20,}/gi, '$1[REDACTED]')
    1742|         // GitHub personal access tokens
    1743|         .replace(/\bgh[pousr]_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36,}\b/g, '[GH_TOKEN_REDACTED]')
    1744|         // OpenAI / Anthropic / generic sk- API keys
    1745|         .replace(/\bsk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}\b/g, '[API_KEY_REDACTED]')
    1746|         // Generic credential key=value or "key": "value" patterns
    1747|         .replace(/(["\'']?(?:api_?key|secret|password|passwd|token|access_?key|auth_?key|private_?key)["\'']?\s*[:=]\s*["\'']?)[A-Za-z0-9_\-.+/]{16,}(["\'']?)/gi, '$1[REDACTED]$2');
    1748| }
    1749| /** 估算文字的約略 token 數（CJK 字元每個約 1 token，ASCII 每 4 字元約 1 token）。 */
    1750| function estimateTokens(text) {
    1751|     let count = 0;
    1752|     for (const ch of text) {
    1753|         const code = ch.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;
    1754|         count += code > 0x2E7F ? 1 : 0.25; // CJK/special ≈ 1 token; ASCII ≈ 1/4 token
    1755|     }
    1756|     return Math.ceil(count);
    1757| }

    1763| /** 向 Ollama `/api/show` 或 vLLM/OpenAI-compat `/v1/models/{id}` 查詢模型實際 context window 大小（tokens）。
