    2065| function ollamaChatCallStream(baseUrl, model, messages, tools, onThinkChunk, onTextChunk, onStats) {
    2066|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    2067|         try {
    2068|             const url = new url_1.URL('/api/chat', baseUrl);
    2069|             const bodyObj = {
    2070|                 model, messages, stream: true,
    2071|                 ...(tools.length > 0 ? { tools } : {}),
    2072|                 ...getOllamaThinkParam(model)
    2073|             };
    2074|             const body = JSON.stringify(bodyObj);
    2075|             const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    2076|             const options = {
    2077|                 hostname: url.hostname,
    2078|                 port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
    2079|                 path: url.pathname, method: 'POST',
    2080|                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) }
    2081|             };
    2082|             let lineBuffer = '';
    2083|             let accContent = '';
    2084|             let accThinking = '';
    2085|             let finalToolCalls;
    2086|             let wasTruncated = false;
    2087|             const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
    2088|                 if (res.statusCode && (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300)) {
    2089|                     let errBody = '';
    2090|                     res.setEncoding('utf8');
    2091|                     res.on('data', (d) => { errBody += d; });
    2092|                     res.on('end', () => {
    2093|                         try {
    2094|                             const j = JSON.parse(errBody);
    2095|                             reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + (j.error ?? 'HTTP ' + res.statusCode)));
    2096|                         }
    2097|                         catch {
    2098|                             reject(new Error('Ollama HTTP ' + res.statusCode));
    2099|                         }
    2100|                     });
    2101|                     return;
    2102|                 }
    2103|                 res.setEncoding('utf8');
    2104|                 let streamError = null;
    2105|                 res.on('data', (data) => {
    2106|                     lineBuffer += data;
    2107|                     const lines = lineBuffer.split('\n');
    2108|                     lineBuffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
    2109|                     for (const line of lines) {
    2110|                         const t = line.trim();
    2111|                         if (!t)
    2112|                             continue;
    2113|                         try {
    2114|                             const json = JSON.parse(t);
    2115|                             if (json.error) {
    2116|                                 const e = json.error;
    2117|                                 streamError = typeof e === 'string' ? e : e.message ?? JSON.stringify(e);
    2118|                                 return;
    2119|                             }
    2120|                             const msgFrag = json.message;
    2121|                             if (msgFrag) {
    2122|                                 if (msgFrag.thinking) {
    2123|                                     accThinking += msgFrag.thinking;
    2124|                                     if (onThinkChunk)
    2125|                                         onThinkChunk(msgFrag.thinking);
    2126|                                 }
    2127|                                 if (msgFrag.content) {
    2128|                                     accContent += msgFrag.content;
    2129|                                     if (onTextChunk)
    2130|                                         onTextChunk(msgFrag.content);
    2131|                                 }
    2132|                                 if (msgFrag.tool_calls && Array.isArray(msgFrag.tool_calls) && msgFrag.tool_calls.length > 0) {
    2133|                                     finalToolCalls = msgFrag.tool_calls;
    2134|                                 }
    2135|                             }
    2136|                             if (json.done) {
    2137|                                 if (json.done_reason === 'length')
    2138|                                     wasTruncated = true;
    2139|                                 const ec = json.eval_count;
    2140|                                 const ed = json.eval_duration;
    2141|                                 if (onStats && ec && ed && ed > 0)
    2142|                                     onStats(ec, ec / (ed / 1e9));
    2143|                             }
    2144|                         }
    2145|                         catch { /* partial */ }
    2146|                     }
    2147|                 });
    2148|                 res.on('end', () => {
    2149|                     if (streamError) {
    2150|                         reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + streamError));
    2151|                         return;
    2152|                     }
    2153|                     if (finalToolCalls && finalToolCalls.length > 0) {
    2154|                         resolve({ role: 'assistant', content: accContent || null, tool_calls: finalToolCalls });
    2155|                     }
    2156|                     else {
    2157|                         let content = accContent;
    2158|                         if (!accThinking && content) {
    2159|                             const m = content.match(/^<think>([\s\S]*?)<\/think>\s*/);
    2160|                             if (m) {
    2161|                                 if (onThinkChunk)
    2162|                                     onThinkChunk(m[1].trim());
    2163|                                 content = content.slice(m[0].length);
    2164|                             }
    2165|                         }
    2166|                         resolve({ role: 'assistant', content: content || null, thinking: accThinking || undefined, truncated: wasTruncated || undefined });
    2167|                     }
    2168|                 });
    2169|             });
    2170|             req.on('error', (e) => reject(ollamaConnectError(new url_1.URL(baseUrl).hostname, e)));
    2171|             req.setTimeout(600000, () => { req.destroy(new Error('Agent 呼叫逾時 (600s)')); });
    2172|             req.write(body);
    2173|             req.end();
    2174|         }
    2175|         catch (e) {
    2176|             reject(e);
    2177|         }
    2178|     });
    2179| }

    2501| async function copilotChatCallWithCts(modelId, messages, tools) {
    2502|     const lms = await vscode.lm.selectChatModels({ id: modelId });
    2503|     const lm = lms[0];
    2504|     if (!lm) {
    2505|         throw new Error(`Copilot 找不到模型: ${modelId}`);
    2506|     }
    2507|     // 防禦性過濾：移除孤立的 tool_result（找不到對應 tool_use 的 tool 訊息），避免 Bedrock/Anthropic 400 錯誤
    2508|     const sanitized = messages.filter((m, i) => {
    2509|         if (m.role !== 'tool') {
    2510|             return true;
    2511|         }
    2512|         // 往前找最近的 assistant 訊息，確認其 tool_calls 包含此 tool_call_id
    2513|         let ai = i - 1;
    2514|         while (ai >= 0 && messages[ai].role === 'tool') {
    2515|             ai--;
    2516|         }
    2517|         return ai >= 0 && messages[ai].role === 'assistant' &&
    2518|             (messages[ai].tool_calls ?? []).some(tc => (tc.id ?? tc.function.name) === m.tool_call_id);
    2519|     });
    2520|     // 正確轉換每種 role 為 VS Code LM API 對應的 Part 型別
    2521|     const vmMsgs = [];
    2522|     for (const m of sanitized) {
    2523|         if (m.role === 'system' || m.role === 'user') {
    2524|             // system 沒有對應 role，以 User 訊息注入
    2525|             vmMsgs.push(vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(m.content ?? ''));
    2526|         }
    2527|         else if (m.role === 'assistant') {
    2528|             // 助手訊息可能同時含文字與工具呼叫（Claude Sonnet tool-use 格式）
    2529|             const parts = [];
    2530|             if (m.content) {
    2531|                 parts.push(new vscode.LanguageModelTextPart(m.content));
    2532|             }
    2533|             for (const tc of m.tool_calls ?? []) {
    2534|                 const args = (typeof tc.function.arguments === 'string'
    2535|                     ? JSON.parse(tc.function.arguments)
    2536|                     : tc.function.arguments);
    2537|                 parts.push(new vscode.LanguageModelToolCallPart(tc.id ?? tc.function.name, tc.function.name, args));
    2538|             }
    2539|             if (parts.length === 0) {
    2540|                 parts.push(new vscode.LanguageModelTextPart(''));
    2541|             }
    2542|             // 純文字時直接傳 string，避免不必要的 Part 包裝
    2543|             vmMsgs.push(parts.length === 1 && parts[0] instanceof vscode.LanguageModelTextPart
    2544|                 ? vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.Assistant(parts[0].value)
    2545|                 : vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.Assistant(parts));
    2546|         }
    2547|         else if (m.role === 'tool') {
    2548|             // 工具執行結果：用 LanguageModelToolResultPart，讓 Claude Sonnet 正確對應 tool_call_id
    2549|             vmMsgs.push(vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User([
    2550|                 new vscode.LanguageModelToolResultPart(m.tool_call_id ?? '', [new vscode.LanguageModelTextPart(m.content ?? '')])
    2551|             ]));
    2552|         }
    2553|     }
    2554|     const vmTools = tools.map(t => ({
    2555|         name: t.function.name,
    2556|         description: t.function.description,
    2557|         inputSchema: t.function.parameters,
    2558|     }));
    2559|     const cts = new vscode.CancellationTokenSource();
    2560|     try {
    2561|         const response = await lm.sendRequest(vmMsgs, { tools: vmTools }, cts.token);
    2562|         let text = '';
    2563|         const toolCalls = [];
    2564|         for await (const part of response.stream) {
    2565|             if (part instanceof vscode.LanguageModelTextPart) {
    2566|                 text += part.value;
    2567|             }
    2568|             else if (part instanceof vscode.LanguageModelToolCallPart) {
    2569|                 toolCalls.push({
    2570|                     id: part.callId,
    2571|                     function: {
    2572|                         name: part.name,
    2573|                         arguments: (typeof part.input === 'object' ? part.input : JSON.parse(String(part.input))),
    2574|                     },
    2575|                 });
    2576|             }
    2577|         }
    2578|         return { role: 'assistant', content: text || null, ...(toolCalls.length > 0 ? { tool_calls: toolCalls } : {}) };
    2579|     }
    2580|     finally {
    2581|         cts.dispose();
    2582|     }
    2583| }
    2584| function supportsThinking(model) {
    2585|     // strip registry prefix (hf.co/user/) 後取純模型名稱
    2586|     const m = model.toLowerCase().replace(/^hf\.co\/[^/]+\//i, '').replace(/^.*\//, '');
    2587|     // 明確不支援 thinking 的關鍵字（coder / instruct 變體）
    2588|     if (m.includes('coder') || m.includes('-instruct') || m.includes(':instruct')) {
    2589|         return false;
    2590|     }
    2591|     // 明確支援 thinking 的模型
    2592|     return m.startsWith('deepseek-r1') || m.startsWith('deepseek-r2') ||
    2593|         m.startsWith('qwq') ||
    2594|         // qwen3 只有 thinking 系列才支援，判斷方式：名稱不含 coder/instruct 且根模型就叫 qwen3
    2595|         (m.startsWith('qwen3') && !m.includes('coder')) ||
    2596|         m.includes(':thinking') || m.includes('-thinking') ||
    2597|         m.includes('think') || m.includes('-r1') || m.includes(':r1') ||
    2598|         m.includes('r1-') || /^r1[:.-]/.test(m);
    2599| }
    2600| function getCurrentThinkingLevel() {
    2601|     const v = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw').get('thinkingLevel', 'medium');
    2602|     return (v === 'off' || v === 'low' || v === 'medium' || v === 'high' || v === 'max') ? v : 'medium';
    2603| }
    2604| /**
    2605|  * 依使用者「思考等級」設定 + 模型能力，回傳要塞進 Ollama request body 的 think 參數。
    2606|  * - off: 強制 think:false（即使模型支援，也跳過思考，省 token & 加速）
    2607|  * - low/medium: 傳對應字串（各模型 Jinja 模板通用）
    2608|  * - high/max: 傳 true（布林），讓 Ollama 套用模型預設最大思考力，避免模板等級字串不相容
    2609|  * - 模型不支援思考時，不加 think key（讓 Ollama 用模型預設）
    2610|  */
    2611| function getOllamaThinkParam(model) {
    2612|     const level = getCurrentThinkingLevel();
    2613|     if (level === 'off') {
    2614|         return { think: false };
    2615|     }
    2616|     if (!supportsThinking(model)) {
    2617|         return {};
    2618|     }
    2619|     // 'low'/'medium' are universally supported strings; 'high'/'max' fall back to boolean true
    2620|     if (level === 'low' || level === 'medium') {
    2621|         return { think: level };
    2622|     }
    2623|     return { think: true };
    2624| }
    2625| function ollamaGenerate(baseUrl, model, prompt) {
    2626|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    2627|         try {
    2628|             const url = new url_1.URL('/api/generate', baseUrl);
    2629|             const params = { model, prompt, stream: false };
    2630|             Object.assign(params, getOllamaThinkParam(model));
    2631|             const body = JSON.stringify(params);
    2632|             const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    2633|             const options = {
    2634|                 hostname: url.hostname,
    2635|                 port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
    2636|                 path: url.pathname,
    2637|                 method: 'POST',
    2638|                 headers: {
    2639|                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    2640|                     'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body)
    2641|                 }
    2642|             };
    2643|             const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
    2644|                 let data = '';
    2645|                 res.on('data', (chunk) => { data += chunk; });
    2646|                 res.on('end', () => {
    2647|                     if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
    2648|                         reject(new Error(`Ollama returned HTTP ${res.statusCode}: ${data.substring(0, 200)}`));
    2649|                         return;
    2650|                     }
    2651|                     try {
    2652|                         const json = JSON.parse(data);
    2653|                         let response = json.response ?? data;
    2654|                         let thinking = json.thinking;
    2655|                         // fallback: extract <think>...</think> if model embeds it in response
    2656|                         if (!thinking) {
    2657|                             const m = /^<think>([\s\S]*?)<\/think>\s*/i.exec(response);
    2658|                             if (m) {
    2659|                                 thinking = m[1];
    2660|                                 response = response.slice(m[0].length);
    2661|                             }
    2662|                         }
    2663|                         resolve({ response, thinking });
    2664|                     }
    2665|                     catch {
    2666|                         resolve({ response: data });
    2667|                     }
    2668|                 });
    2669|             });
    2670|             req.on('error', (e) => reject(new Error(`無法連線到 Ollama (${baseUrl})：${e.message}`)));
    2671|             req.write(body);
    2672|             req.end();
    2673|         }
    2674|         catch (e) {
    2675|             reject(e);
    2676|         }
    2677|     });
    2678| }
    2679| const OLLAMA_RETRY_ERRORS = ['ECONNRESET', 'ETIMEDOUT', 'ECONNREFUSED', 'socket hang up', '超時', 'timeout'];
    2680| function isRetryableOllamaError(e) {
    2681|     const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    2682|     return OLLAMA_RETRY_ERRORS.some(s => msg.toLowerCase().includes(s.toLowerCase()));
    2683| }
    2684| /**
    2685|  * 從 LLM 回傳文字中抽出 extractMemories 的 JSON array。
    2686|  * 容忍 ```json``` fence、前後解說文字、單一物件包裝等常見格式偏差。
    2687|  */
    2688| function parseExtractMemoriesJson(raw) {
    2689|     if (!raw)
    2690|         return [];
    2691|     const fence = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    2692|     let candidate = fence ? fence[1] : raw;
    2693|     const arrayStart = candidate.indexOf('[');
    2694|     const arrayEnd = candidate.lastIndexOf(']');
    2695|     if (arrayStart >= 0 && arrayEnd > arrayStart) {
    2696|         candidate = candidate.slice(arrayStart, arrayEnd + 1);
    2697|     }
    2698|     try {
    2699|         const parsed = JSON.parse(candidate);
    2700|         if (!Array.isArray(parsed))
    2701|             return [];
    2702|         const valid = [];
    2703|         for (const item of parsed) {
    2704|             if (!item || typeof item !== 'object')
    2705|                 continue;
    2706|             const o = item;
    2707|             const type = String(o.type ?? '');
    2708|             if (type !== 'fact' && type !== 'preference' && type !== 'pattern' && type !== 'context')
    2709|                 continue;
    2710|             const title = String(o.title ?? '').trim();
    2711|             const body = String(o.body ?? '').trim();
    2712|             const slug = String(o.slug ?? '').trim();
    2713|             const oneLineHook = String(o.oneLineHook ?? title).trim();
    2714|             if (!title || !body)
    2715|                 continue;
    2716|             const tags = Array.isArray(o.tags) ? o.tags.map(t => String(t)).slice(0, 10) : undefined;
    2717|             valid.push({ type, title, slug, body, oneLineHook, tags });
    2718|         }
    2719|         return valid;
    2720|     }
    2721|     catch {
    2722|         return [];
    2723|     }
    2724| }
    2725| async function ollamaGenerateStreamWithRetry(baseUrl, model, prompt, onResponseChunk, onThinkChunk, onRetry, maxRetries = 10, retrySec = 60, onStats) {
    2726|     for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    2727|         try {
    2728|             return await ollamaGenerateStream(baseUrl, model, prompt, onResponseChunk, onThinkChunk, onStats);
    2729|         }
    2730|         catch (e) {
    2731|             if (attempt >= maxRetries || !isRetryableOllamaError(e))
    2732|                 throw e;
    2733|             const errMsg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    2734|             if (onRetry)
    2735|                 onRetry(attempt + 1, retrySec, errMsg);
    2736|             await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, retrySec * 1000));
    2737|         }
    2738|     }
    2739|     throw new Error('retry exhausted');
    2740| }
    2741| function ollamaGenerateStream(baseUrl, model, prompt, onResponseChunk, onThinkChunk, onStats, images) {
    2742|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    2743|         try {
    2744|             const url = new url_1.URL('/api/generate', baseUrl);
    2745|             const params = { model, prompt, stream: true };
    2746|             Object.assign(params, getOllamaThinkParam(model));
    2747|             if (images && images.length > 0) {
    2748|                 params.images = images;
    2749|             }
    2750|             const body = JSON.stringify(params);
    2751|             const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    2752|             const options = {
    2753|                 hostname: url.hostname,
    2754|                 port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
    2755|                 path: url.pathname,
    2756|                 method: 'POST',
    2757|                 headers: {
    2758|                     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    2759|                     'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body)
    2760|                 }
    2761|             };
    2762|             let lineBuffer = '';
    2763|             let fullResponse = '';
    2764|             let inThink = false;
    2765|             // Process a single response token, routing to think or response callbacks
    2766|             const processToken = (token) => {
    2767|                 let rem = token;
    2768|                 while (rem.length > 0) {
    2769|                     if (!inThink) {
    2770|                         const ts = rem.indexOf('<think>');
    2771|                         if (ts === -1) {
    2772|                             fullResponse += rem;
    2773|                             onResponseChunk(rem);
    2774|                             break;
    2775|                         }
    2776|                         if (ts > 0) {
    2777|                             const b = rem.slice(0, ts);
    2778|                             fullResponse += b;
    2779|                             onResponseChunk(b);
    2780|                         }
    2781|                         inThink = true;
    2782|                         rem = rem.slice(ts + 7);
    2783|                     }
    2784|                     else {
    2785|                         const te = rem.indexOf('</think>');
    2786|                         if (te === -1) {
    2787|                             if (onThinkChunk)
    2788|                                 onThinkChunk(rem);
    2789|                             break;
    2790|                         }
    2791|                         const tc = rem.slice(0, te);
    2792|                         if (onThinkChunk && tc)
    2793|                             onThinkChunk(tc);
    2794|                         inThink = false;
    2795|                         rem = rem.slice(te + 8);
    2796|                     }
    2797|                 }
    2798|             };
    2799|             const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
    2800|                 if (res.statusCode && (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300)) {
    2801|                     let errBody = '';
    2802|                     res.setEncoding('utf8');
    2803|                     res.on('data', (d) => { errBody += d; });
    2804|                     res.on('end', () => {
    2805|                         try {
    2806|                             const j = JSON.parse(errBody);
    2807|                             reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + (j.error ?? 'HTTP ' + res.statusCode)));
    2808|                         }
    2809|                         catch {
    2810|                             reject(new Error('Ollama HTTP ' + res.statusCode));
    2811|                         }
    2812|                     });
    2813|                     return;
    2814|                 }
    2815|                 res.setEncoding('utf8');
    2816|                 let streamError = null;
    2817|                 res.on('data', (data) => {
    2818|                     lineBuffer += data;
    2819|                     const lines = lineBuffer.split('\n');
    2820|                     lineBuffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
    2821|                     for (const line of lines) {
    2822|                         const t = line.trim();
    2823|                         if (!t)
    2824|                             continue;
    2825|                         try {
    2826|                             const json = JSON.parse(t);
    2827|                             if (json.error) {
    2828|                                 const e = json.error;
    2829|                                 streamError = typeof e === 'string' ? e : e.message ?? JSON.stringify(e);
    2830|                                 return;
    2831|                             }
    2832|                             // dedicated thinking field (Ollama >= 0.9 with think models)
    2833|                             if (json.thinking && onThinkChunk)
    2834|                                 onThinkChunk(json.thinking);
    2835|                             if (json.response)
    2836|                                 processToken(json.response);
    2837|                             if (json.done && onStats && typeof json.eval_count === 'number' && typeof json.eval_duration === 'number' && json.eval_duration > 0) {
    2838|                                 onStats(json.eval_count, json.eval_count / (json.eval_duration / 1e9));
    2839|                             }
    2840|                         }
    2841|                         catch { /* partial or non-JSON line */ }
    2842|                     }
    2843|                 });
    2844|                 res.on('end', () => {
    2845|                     if (streamError) {
    2846|                         reject(new Error('Ollama 錯誤：' + streamError));
    2847|                         return;
    2848|                     }
    2849|                     resolve(fullResponse);
    2850|                 });
    2851|             });
    2852|             req.on('error', (e) => reject(new Error(`無法連線到 Ollama (${baseUrl})：${e.message}`)));
    2853|             req.write(body);
    2854|             req.end();
    2855|         }
    2856|         catch (e) {
    2857|             reject(e);
    2858|         }
    2859|     });
    2860| }

    2974| /** 讀取所有設定的 Ollama 伺服器 URL（amiAiClaw.urls）。 */
    2975| function getOllamaUrls(cfg) {
    2976|     const arr = (cfg.get('urls') ?? []).filter((u) => u.trim());
    2977|     if (arr.length > 0) {
    2978|         // 重複出現的 URL 視為停用：只保留恰好出現一次的 URL
    2979|         const count = new Map();
    2980|         for (const u of arr)
    2981|             count.set(u, (count.get(u) ?? 0) + 1);
    2982|         const enabled = arr.filter(u => count.get(u) === 1);
    2983|         return enabled.length > 0 ? enabled : [];
    2984|     }
    2985|     return [cfg.get('url') ?? 'http://localhost:11434'];
    2986| }
    2987| /** 解碼 Ollama model ID：多伺服器格式為 "http://host:port||modelname"，單伺服器為 "modelname"。
    2988|  *  OpenAI-compatible 格式："openai::http://host:port||modelname" 或 "openai::modelname"（使用 fallbackUrls[0]）。
    2989|  *  解碼後 model 保留 openai:: 前綴供後續路由判斷。
    2990|  */
    2991| function decodeOllamaModel(modelId, fallbackUrls) {
    2992|     // OpenAI-compatible 格式：openai::http://host:port||modelname 或 openai::modelname
    2993|     if (modelId.startsWith('openai::')) {
    2994|         const inner = modelId.slice('openai::'.length);
    2995|         const sep = inner.indexOf('||');
    2996|         if (sep !== -1)
    2997|             return { url: inner.slice(0, sep), model: 'openai::' + inner.slice(sep + 2) };
    2998|         return { url: fallbackUrls[0] ?? 'http://localhost:11434', model: 'openai::' + inner };
    2999|     }
    3000|     const sep = modelId.indexOf('||');
    3001|     if (sep !== -1)
    3002|         return { url: modelId.slice(0, sep), model: modelId.slice(sep + 2) };
    3003|     return { url: fallbackUrls[0] ?? 'http://localhost:11434', model: modelId };
    3004| }
    3005| /** 編碼 Ollama model ID：多伺服器時加 URL 前綴，單伺服器時返回原始 model 名稱（向後相容）。 */
    3006| function encodeOllamaModelId(url, model, allUrls) {
    3007|     if (model.startsWith('openai::')) {
    3008|         return model;
    3009|     }
    3010|     return allUrls.length > 1 ? `${url}||${model}` : model;
    3011| }
    3012| /** 顯示標籤：多伺服器時加上 [hostname:port] 前綴。 */
    3013| function ollamaDisplayLabel(url, model, allUrls) {
    3014|     if (model.startsWith('openai::')) {
    3015|         const inner = model.slice('openai::'.length);
    3016|         const sep = inner.indexOf('||');
    3017|         const sourceUrl = sep !== -1 ? inner.slice(0, sep) : url;
    3018|         const modelName = sep !== -1 ? inner.slice(sep + 2) : inner;
    3019|         if (allUrls.length <= 1 && sep === -1) {
    3020|             return modelName;
    3021|         }
    3022|         try {
    3023|             const u = new url_1.URL(sourceUrl);
    3024|             return `[${u.hostname}:${u.port || (u.protocol === 'https:' ? '443' : '80')}] ${modelName}`;
    3025|         }
    3026|         catch {
    3027|             return modelName;
    3028|         }
    3029|     }
    3030|     if (allUrls.length <= 1)
    3031|         return model;
    3032|     try {
    3033|         const u = new url_1.URL(url);
    3034|         return `[${u.hostname}:${u.port || '11434'}] ${model}`;
    3035|     }
    3036|     catch {
    3037|         return model;
    3038|     }
    3039| }

    3163| function ollamaCheckConnection(baseUrl) {
    3164|     return new Promise((resolve) => {
    3165|         try {
    3166|             const url = new url_1.URL('/api/tags', baseUrl);
    3167|             const openAiUrl = new url_1.URL('/v1/models', baseUrl);
    3168|             const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    3169|             const options = {
    3170|                 hostname: url.hostname,
    3171|                 port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
    3172|                 path: url.pathname,
    3173|                 method: 'GET',
    3174|             };
    3175|             let settled = false;
    3176|             const probeOpenAi = () => {
    3177|                 if (settled) {
    3178|                     return;
    3179|                 }
    3180|                 const p = openAiUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    3181|                 const req2 = p.request({
    3182|                     hostname: openAiUrl.hostname,
    3183|                     port: openAiUrl.port ? parseInt(openAiUrl.port, 10) : (openAiUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
    3184|                     path: openAiUrl.pathname,
    3185|                     method: 'GET',
    3186|                 }, (res2) => {
    3187|                     res2.resume();
    3188|                     if (!settled) {
    3189|                         settled = true;
    3190|                         resolve({ ok: res2.statusCode === 200, message: res2.statusCode === 200 ? 'OpenAI-compatible OK' : 'HTTP ' + res2.statusCode });
    3191|                     }
    3192|                 });
    3193|                 req2.on('error', (e) => {
    3194|                     if (!settled) {
    3195|                         settled = true;
    3196|                         resolve({ ok: false, message: ollamaConnectError(openAiUrl.hostname, e).message });
    3197|                     }
    3198|                 });
    3199|                 req2.setTimeout(8000, () => {
    3200|                     if (!settled) {
    3201|                         settled = true;
    3202|                         req2.destroy();

    3204|                     }
    3205|                 });
    3206|                 req2.end();
    3207|             };
    3208|             const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
    3209|                 res.resume();
    3210|                 if (!settled) {
    3211|                     if (res.statusCode === 200) {
    3212|                         settled = true;
    3213|                         resolve({ ok: true, message: 'OK' });
    3214|                     }
    3215|                     else {
    3216|                         probeOpenAi();
    3217|                     }
    3218|                 }
    3219|             });
    3220|             req.on('error', (e) => {
    3221|                 if (!settled) {
    3222|                     probeOpenAi();
    3223|                 }
    3224|             });
    3225|             req.setTimeout(8000, () => {

    3231|             req.end();

    3235|         }
    3236|     });

    3271| /** 拉取 Ollama 模型，透過 onProgress 回報進度字串。返回 Promise，完成或失敗時 resolve/reject。 */
    3272| function ollamaPullModel(baseUrl, modelName, onProgress) {
    3273|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    3274|         try {
    3275|             const url = new url_1.URL('/api/pull', baseUrl);
    3276|             const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    3277|             const body = JSON.stringify({ model: modelName, stream: true });
    3278|             const options = {
    3279|                 hostname: url.hostname,
    3280|                 port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
    3281|                 path: url.pathname,
    3282|                 method: 'POST',
    3283|                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
    3284|             };
    3285|             const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
    3286|                 if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
    3287|                     res.resume();
    3288|                     reject(new Error('HTTP ' + res.statusCode));
    3289|                     return;
    3290|                 }
    3291|                 let buf = '';
    3292|                 res.on('data', (chunk) => {
    3293|                     buf += chunk.toString();
    3294|                     const lines = buf.split('\n');
    3295|                     buf = lines.pop() ?? '';
    3296|                     for (const line of lines) {
    3297|                         if (!line.trim()) {
    3298|                             continue;
    3299|                         }
    3300|                         try {
    3301|                             const obj = JSON.parse(line);
    3302|                             if (obj.error) {
    3303|                                 reject(new Error(obj.error));
    3304|                                 return;
    3305|                             }
    3306|                             const pct = (obj.total && obj.total > 0) ? Math.round((obj.completed ?? 0) / obj.total * 100) : null;
    3307|                             onProgress(obj.status ?? '', pct);
    3308|                         }
    3309|                         catch { /* skip malformed JSON lines */ }
    3310|                     }
    3311|                 });
    3312|                 res.on('end', () => resolve());
    3313|                 res.on('error', (e) => reject(e));
    3314|             });
    3315|             req.on('error', (e) => reject(ollamaConnectError(url.hostname, e)));
    3316|             req.write(body);
    3317|             req.end();
    3318|         }
    3319|         catch (e) {
    3320|             reject(e);
    3321|         }
    3322|     });
    3323| }
    3324| function ollamaConnectError(hostname, e) {
    3325|     if (e.code === 'ENOTFOUND') {
    3326|         return new Error('主機名稱 \'' + hostname + '\' 無法解析（DNS），請確認 /etc/hosts 或 DNS 設定');
    3327|     }
    3328|     if (e.code === 'ECONNREFUSED') {
    3329|         return new Error('連線被拒絕（port 未開放），請確認 Ollama 伺服器已啟動：' + hostname + ':11434');
    3330|     }
    3331|     if (e.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' || e.message === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
    3332|         return new Error('連線逾時，請確認防火牆設定或主機 \'' + hostname + '\' 可達');
    3333|     }
    3334|     if (e.code === 'EHOSTUNREACH') {
    3335|         return new Error('無法到達主機 \'' + hostname + '\'，請確認網路路由設定');
    3336|     }
    3337|     return new Error((e.code ? e.code + ': ' : '') + e.message);
    3338| }

       4| const DEFAULT_AGENT_INFO = {
       5|     running: false, step: 0, model: '', shadowRunning: false,
       6|     shadowCount: 0, lastActivity: '', startedAt: 0,
       7| };
       8| /**
       9|  * HeartbeatService: A singleton service that provides a periodic pulse (5s).
      10|  * It allows modules to subscribe to tick events and broadcasts the heartbeat to the Webview UI.
      11|  */
      12| class HeartbeatService {
      13|     constructor() {
      14|         this._subscribers = new Set();
      15|         this._disposables = [];
      16|         this._agentInfo = { ...DEFAULT_AGENT_INFO };
      17|     }
      18|     /** Returns the singleton instance of HeartbeatService. */
      19|     static getInstance() {
      20|         if (!HeartbeatService._instance) {
      21|             HeartbeatService._instance = new HeartbeatService();
      22|         }
      23|         return HeartbeatService._instance;
      24|     }
      25|     /** Update agent execution status; called by AgentExecutor at key points. */
      26|     setAgentInfo(info) {
      27|         this._agentInfo = { ...this._agentInfo, ...info };
      28|     }
      29|     getAgentInfo() { return this._agentInfo; }
      30|     /**
      31|      * Starts the heartbeat timer if it's not already running.
      32|      * Period: 5000ms (5 seconds).
      33|      */
      34|     start() {
      35|         if (this._intervalId)
      36|             return;
      37|         this._intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      38|             this._subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
      39|                 try {
      40|                     callback();
      41|                 }
      42|                 catch (err) {
      43|                     console.error('[HeartbeatService] Subscriber error:', err);
      44|                 }
      45|             });
      46|         }, 5000);
      47|     }
      48|     /** Stops the heartbeat timer. */
      49|     stop() {
      50|         if (this._intervalId) {
      51|             clearInterval(this._intervalId);
      52|             this._intervalId = undefined;
      53|         }
      54|     }
      55|     /**
      56|      * Registers a callback to be executed on every heartbeat tick.
      57|      * @param callback The function to run.
      58|      * @returns A disposable that, when disposed, removes the subscription.
      59|      */
      60|     onTick(callback) {
      61|         this._subscribers.add(callback);
      62|         const disposable = { dispose: () => { this._subscribers.delete(callback); } };
      63|         this._disposables.push(disposable);
      64|         return disposable;
      65|     }
      66|     /** Broadcasts a heartbeat signal (including agent status) to the provided Webview panel. */
      67|     broadcastToWebview(panel) {
      68|         const info = this._agentInfo;
      69|         panel.webview.postMessage({
      70|             type: 'heartbeat-tick',
      71|             agentRunning: info.running,
      72|             agentStep: info.step,
      73|             agentModel: info.model,
      74|             shadowRunning: info.shadowRunning,
      75|             shadowCount: info.shadowCount,
      76|             lastActivity: info.lastActivity,
      77|             elapsedMs: info.running && info.startedAt ? Date.now() - info.startedAt : 0,
      78|         });
      79|     }
      80|     /** Cleans up subscriptions but keeps the interval running (singleton, never truly stopped). */
      81|     dispose() {
      82|         this._agentInfo = { ...DEFAULT_AGENT_INFO };
      83|         this._disposables.forEach((d) => d.dispose());
      84|         this._subscribers.clear();
      85|         this._disposables = [];
      86|     }
      87| }
      88| exports.HeartbeatService = HeartbeatService;

     111| /**
     112|  * 從 CarryoverState 建立（或更新）session notes 內容。
     113|  *
     114|  * 保留既有的「## Task」與「## Errors」sections（追加而非覆蓋），
     115|  * 其餘 sections 每次全量覆寫。
     116|  */
     117| function buildSessionNotes(ctx, existing) {
     118|     const now = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
     119|     const c = ctx.carryover;
     120|     // ── 解析既有筆記中的 Errors 區段（保留歷史） ──
     121|     const existingErrorsMatch = existing.match(/## Errors & Fixes\n([\s\S]*?)(?=\n## |\n# |$)/);
     122|     const existingErrors = existingErrorsMatch ? existingErrorsMatch[1].trim() : '';
     123|     // ── 組裝新 Errors 區段 ──
     124|     const newErrors = (ctx.recentErrors ?? []).map(e => `- ${e.slice(0, 200)}`).join('\n');

     127|     const pendingLine = c.taskGoal ? `**當前目標：** ${c.taskGoal}` : '';
     128|     const worklogLines = c.recentWorkLog.slice(-8).map(w => `- ${w}`).join('\n');
     129|     const currentStateLines = [pendingLine, worklogLines ? `\n**最近執行：**\n${worklogLines}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
     130|     // ── Key Files ──
     131|     const keyFilesLines = [
     132|         ...c.activeArtifacts.slice(-8).map(f => `- ${f}`),
     133|     ].join('\n');
     134|     // ── Verified Work ──
     135|     const verifiedLines = c.verifiedWork.slice(-10).map(w => `- ${w}`).join('\n');
     136|     const notes = [
     137|         `# Session Notes`,
     138|         `_更新時間：${now}（累計工具呼叫 ${ctx.toolCallCount} 次）_`,
     139|         ``,
     140|         `## Task`,
     141|         ctx.taskDescription ? ctx.taskDescription.slice(0, 400) : '_（未記錄）_',
     142|         ``,
     143|         `## Current State`,
     144|         currentStateLines || '_（尚無記錄）_',
     145|         ``,
     146|         `## Key Files`,
     147|         keyFilesLines || '_（尚無記錄）_',
     148|         ``,
     149|         `## Verified Work`,
     150|         verifiedLines || '_（尚無記錄）_',
     151|         ``,
     152|         `## Errors & Fixes`,

     115| async function executeExtractMemories(shortTermText, options = {}) {
     116|     if (!shortTermText || shortTermText.trim().length === 0)
     117|         return null;
     118|     const now = Date.now();

     120|         return null;

     148|                 extractPrompt: prompt,

     150|         }

     152|             lastExtractionTs = Date.now();

     154|         }

     158|         }
     159|         const written = [];

     161|         for (const item of items) {
     162|             if (!memoryTypes_1.MEMORY_TYPE_VALUES.includes(item.type))

     165|             if (!safeSlug)

     171|                 type: item.type,
     172|                 title: item.title.slice(0, 200),
     173|                 tags: item.tags?.slice(0, 10),

     175|                 updated: today,
     176|             };

     183|                 }
     184|                 catch { /* ignore */ }

     190|         lastExtractionTs = Date.now();

     192|     }
     193|     catch {
     194|         return null;
     195|     }
     196|     finally {
     197|         extractionInProgress = false;
     198|     }
     199| }

     222|     try {
     223|         const existingLines = existingIndex.split('\n');
     224|         const seen = new Set();

     414|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamTodoDone', idx: t.index });
     415|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamOrchestratorChunk', chunk: `\n⛔ 任務#${t.index}（${t.task.slice(0, 30)}）因前置任務未完成而跳過。\n` });
     416|                 }
     417|                 if (this._teamCancel) {
     418|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamEnd' });
     419|                     return;
     420|                 }
     421|                 let tSynthResult = '';

     424|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamSynthStart' });

     438|                     await this._callbacks.executeAgent(`根據以下團隊討論結論，立即執行必要操作來完成使用者的任務。\n\n${wsContext}\n\n【原始任務】\n${prompt}\n\n【團隊綜合結論】\n${tSynthResult}\n\n【強制規則】\n- 訊息中出現 Jira Key（如 UOEM2-3476）→ 立即呼叫 jira_fetch，禁止說「我將查詢」。\n- 需要理解工作區代碼 → 立即呼叫 read_file / search_workspace，禁止假設內容。\n- 看到任務就執行工具，不得宣告意圖後停止。\n\n請逐步執行。`, tAgentModel, false);
     439|                 }
     440|             }
     441|         }
     442|     }
     443|     static pickThinkingModel(models) {
     444|         if (models.length === 0) {
     445|             return '';
     446|         }
     447|         const RANK = [/deepseek-r1/i, /qwq/i, /r1/i, /thinking/i, /reasoner/i, /reflect/i];
     448|         let best = models[0];
     449|         let bestScore = -1;
     450|         for (const m of models) {
     451|             const score = RANK.findIndex(r => r.test(m));
     452|             const s = score === -1 ? RANK.length : score;
     453|             if (bestScore === -1 || s < bestScore) {
     454|                 bestScore = s;
     455|                 best = m;
     456|             }
     457|         }
     458|         return best;
     459|     }
     460|     static buildRoleSystemNote(role) {
     461|         const configured = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw').get('teamRoles', []);
     462|         const found = configured.find(r => r.key === role);
     463|         if (found?.systemPrompt)
     464|             return found.systemPrompt;
     465|         switch (role) {
     466|             case 'planner': return '你的職責是【規劃者】：分析需求、制定解題架構、將任務拆分為有序步驟、確保整體方向正確。';
     467|             case 'developer': return '你的職責是【開發者】：撰寫程式碼、實作功能、提供具體技術解決方案、確保程式邏輯正確。';
     468|             case 'reviewer': return '你的職責是【評審員】：審查方案與程式碼品質、找出潛在問題與改進空間、以批判視角提高整體品質。';
     469|             case 'tester': return '你的職責是【測試員】：思考邊界情況、撰寫測試案例、找出可能的錯誤與漏洞、確保功能穩定性。';
     470|             case 'writer': return '你的職責是【撰寫者】：清晰解釋技術概念、撰寫說明文件、確保溝通明確易懂。';
     471|             default: return '';
     472|         }
     473|     }
     474|     async _handleTeamDiscussion(prompt, allModels, maxRounds, roles) {
     475|         const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     476|         const urls = this._services.getOllamaUrls(cfg);
     477|         const COLORS = TeamShared_1.TEAM_COLORS;

     479|         const _rolesCfg = cfg.get('teamRoles', []);
     480|         const _rolePrefix = (idx) => { const k = roles?.[idx]; const r = k ? _rolesCfg.find(c => c.key === k) : undefined; return r ? `${r.emoji} ${r.label} ` : ''; };
     481|         // 決定主管：優先 'manager' 角色 → Copilot 模型 → index 0
     482|         const managerIdx = (() => {
     483|             const mgrRoleIdx = roles ? roles.findIndex(r => r === 'manager') : -1;

     485|                 return mgrRoleIdx;

     487|             if (cpIdx >= 0)
     488|                 return cpIdx;
     489|             return 0;
     490|         })();
     491|         const managerModel = allModels[managerIdx];
     492|         const workerModels = allModels.filter((_, i) => i !== managerIdx);
     493|         // 若只有一個模型，它同時擔任主管與唯一 worker
     494|         const effectiveWorkers = workerModels.length > 0 ? workerModels : allModels;
     495|         const managerDisplay = _rolePrefix(managerIdx) + getDisplay(managerModel);

    1461|     async runWorkerDiscussion(workerModel, reviewFn, baseUrl, assignedTask, id, color, maxRounds = 100, ollamaCall) {
    1462|         const isCopilot = workerModel.startsWith('copilot/') || workerModel.startsWith('copilot::');
    1463|         const workerFamily = workerModel.startsWith('copilot::') ? workerModel.slice('copilot::'.length) : workerModel.startsWith('copilot/') ? workerModel.slice('copilot/'.length) : workerModel;
    1464|         const callOllama = ollamaCall ?? this._services.ollamaGenerateStream.bind(null, baseUrl);
    1465|         let currentPrompt = assignedTask;
    1466|         let lastResponse = '';
    1467|         for (let round = 0; round < maxRounds && !this._teamCancel; round++) {
    1468|             this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamRoundStart', id, round });

    1470|                 lastResponse = await this.copilotStream(workerFamily, currentPrompt, (chunk) => { if (!this._teamCancel)
    1471|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamResponseChunk', id, chunk }); });
    1472|             }
    1473|             else {
    1474|                 let thinkBuf = '';
    1475|                 let thinkTimer = null;

    1477|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamThinkChunk', id, color, chunk: thinkBuf });
    1478|                     thinkBuf = '';
    1479|                 } thinkTimer = null; };
    1480|                 lastResponse = await callOllama(workerModel, currentPrompt, (chunk) => { if (!this._teamCancel)
    1481|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamResponseChunk', id, chunk }); }, (tc) => { if (!this._teamCancel) {
    1482|                     thinkBuf += tc;

    1484|                         thinkTimer = setTimeout(flushThink, 80);
    1485|                 } });
    1486|                 if (thinkTimer) {
    1487|                     clearTimeout(thinkTimer);
    1488|                 }
    1489|                 flushThink();
    1490|             }
    1491|             if (this._teamCancel || round === maxRounds - 1) {
    1492|                 this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamRoundDone', id, approved: true });
    1493|                 break;
    1494|             }
    1495|             this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamRoundReviewStart', id });
    1496|             const reviewPrompt = `你是 AI 協調員，正在指導一個工作助手.
    1497| 
    1498| 【分配的任務】
    1499| ${assignedTask}
    1500|

    1502| ${lastResponse}
    1503| 
    1504| 請單就回覆品質做出判斷：
    1505| - 若已達到最優解或內容足夠完整，就只回覆：[APPROVED]
    1506| - 若需改進，給出一句具體的改進指示（不超過 60 字，繁體中文）：`;
    1507|             let reviewText = '';
    1508|             try {
    1509|                 reviewText = await reviewFn(reviewPrompt, (chunk) => { if (!this._teamCancel)
    1510|                     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamRoundReviewChunk', id, chunk }); });

    1530|     async copilotStream(modelFamily, prompt, onChunk) {
    1531|         const [model] = await vscode.lm.selectChatModels({ vendor: 'copilot', family: modelFamily });
    1532|         if (!model) {
    1533|             throw new Error(`Copilot 模型 "${modelFamily}" 不可用，請確認 GitHub Copilot 已安裝並登入`);
    1534|         }
    1535|         const cts = new vscode.CancellationTokenSource();
    1536|         const cancelInterval = setInterval(() => { if (this._teamCancel) {
    1537|             cts.cancel();
    1538|         } }, 200);
    1539|         try {
    1540|             const response = await model.sendRequest([vscode.LanguageModelChatMessage.User(prompt)], {}, cts.token);
    1541|             let fullText = '';
    1542|             for await (const part of response.stream) {
    1543|                 if (this._teamCancel) {
    1544|                     break;
    1545|                 }
    1546|                 if (part instanceof vscode.LanguageModelTextPart) {
    1547|                     fullText += part.value;
    1548|                     onChunk(part.value);
    1549|                 }
    1550|             }
    1551|             return fullText;
    1552|         }
    1553|         finally {
    1554|             clearInterval(cancelInterval);
    1555|             cts.dispose();
    1556|         }
    1557|     }

      75| async function scanWorkspaceForTeam() {
      76|     const wsFolders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
      77|     const wsRoot = wsFolders.length > 0 ? wsFolders[0].uri.fsPath : process.cwd();
      78|     const teamsCtxPath = path.join(wsRoot, 'teamscontext.md');

      82|         teamsCtxContent = Buffer.from(tcBytes).toString('utf-8').trim();
      83|     }

      86|     allUris.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.localeCompare(b.fsPath));
      87|     const filteredUris = allUris.filter(uri => !SKIP_EXT.has(path.extname(uri.fsPath).toLowerCase()));
      88|     const allRelPaths = filteredUris.map(uri => path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
      89|     const fileListBlock = `【工作區檔案清單（${allRelPaths.length} 個）】\n${allRelPaths.map(p => `  - ${p}`).join('\n')}`;
      90|     const batches = [];
      91|     let curBatch = [];
      92|     let curBatchBytes = 0;
      93|     let totalBytes = 0;
      94|     for (const uri of filteredUris) {
      95|         const rel = path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
      96|         try {
      97|             const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
      98|             let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf-8');
      99|             if (text.length > MAX_FILE) {
     100|                 text = text.slice(0, MAX_FILE) + `\n...（${rel} 已截斷，僅顯示前段）`;
     101|             }
     102|             const entry = `### ${rel}\n\`\`\`\n${text}\n\`\`\``;
     103|             if (curBatchBytes + entry.length > BATCH_SIZE && curBatch.length > 0) {
     104|                 batches.push(curBatch);
     105|                 curBatch = [];
     106|                 curBatchBytes = 0;
     107|             }
     108|             curBatch.push(entry);
     109|             curBatchBytes += entry.length;
     110|             totalBytes += text.length;
     111|         }
     112|         catch { /* 略過無法讀取的二進位檔 */ }
     113|     }
     114|     if (curBatch.length > 0)
     115|         batches.push(curBatch);
     116|     const readCount = batches.reduce((s, b) => s + b.length, 0);
     117|     const baseCtx = [
     118|         `【工作區路徑】${wsRoot}`,
     119|         teamsCtxContent ? `【teamscontext.md — 先前討論紀錄】\n${teamsCtxContent}` : '',
     120|         fileListBlock,
     121|     ].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
     122|     return { wsRoot, teamsCtxPath, teamsCtxContent, allRelPaths, batches, totalBytes, readCount, baseCtx };
     123| }
     124| /**
     125|  * 把掃描結果組裝成「逐批餵碼」的多輪對話歷史。
     126|  *   - 有批次：user(baseCtx+第1批) → assistant(已讀第N批) → user(第N+1批) → … → assistant(已讀完。{finalPrompt})
     127|  *   - 無批次且提供 emptyFallbackAssistant：user(baseCtx) → assistant(emptyFallbackAssistant)
     128|  *   - 無批次且未提供 fallback：回傳空陣列（manager 模式行為）
     129|  *
     130|  * @param finalPrompt 讀完後 assistant 收尾語（discussion="請提出問題。" / manager="請提出任務。"）
     131|  * @param emptyFallbackAssistant 無批次時的 assistant 回覆（僅 discussion 提供）
     132|  */
     133| function buildBatchedInitHistory(scan, finalPrompt, emptyFallbackAssistant) {
     134|     const { baseCtx, batches, allRelPaths, totalBytes } = scan;
     135|     const hist = [];
     136|     if (batches.length > 0) {
     137|         hist.push({ role: 'user', content: `${baseCtx}\n\n【第 1/${batches.length} 批原始碼（${batches[0].length} 個檔案）】\n\n${batches[0].join('\n\n')}`
     138|         });
     139|         for (let bi = 1; bi < batches.length; bi++) {
     140|             hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: `已閱讀第 ${bi}/${batches.length} 批（${batches[bi - 1].length} 個檔案），繼續接收下一批。` });
     141|             hist.push({ role: 'user', content: `【第 ${bi + 1}/${batches.length} 批原始碼（${batches[bi].length} 個檔案）】\n\n${batches[bi].join('\n\n')}`
     142|             });
     143|         }
     144|         hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: `已完整閱讀全部 ${batches.length} 批共 ${allRelPaths.length} 個檔案（${Math.round(totalBytes / 1024)}KB）。${finalPrompt}` });
     145|     }
     146|     else if (emptyFallbackAssistant !== undefined) {
     147|         hist.push({ role: 'user', content: baseCtx });
     148|         hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: emptyFallbackAssistant });
     149|     }
     150|     return hist;
     151| }

       9| class ToolCache {
      10|     constructor(_ttlMs = 30000) {
      11|         this._ttlMs = _ttlMs;
      12|         this._map = new Map();
      13|     }
      14|     get(key) {
      15|         const entry = this._map.get(key);
      16|         if (!entry) {
      17|             return undefined;
      18|         }
      19|         if (Date.now() - entry.ts > this._ttlMs) {
      20|             this._map.delete(key);
      21|             return undefined;
      22|         }
      23|         return entry.value;
      24|     }
      25|     set(key, value) {
      26|         this._map.set(key, { value, ts: Date.now() });
      27|     }
      28|     delete(key) {
      29|         this._map.delete(key);
      30|     }
      31|     clear() {
      32|         this._map.clear();
      33|     }

      65| // ─── Unified Diff helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      66| function computeUnifiedDiff(aLines, bLines, fileA, fileB, contextLines) {
      67|     // 簡易 LCS-based unified diff
      68|     const m = aLines.length, n = bLines.length;
      69|     // DP LCS table (只存長度，用回溯)
      70|     const dp = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => new Array(n + 1).fill(0));
      71|     for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
      72|         for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      73|             if (aLines[i - 1] === bLines[j - 1]) {
      74|                 dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
      75|             }
      76|             else {
      77|                 dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
      78|             }
      79|         }
      80|     }
      81|     const edits = [];
      82|     let i = m, j = n;
      83|     while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
      84|         if (i > 0 && j > 0 && aLines[i - 1] === bLines[j - 1]) {
      85|             edits.push({ op: ' ', line: aLines[i - 1], ai: i, bi: j });
      86|             i--;
      87|             j--;
      88|         }
      89|         else if (j > 0 && (i === 0 || dp[i][j - 1] >= dp[i - 1][j])) {
      90|             edits.push({ op: '+', line: bLines[j - 1], ai: i, bi: j });
      91|             j--;
      92|         }
      93|         else {
      94|             edits.push({ op: '-', line: aLines[i - 1], ai: i, bi: j });
      95|             i--;
      96|         }
      97|     }
      98|     edits.reverse();
      99|     // Build hunks
     100|     const changed = new Set(edits.map((e, idx) => e.op !== ' ' ? idx : -1).filter(x => x >= 0));
     101|     if (changed.size === 0) {
     102|         return '';
     103|     }
     104|     const inHunk = new Set();
     105|     for (const c of changed) {
     106|         for (let k = Math.max(0, c - contextLines); k <= Math.min(edits.length - 1, c + contextLines); k++) {
     107|             inHunk.add(k);
     108|         }
     109|     }
     110|     const lines = [`--- ${fileA}`, `+++ ${fileB}`];
     111|     let inBlock = false, aStart = 0, bStart = 0, aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
     112|     const hunkLines = [];
     113|     const flushHunk = () => {
     114|         if (hunkLines.length) {
     115|             lines.push(`@@ -${aStart},${aCount} +${bStart},${bCount} @@`);
     116|             lines.push(...hunkLines);
     117|             hunkLines.length = 0;
     118|             inBlock = false;
     119|         }
     120|     };
     121|     let aIdx = 1, bIdx = 1;
     122|     for (let k = 0; k < edits.length; k++) {
     123|         const e = edits[k];
     124|         if (inHunk.has(k)) {
     125|             if (!inBlock) {
     126|                 flushHunk();
     127|                 aStart = e.op === '+' ? aIdx : aIdx;
     128|                 bStart = e.op === '-' ? bIdx : bIdx;
     129|                 aCount = 0;
     130|                 bCount = 0;
     131|                 inBlock = true;
     132|             }
     133|             hunkLines.push(e.op + e.line);
     134|             if (e.op !== '+') {
     135|                 aCount++;
     136|                 aIdx++;
     137|             }
     138|             if (e.op !== '-') {
     139|                 bCount++;
     140|                 bIdx++;
     141|             }
     142|         }
     143|         else {
     144|             if (inBlock) {
     145|                 flushHunk();
     146|             }
     147|             if (e.op !== '+') {
     148|                 aIdx++;
     149|             }
     150|             if (e.op !== '-') {
     151|                 bIdx++;
     152|             }
     153|         }
     154|     }
     155|     flushHunk();
     156|     return lines.join('\n');
     157| }

     159| function computeDiffStatsAndPatch(before, after, filePath, maxPatchBytes = 6000) {
     160|     const aLines = before.split(/\r?\n/);
     161|     const bLines = after.split(/\r?\n/);
     162|     // 大檔案略過全 diff（LCS O(m*n) 太慢），只回傳行數差
     163|     if (aLines.length + bLines.length > 4000) {
     164|         return { linesAdded: Math.max(0, bLines.length - aLines.length), linesRemoved: Math.max(0, aLines.length - bLines.length), patch: '' };

     305|     static collectImageFiles(rootDir, limit) {
