     350|             let url;
     351|             try {
     352|                 url = new url_1.URL('/api/chat', baseUrl);
     353|             }
     354|             catch {
     355|                 reject(new Error(`Ollama URL 無效: ${baseUrl}`));
     356|                 return;
     357|             }
     358|             const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
     359|             const buf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
     360|                 model,
     361|                 messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt, images: imagesB64 }],
     362|                 stream: false,
     363|                 options: { temperature: 0 },
     364|             }), 'utf8');
     365|             const options = {
     366|                 hostname: url.hostname,
     367|                 port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
     368|                 path: url.pathname,
     369|                 method: 'POST',
     370|                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': buf.length },
     371|             };
     372|             const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
     373|                 let data = '';
     374|                 res.setEncoding('utf8');
     375|                 res.on('data', (d) => { data += d; });
     376|                 res.on('end', () => {
     377|                     try {
     378|                         const j = JSON.parse(data);
     379|                         if (j.error) {
     380|                             reject(new Error(j.error));
     381|                             return;
     382|                         }
     383|                         resolve((j.message?.content ?? '').trim());
     384|                     }
     385|                     catch {
     386|                         reject(new Error(`回應解析失敗: ${data.slice(0, 200)}`));
     387|                     }
     388|                 });
     389|             });
     390|             req.on('error', (e) => reject(e));
     391|             req.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => { req.destroy(); reject(new Error(`Ollama 視覺推論逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`)); });
     392|             req.write(buf);
     393|             req.end();
     394|         });
     395|     }
     396|     /** 從模型回應中擷取第一個 JSON 物件並解析（容忍 markdown code fence 與前後雜訊）。 */
     397|     static extractFirstJson(text) {
     398|         if (!text) {
     399|             return null;
     400|         }
     401|         const fenced = text.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
     402|         const candidate = fenced ? fenced[1] : text;
     403|         const start = candidate.indexOf('{');
     404|         const end = candidate.lastIndexOf('}');
     405|         if (start < 0 || end <= start) {
     406|             return null;
     407|         }
     408|         try {
     409|             return JSON.parse(candidate.slice(start, end + 1));
     410|         }
     411|         catch {
     412|             return null;
     413|         }
     414|     }
     415|     /** 從 atlassian.atlascode 擷取 Jira auth (bearer token + baseApiUrl)。
     416|      *  只支援 Windows，使用 Python (內建模組) + Node.js crypto 解密。
     417|      *  cache：到期前 5 分鐘更新。
     418|      */
     419|     async getAtlascodeJiraAuth() {
     420|         if (this._atlasJiraCred && this._atlasJiraCred.expiry > Date.now() + 300000) {
     421|             return this._atlasJiraCred;
     422|         }
     423|         try {
     424|             const appData = process.env['APPDATA'];
     425|             if (!appData) {
     426|                 return null;
     427|             }
     428|             const localStatePath = path.join(appData, 'Code', 'Local State');
     429|             if (!fs.existsSync(localStatePath)) {
     430|                 return null;
     431|             }
     432|             // Python 腳本：使用內建模組讀 SQLite + DPAPI 解密 master key，輸出 JSON
     433|             // 路徑用 JSON.stringify 嵌入：Python 解析 "C:\\Users\\..." = C:\Users\... (正確)
     434|             const pyScript = [
     435|                 'import sqlite3,json,ctypes,base64,os,sys',
     436|                 `app=${JSON.stringify(appData)}`,
     437|                 `db=os.path.join(app,'Code','User','globalStorage','state.vscdb')`,
     438|                 `ls_path=os.path.join(app,'Code','Local State')`,
     439|                 'with open(ls_path,encoding="utf-8") as f: ls=json.load(f)',
     440|                 'enc=base64.b64decode(ls["os_crypt"]["encrypted_key"])[5:]',
     441|                 'class B(ctypes.Structure): _fields_=[("n",ctypes.c_ulong),("p",ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char))]',
     442|                 'i=(ctypes.c_char*len(enc))(*enc); ib=B(len(enc),i); ob=B()',
     443|                 'ok=ctypes.windll.crypt32.CryptUnprotectData(ctypes.byref(ib),None,None,None,None,0,ctypes.byref(ob))',
     444|                 'if not ok: print(json.dumps({"error":"dpapi"})); sys.exit(1)',
     445|                 'mk=list(ctypes.string_at(ob.p,ob.n)); ctypes.windll.kernel32.LocalFree(ob.p)',
     446|                 'c=sqlite3.connect(db)',
     447|                 // 嘗試多個 key 名稱，相容舊版 (v2.x) 與新版 (v3+) atlascode
     448|                 'def find_sites(c):',
     449|                 '    for k in ["atlassian.atlascode","atlassian.atlascode.v2","atlascode"]:',
     450|                 '        r=c.execute("SELECT value FROM ItemTable WHERE key=?",[k]).fetchone()',
     451|                 '        if not r: continue',
     452|                 '        d=json.loads(r[0])',
     453|                 '        if isinstance(d,list) and d and isinstance(d[0],dict) and "baseApiUrl" in d[0]: return d',
     454|                 '        if isinstance(d,dict):',
     455|                 '            for fld in ["jiraSites","jiraCloudSites","sites"]:',
     456|                 '                lst=d.get(fld)',
     457|                 '                if lst and isinstance(lst,list): return lst',
     458|                 '    # 廣播搜尋包含 atlascode 的所有 key',
     459|                 '    rows=c.execute("SELECT key,value FROM ItemTable WHERE key LIKE ?",["atlassian%"]).fetchall()',
     460|                 '    for _,v in rows:',
     461|                 '        try:',
     462|                 '            d=json.loads(v)',
     463|                 '            for fld in ["jiraSites","jiraCloudSites","sites"]:',
     464|                 '                lst=d.get(fld,[]) if isinstance(d,dict) else []',
     465|                 '                if lst and isinstance(lst[0],dict) and "baseApiUrl" in lst[0]: return lst',
     466|                 '        except: pass',
     467|                 '    return []',
     468|                 'sites=find_sites(c)',
     469|                 'if not sites: print(json.dumps({"error":"no_sites"})); sys.exit(1)',
     470|                 's=sites[0]',
     471|                 'cred_id=s.get("credentialId","")',
     472|                 'if not cred_id: print(json.dumps({"error":"no_cred_id"})); sys.exit(1)',
     473|                 'ck=\'secret://{"extensionId":"atlassian.atlascode","key":"jira-\'+cred_id+\'"}\'',
     474|                 'er=c.execute("SELECT value FROM ItemTable WHERE key=?",[ck]).fetchone(); c.close()',
     475|                 'if not er: print(json.dumps({"error":"no_cred"})); sys.exit(1)',
     476|                 'ed=json.loads(er[0])',
     477|                 'print(json.dumps({"mk":mk,"buf":ed["data"],"baseApiUrl":s["baseApiUrl"],"host":s.get("host","")}))',
     478|             ].join('\n');
     479|             // 寫入 temp file 執行，避免 Windows stdin pipe hang 問題
     480|             // 嘗試 py (Windows Launcher) → python → python3
     481|             const tmpPy = path.join(appData, 'ami-atlas-auth-tmp.py');
     482|             fs.writeFileSync(tmpPy, pyScript, 'utf-8');
     483|             let raw = '';
     484|             let lastErr;
     485|             const pythonCmds = process.platform === 'win32' ? ['py', 'python'] : ['python3', 'python'];
     486|             try {
     487|                 for (const cmd of pythonCmds) {
     488|                     try {
     489|                         raw = (0, child_process_1.execSync)(`${cmd} "${tmpPy}"`, { encoding: 'utf-8', timeout: 12000 }).trim();
     490|                         lastErr = undefined;
     491|                         break;
     492|                     }
     493|                     catch (e) {
     494|                         lastErr = e;
     495|                     }
     496|                 }
     497|                 if (lastErr) {
     498|                     throw lastErr;
     499|                 }
     500|             }
     501|             finally {
     502|                 try {
     503|                     fs.unlinkSync(tmpPy);
     504|                 }
     505|                 catch { /* ignore */ }
     506|             }
     507|             const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
     508|             if (parsed.error || !parsed.mk || !parsed.buf || !parsed.baseApiUrl) {
     509|                 this._callbacks.log(`atlascode auth: ${parsed.error ?? 'missing fields'}`);
     510|                 return null;
     511|             }
     512|             // AES-256-GCM 解密：v10(3) + nonce(12) + ciphertext + tag(16)
     513|             const masterKey = Buffer.from(parsed.mk);
     514|             const buf = Buffer.from(parsed.buf);
     515|             const nonce = buf.slice(3, 15);
     516|             const ciphertext = buf.slice(15, buf.length - 16);
     517|             const tag = buf.slice(buf.length - 16);
     518|             const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', masterKey, nonce);
     519|             decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
     520|             const plain = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(ciphertext), decipher.final()]);
     521|             const cred = JSON.parse(plain.toString('utf-8'));
     522|             if (!cred.access) {
     523|                 return null;
     524|             }
     525|             // 解析 JWT expiry
     526|             let expiry = Date.now() + 3600000; // 預設 1h
     527|             try {
     528|                 const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cred.access.split('.')[1], 'base64').toString('utf-8'));
     529|                 if (payload.exp) {
     530|                     expiry = payload.exp * 1000;
     531|                 }
     532|             }
     533|             catch { /* ignore */ }
     534|             this._atlasJiraCred = { baseApiUrl: parsed.baseApiUrl, accessToken: cred.access, expiry };
     535|             return this._atlasJiraCred;
     536|         }
     537|         catch (e) {
     538|             this._callbacks.log(`getAtlascodeJiraAuth error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
     539|             return null;
     540|         }
     541|     }
     542|     /** 探索 Rovo Dev 本地 HTTP server (127.0.0.1:{port})，優先讀 env var，否則掃描 Windows 程序表。
     543|      *  正向結果快取 5 分鐘；負向結果快取 30 秒。*/
     544|     async discoverRovoDevUrl() {
     545|         if (this._rovoDevCache && Date.now() < this._rovoDevCache.expiry) {
     546|             return { url: this._rovoDevCache.url, token: this._rovoDevCache.token };
     547|         }
     548|         if (!this._rovoDevCache && Date.now() < this._rovoDevNullUntil) {
     549|             return null;
     550|         }
     551|         const envToken = process.env['ROVODEV_SERVE_SESSION_TOKEN'] ?? '';
     552|         const tryUrl = async (url) => {
     553|             return new Promise(resolve => {
     554|                 try {
     555|                     const u = new url_1.URL('/healthcheck', url);
     556|                     const headers = envToken ? { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${envToken}` } : {};
     557|                     const req = http.request({ hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'), path: u.pathname, method: 'GET', headers }, res => {
     558|                         res.resume();
     559|                         resolve(res.statusCode === 200);
     560|                     });
     561|                     req.on('error', () => resolve(false));
     562|                     req.setTimeout(2000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(false); });
     563|                     req.end();
     564|                 }
     565|                 catch {
     566|                     resolve(false);
     567|                 }
     568|             });
     569|         };
     570|         // 1. Env var (Boysenberry mode)
     571|         const envPort = process.env['ROVODEV_PORT'];
     572|         if (envPort && /^\d+$/.test(envPort)) {
     573|             const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${envPort}`;
     574|             if (await tryUrl(url)) {
     575|                 this._rovoDevCache = { url, token: envToken, expiry: Date.now() + 5 * 60000 };
     576|                 return { url, token: envToken };
     577|             }
     578|         }
     579|         // 2. Windows: find atlassian_cli_rovodev.exe port via tasklist + netstat
     580|         if (process.platform === 'win32') {
     581|             const port = this.findRovoDevPortWindows();
     582|             if (port) {
     583|                 const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
     584|                 if (await tryUrl(url)) {
     585|                     this._rovoDevCache = { url, token: envToken, expiry: Date.now() + 5 * 60000 };
     586|                     return { url, token: envToken };
     587|                 }
     588|             }
     589|         }
     590|         this._rovoDevCache = undefined;
     591|         this._rovoDevNullUntil = Date.now() + 30000;
     592|         return null;
     593|     }
     594|     /** 用 tasklist + netstat 同步取得 Rovo Dev 監聽 port (Windows)。*/
     595|     findRovoDevPortWindows() {
     596|         try {
     597|             const taskOut = (0, child_process_1.execSync)('tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq atlassian_cli_rovodev.exe" /FO CSV /NH 2>nul', { shell: 'cmd.exe', timeout: 3000, windowsHide: true }).toString();
     598|             const pidMatch = taskOut.match(/"atlassian_cli_rovodev\.exe","(\d+)"/);
     599|             if (!pidMatch)
     600|                 return null;
     601|             const pid = pidMatch[1];
     602|             const netOut = (0, child_process_1.execSync)('netstat -ano 2>nul | findstr " LISTENING"', { shell: 'cmd.exe', timeout: 5000, windowsHide: true }).toString();
     603|             for (const line of netOut.split('\n')) {
     604|                 if (!line.trimEnd().endsWith(pid)) {
     605|                     continue;
     606|                 }
     607|                 const m = line.match(/127\.0\.0\.1:(\d+)/);
     608|                 if (!m) {
     609|                     continue;
     610|                 }
     611|                 const p = parseInt(m[1]);
     612|                 if (p >= 40000 && p <= 41000) {
     613|                     return String(p);
     614|                 }
     615|             }
     616|             return null;
     617|         }
     618|         catch {
     619|             return null;
     620|         }
     621|     }
     622|     /** 向 Rovo Dev 本地 HTTP server 提問並以 SSE stream 收集文字回覆。
     623|      *  回傳 AI 回覆文字，若無法連線則回傳 null。*/
     624|     async callRovoDevApi(question) {
     625|         const target = await this.discoverRovoDevUrl();
     626|         if (!target) {
     627|             return null;
     628|         }
     629|         const { url, token } = target;
     630|         const reqHeaders = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'accept': 'text/event-stream' };
     631|         if (token) {
     632|             reqHeaders['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
     633|         }
     634|         // Step 1: POST /v3/set_chat_message
     635|         const body = JSON.stringify({ message: question, context: [] });
     636|         const step1Ok = await new Promise(resolve => {
     637|             try {
     638|                 const u = new url_1.URL('/v3/set_chat_message', url);
     639|                 const req = http.request({
     640|                     hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'),
     641|                     path: u.pathname, method: 'POST',
     642|                     headers: { ...reqHeaders, 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
     643|                 }, res => { res.resume(); resolve(res.statusCode !== undefined && res.statusCode < 400); });
     644|                 req.on('error', () => resolve(false));
     645|                 req.setTimeout(10000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(false); });
     646|                 req.write(body);
     647|                 req.end();
     648|             }
     649|             catch {
     650|                 resolve(false);
     651|             }
     652|         });
     653|         if (!step1Ok) {
     654|             // Auth || connection failed – invalidate cache so we re-discover next time
     655|             this._rovoDevCache = undefined;
     656|             this._rovoDevNullUntil = 0;
     657|             return null;
     658|         }
     659|         // Step 2: GET /v3/stream_chat (SSE) and collect text parts
     660|         return new Promise(resolve => {
     661|             try {
     662|                 const u = new url_1.URL('/v3/stream_chat?pause_on_call_tools_start=false&enable_deferred_tools=true', url);
     663|                 const req = http.request({
     664|                     hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'),
     665|                     path: u.pathname + u.search, method: 'GET',
     666|                     headers: reqHeaders,
     667|                 }, res => {
     668|                     if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
     669|                         res.resume();
     670|                         resolve(null);
     671|                         return;
     672|                     }
     673|                     let sseBuffer = '';
     674|                     const parts = [];
     675|                     res.on('data', (chunk) => {
     676|                         sseBuffer += chunk.toString('utf8');
     677|                         const blocks = sseBuffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/g);
     678|                         sseBuffer = blocks.pop() ?? '';
     679|                         for (const block of blocks) {
     680|                             if (block.startsWith(': ping')) {
     681|                                 continue;
     682|                             }
     683|                             const m = block.match(/^event: ([^\r\n]+)\r?\ndata: ([\s\S]*)$/);
     684|                             if (!m) {
     685|                                 continue;
     686|                             }
     687|                             const kind = m[1].trim();
     688|                             let data = {};
     689|                             try {
     690|                                 data = JSON.parse(m[2]);
     691|                             }
     692|                             catch {
     693|                                 continue;
     694|                             }
     695|                             if (kind === 'text') {
     696|                                 const c = (data['content'] ?? data['content_delta'] ?? '');
     697|                                 if (c) {
     698|                                     parts.push(c);
     699|                                 }
     700|                             }
     701|                             else if (kind === 'part_start') {
     702|                                 const part = (data['part'] ?? {});
     703|                                 if (part['part_kind'] === 'text' && part['content']) {
     704|                                     parts.push(part['content']);
     705|                                 }
     706|                             }
     707|                             else if (kind === 'part_delta') {
     708|                                 const delta = (data['delta'] ?? {});
     709|                                 if (delta['part_delta_kind'] === 'text' && delta['content_delta']) {
     710|                                     parts.push(delta['content_delta']);
     711|                                 }
     712|                             }
     713|                         }
     714|                     });
     715|                     res.on('end', () => { resolve(parts.join('').trim() || null); });
     716|                     res.on('error', () => resolve(null));
     717|                 });
     718|                 req.on('error', () => resolve(null));
     719|                 req.setTimeout(60000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(null); });
     720|                 req.end();
     721|             }
     722|             catch {
     723|                 resolve(null);
     724|             }
     725|         });
     726|     }
     727|     async executeTool(name, args) {
     728|         // 工具名稱正規化：將常見替代名稱映射至正式名稱
     729|         const resolved = ToolExecutor.TOOL_ALIASES[name] ?? name;
     730|         if (resolved !== name) {
     731|             this._callbacks.log(`executeTool: alias "${name}" → "${resolved}"`);
     732|             return this.executeTool(resolved, args);
     733|         }
     734|         const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
     735|         const wsRoot = folders[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? '';
     736|         const resolvePath = (p) => {
     737|             if (!p) {
     738|                 return wsRoot;
     739|             }
     740|             if (path.isAbsolute(p)) {
     741|                 return p;
     742|             }
     743|             // Check if the relative path exists under any workspace folder
     744|             for (const f of folders) {
     745|                 const candidate = path.join(f.uri.fsPath, p);
     746|                 // Return first folder that contains the relative prefix
     747|                 const rel = p.split(/[\\/]/)[0];
     748|                 if (rel) {
     749|                     try {
     750|                         require('fs').accessSync(path.join(f.uri.fsPath, rel));
     751|                         return candidate;
     752|                     }
     753|                     catch { /* try next */ }
     754|                 }
     755|             }
     756|             return path.join(wsRoot, p);
     757|         };
     758|         /**
     759|          * 三層優先順序路徑解析：
     760|          *  1. 絕對路徑 / 相對路徑（存在於磁碟）→ 直接使用
     761|          *  2. 找不到 → 查 VS Code 已開啟的 openTextDocuments（basename 或 相對路徑 suffix 比對）
     762|          *  3. 還找不到 → workspace.findFiles 在整個工作區搜尋
     763|          */
     764|         const resolvePathWithPriority = async (raw) => {
     765|             if (!raw) {
     766|                 return wsRoot;
     767|             }
     768|             // ① 絕對路徑直接用
     769|             if (path.isAbsolute(raw)) {
     770|                 try {
     771|                     require('fs').accessSync(raw);
     772|                     return raw;
     773|                 }
     774|                 catch { /* fall through */ }
     775|             }
     776|             // ① 相對路徑：先嘗試 workspace folder 解析
     777|             const candidate = resolvePath(raw);
     778|             try {
     779|                 require('fs').accessSync(candidate);
     780|                 return candidate;
     781|             }
     782|             catch { /* not on disk */ }
     783|             // ② 已開啟的 editor documents（不須在磁碟，可能是 untitled 或虛擬 FS）
     784|             const rawBase = path.basename(raw).toLowerCase();
     785|             const rawNorm = raw.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
     786|             for (const doc of vscode.workspace.textDocuments) {
     787|                 const docPath = doc.uri.fsPath;
     788|                 const docNorm = docPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
     789|                 if (docNorm.endsWith(rawNorm) || path.basename(docPath).toLowerCase() === rawBase) {
     790|                     return docPath;
     791|                 }
     792|             }
     793|             // ③ workspace.findFiles 搜全工作區
     794|             try {
     795|                 // 先嘗試精確 glob（保留原始路徑結構）
     796|                 const exactGlob = `**/${raw.replace(/\\/g, '/')}`;
     797|                 const found = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(exactGlob, '**/node_modules/**', 5);
     798|                 if (found.length > 0) {
     799|                     // 若多個結果，優先選最短路徑（最靠近根目錄）
     800|                     found.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.length - b.fsPath.length);
     801|                     return found[0].fsPath;
     802|                 }
     803|                 // basename glob fallback
     804|                 const baseGlob = `**/${rawBase}`;
     805|                 const found2 = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(baseGlob, '**/node_modules/**', 5);
     806|                 if (found2.length > 0) {
     807|                     found2.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.length - b.fsPath.length);
     808|                     return found2[0].fsPath;
     809|                 }
     810|             }
     811|             catch { /* ignore findFiles error */ }
     812|             // fallback：回傳原始 resolvePath 結果（讓呼叫端的 stat 報「找不到」）
     813|             return candidate;
     814|         };
     815|         // Shadow 路由分流：若 args.mode==='shadow' 或影子模式已啟動，將寫入類工具導入暗存區
     816|         const _isShadowCall = args['mode'] === 'shadow';
     817|         const _isSandboxActive = this._sandbox.isActive();
     818|         if ((_isShadowCall || _isSandboxActive) && SandboxManager_1.SHADOW_WRITE_TOOLS.has(name)) {
     819|             if (!this._sandbox.isActive()) {
     820|                 this._sandbox.initShadow(Date.now().toString(36));
     821|             }
     822|             const shadowArgs = this._sandbox.remapArgs(name, args);
     823|             const provider = this._providerMap.get(name);
     824|             if (provider) {
     825|                 const ctx = {
     826|                     callbacks: this._callbacks,
     827|                     cache: this._cache,
     828|                     audit: this._audit,
     829|                     wsRoot,
     830|                     folders,
     831|                     requestPermission: (cat, desc, tool, diff) => this.requestPermission(cat, desc, tool ?? '', diff),
     832|                     resolvePath,
     833|                     resolvePathSmart: resolvePathWithPriority,
     834|                     executeTool: (n, a) => this.executeTool(n, a),
     835|                     handleWhatsApp: (n, a) => this._callbacks.handleWhatsAppTool(n, a),
     836|                 };
     837|                 return provider.execute(name, shadowArgs, ctx);
     838|             }
     839|         }
     840|         // 影子號令： sandbox_init / sandbox_verify / sandbox_commit / sandbox_rollback
     841|         if (name === 'sandbox_init') {
     842|             this._sandbox.initShadow(args.session_id || Date.now().toString(36));
     843|             return '✅ 影子工作區已初始化，後續寫入類操作將進入暫存區等待審核';
     844|         }
     845|         if (name === 'sandbox_verify') {
     846|             const r = await this._sandbox.verify();
     847|             return r.output || (r.passed ? '✅ 驗證通過' : '❌ 驗證失敗');
     848|         }
     849|         if (name === 'sandbox_commit') {
     850|             const files = await this._sandbox.commit();
     851|             return `✅ 已提交 ${files.length} 個檔案至實際工作區\n${files.join('\n')}`;
     852|         }
     853|         if (name === 'sandbox_rollback') {
     854|             this._sandbox.rollback();
     855|             return '🗑️ 已回滚影子工作區，真實工作區未改動。';
     856|         }
     857|         if (name === 'sandbox_status') {
     858|             const s = this._sandbox.getState();
     859|             return JSON.stringify({ status: s.status, files: s.files.length, shadowDir: s.shadowDir, verifyPassed: s.verifyPassed }, null, 2);
     860|         }
     861|         // Provider dispatch：已遷移的工具走 provider 路徑，其餘繼續走原始 switch
     862|         const _provider = this._providerMap.get(name);
     863|         if (_provider) {
     864|             const _ctx = {
     865|                 callbacks: this._callbacks,
     866|                 cache: this._cache,
     867|                 audit: this._audit,
     868|                 wsRoot,
     869|                 folders,
     870|                 requestPermission: (cat, desc, tool, diff) => this.requestPermission(cat, desc, tool ?? '', diff),
     871|                 resolvePath,
     872|                 resolvePathSmart: resolvePathWithPriority,
     873|                 executeTool: (n, a) => this.executeTool(n, a),
     874|                 handleWhatsApp: (n, a) => this._callbacks.handleWhatsAppTool(n, a),
     875|             };
     876|             return _provider.execute(name, args, _ctx);
     877|         }
     878|         switch (name) {
     879|             case 'get_active_file': {
     880|                 const editor = vscode.window.activeTextEditor;
     881|                 if (!editor) {
     882|                     return '沒有開啟的檔案';
     883|                 }
     884|                 return `檔案: ${editor.document.uri.fsPath}\n\n${editor.document.getText()}`;
     885|             }
     886|             case 'read_file': {
     887|                 const fpath = await resolvePathWithPriority(args.path);
     888|                 const rfKey = `rf:${fpath}`;
     889|                 const rfCached = this._cache.get(rfKey);
     890|                 if (rfCached !== undefined) {
     891|                     return rfCached;
     892|                 }
     893|                 // 先檢查檔案大小，避免大型二進位/文字檔案讓 webview 凍結
     894|                 let fileStat;
     895|                 try {
     896|                     fileStat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
     897|                 }
     898|                 catch {
     899|                     return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`;
     900|                 }
     901|                 const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5 MB
     902|                 const LOG_SMART_THRESHOLD = 64 * 1024; // 64 KB：超過此大小的 log 改走 error-first 策略
     903|                 const ext = fpath.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
     904|                 const isLog = ['log', 'txt', 'out', 'err', 'bld', 'build', 'trace'].includes(ext);
     905|                 // 各式錯誤/警告關鍵字 pattern（涵蓋 EDKII build、GCC、Python、Node.js、一般系統 log）
     906|                 const LOG_ERROR_PATTERN = 'error:|Error:|ERROR|warning:|Warning:|WARNING|fatal:|Fatal:|FATAL|' +
     907|                     'fail:|FAIL|FAILED|BUILD FAILURE|BUILD ERROR|' +
     908|                     'assert|Assert|ASSERT|exception|Exception|EXCEPTION|' +
     909|                     'undefined reference|cannot find|unresolved|Unresolved|' +
     910|                     'ld returned|undefined symbol|' +
     911|                     'Traceback|SyntaxError|TypeError|ReferenceError|ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|' +
     912|                     'abort|Abort|ABORT|crash|Crash|panic|Panic|PANIC|' +
     913|                     'segfault|Segmentation fault|signal [0-9]|' +
     914|                     'No such file|Permission denied|Access denied|not found';
     915|                 if (fileStat.size > MAX_BYTES) {
     916|                     // 超大檔（> 5 MB）：直接用 read_file_smart 分兩段回傳
     917|                     const sizeMb = (fileStat.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1);
     918|                     if (isLog) {
     919|                         const tailResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', { path: args.path, tail: 300, max_kb: 96 });
     920|                         const errorResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', {
     921|                             path: args.path,
     922|                             pattern: LOG_ERROR_PATTERN,
     923|                             context_lines: 5,
     924|                             max_kb: 128,
     925|                         });
     926|                         return `⚠️ 檔案過大（${sizeMb} MB），自動分兩段回傳——\n\n` +
     927|                             `【全檔錯誤/警告點（含前後 5 行 context）】\n${errorResult}\n\n` +
     928|                             `【尾端 300 行（最終執行結果）】\n${tailResult}`;
     929|                     }
     930|                     else {
     931|                         const headResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', { path: args.path, head: 300, max_kb: 64 });
     932|                         return `⚠️ 檔案過大（${sizeMb} MB），自動回傳前 300 行：\n${headResult}`;
     933|                     }
     934|                 }
     935|                 // 中型 log（64 KB ~ 5 MB）：先掃描錯誤點再補尾端，避免截斷遺漏關鍵訊息
     936|                 if (isLog && fileStat.size > LOG_SMART_THRESHOLD) {
     937|                     const sizeKb = (fileStat.size / 1024).toFixed(0);
     938|                     const errorResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', {
     939|                         path: args.path,
     940|                         pattern: LOG_ERROR_PATTERN,
     941|                         context_lines: 5,
     942|                         max_kb: 128,
     943|                     });
     944|                     const tailResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', { path: args.path, tail: 100, max_kb: 64 });
     945|                     return `📋 Log 分析模式（${sizeKb} KB）——先掃描各式錯誤點，再補尾端執行結果\n\n` +
     946|                         `【錯誤 / 警告點（含前後 5 行 context）】\n${errorResult}\n\n` +
     947|                         `【尾端 100 行（執行結果）】\n${tailResult}`;
     948|                 }
     949|                 const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
     950|                 const text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
     951|                 // Track read time for conflict detection on subsequent writes
     952|                 try {
     953|                     const s = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
     954|                     this._fileReadTimes.set(fpath, s.mtime);
     955|                 }
     956|                 catch { /* ignore */ }
     957|                 const rfResult = text.length > 50000 ? text.slice(0, 50000) + '\n…（已截斷至 50KB）' : text;
     958|                 if (text.length <= 10000) {
     959|                     this._cache.set(rfKey, rfResult);
     960|                 }
     961|                 return rfResult;
     962|             }
     963|             case 'read_file_smart': {
     964|                 // 分區讀取大型檔案：支援行範圍、grep 過濾、head/tail，不會把整個檔案載入記憶體
     965|                 const rfsFpath = await resolvePathWithPriority(args.path);
     966|                 const rfsPattern = args.pattern ? String(args.pattern) : null;
     967|                 const rfsStartLine = args.start_line ? Math.max(1, Number(args.start_line)) : null;
     968|                 const rfsEndLine = args.end_line ? Math.max(1, Number(args.end_line)) : null;
     969|                 const rfsHead = args.head ? Math.max(1, Number(args.head)) : null;
     970|                 const rfsTail = args.tail ? Math.max(1, Number(args.tail)) : null;
     971|                 const rfsCtx = args.context_lines ? Math.max(0, Number(args.context_lines)) : 0;
     972|                 const rfsMaxKb = args.max_kb ? Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_kb))) : 128;
     973|                 try {
     974|                     const nodefs = require('fs');
     975|                     const readline = require('readline');
     976|                     // 取得檔案資訊
     977|                     let stat;
     978|                     try {
     979|                         stat = nodefs.statSync(rfsFpath);
     980|                     }
     981|                     catch {
     982|                         return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${rfsFpath}`;
     983|                     }
     984|                     const fileSizeMb = (stat.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1);
     985|                     const rfsRegex = rfsPattern ? new RegExp(rfsPattern, 'i') : null;
     986|                     const maxOutputBytes = rfsMaxKb * 1024;
     987|                     // 收集匹配行（含 context 支援）
     988|                     const matchedLines = [];
     989|                     const ringBuffer = []; // 用於 context_lines 的前置緩衝
     990|                     const pendingCtxLineNos = new Set(); // 標記需要輸出的後置 context 行號
     991|                     let totalFileLines = 0; // 全檔案行數（用於計算百分比）
     992|                     await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     993|                         const rl = readline.createInterface({
     994|                             input: nodefs.createReadStream(rfsFpath, { encoding: 'utf8' }),
     995|                             crlfDelay: Infinity,
     996|                         });
     997|                         let lineNo = 0;
     998|                         let outputBytes = 0;
     999|                         let collecting = true; // 停止收集但繼續計行以取得全檔行數
    1000|                         let tailLines = rfsTail ? [] : [];
    1001|                         rl.on('line', (line) => {
    1002|                             lineNo++;
    1003|                             if (!collecting) {
    1004|                                 return;
    1005|                             } // 繼續計行但不收集
    1006|                             // tail 模式：保留最後 N 行
    1007|                             if (rfsTail) {
    1008|                                 tailLines.push(line);
    1009|                                 if (tailLines.length > rfsTail)
    1010|                                     tailLines.shift();
    1011|                                 return;
    1012|                             }
    1013|                             // head 模式
    1014|                             if (rfsHead && lineNo > rfsHead) {
    1015|                                 collecting = false;
    1016|                                 return;
    1017|                             }
    1018|                             // 行範圍過濾
    1019|                             if (rfsStartLine && lineNo < rfsStartLine) {
    1020|                                 if (rfsCtx > 0) {
    1021|                                     ringBuffer.push(line);
    1022|                                     if (ringBuffer.length > rfsCtx)
    1023|                                         ringBuffer.shift();
    1024|                                 }
    1025|                                 return;
    1026|                             }
    1027|                             if (rfsEndLine && lineNo > rfsEndLine) {
    1028|                                 collecting = false;
    1029|                                 return;
    1030|                             }
    1031|                             const isMatch = rfsRegex ? rfsRegex.test(line) : true;
    1032|                             if (isMatch) {
    1033|                                 // 先補前置 context
    1034|                                 if (rfsCtx > 0 && rfsRegex) {
    1035|                                     for (let i = 0; i < ringBuffer.length; i++) {
    1036|                                         const ctxNo = lineNo - ringBuffer.length + i;
    1037|                                         if (!matchedLines.find(m => m.lineNo === ctxNo)) {
    1038|                                             matchedLines.push({ lineNo: ctxNo, text: ringBuffer[i], isContext: true });
    1039|                                         }
    1040|                                     }
    1041|                                     ringBuffer.length = 0;
    1042|                                     // 標記後置 context
    1043|                                     for (let j = 1; j <= rfsCtx; j++)
    1044|                                         pendingCtxLineNos.add(lineNo + j);
    1045|                                 }
    1046|                                 matchedLines.push({ lineNo, text: line });
    1047|                                 outputBytes += line.length + 1;
    1048|                                 if (outputBytes > maxOutputBytes) {
    1049|                                     collecting = false;
    1050|                                     return;
    1051|                                 }
    1052|                             }
    1053|                             else {
    1054|                                 // 後置 context
    1055|                                 if (pendingCtxLineNos.has(lineNo)) {
    1056|                                     pendingCtxLineNos.delete(lineNo);
    1057|                                     matchedLines.push({ lineNo, text: line, isContext: true });
    1058|                                     outputBytes += line.length + 1;
    1059|                                 }
    1060|                                 if (rfsCtx > 0 && rfsRegex) {
    1061|                                     ringBuffer.push(line);
    1062|                                     if (ringBuffer.length > rfsCtx)
    1063|                                         ringBuffer.shift();
    1064|                                 }
    1065|                             }
    1066|                         });
    1067|                         rl.on('close', () => {
    1068|                             totalFileLines = lineNo;
    1069|                             // 處理 tail 模式結果
    1070|                             if (rfsTail && tailLines.length > 0) {
    1071|                                 const tailStart = lineNo - tailLines.length + 1;
    1072|                                 tailLines.forEach((tl, i) => {
    1073|                                     matchedLines.push({ lineNo: tailStart + i, text: tl });
    1074|                                 });
    1075|                             }
    1076|                             resolve();
    1077|                         });
    1078|                         rl.on('error', reject);
    1079|                     });
    1080|                     const header = `📄 ${rfsFpath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalFileLines.toLocaleString()} 行)` +
    1081|                         (rfsPattern ? `  pattern="${rfsPattern}"` : '') +
    1082|                         (rfsStartLine ? `  lines=${rfsStartLine}-${rfsEndLine ?? '∞'}` : '') +
    1083|                         (rfsHead ? `  head=${rfsHead}` : '') +
    1084|                         (rfsTail ? `  tail=${rfsTail}` : '') +
    1085|                         `  matched=${matchedLines.length} 行\n`;
    1086|                     if (matchedLines.length === 0) {
    1087|                         return header + '（無匹配行）';
    1088|                     }
    1089|                     let totalOut = 0;
    1090|                     const lines = matchedLines.map(m => {
    1091|                         totalOut += m.text.length + 1;
    1092|                         const pct = totalFileLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
    1093|                         return `${m.isContext ? '  ' : ''}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}`;
    1094|                     });
    1095|                     const truncated = totalOut > maxOutputBytes;
    1096|                     const body = lines.join('\n') + (truncated ? `\n…（已達 ${rfsMaxKb}KB 輸出上限，請縮小範圍或增大 max_kb）` : '');
    1097|                     return header + body;
    1098|                 }
    1099|                 catch (e) {
    1100|                     return `read_file_smart 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
    1101|                 }
    1102|             }
    1103|             case 'grep_file': {
    1104|                 // 多關鍵字搜尋超大型檔案，逐行 streaming，不把整個檔案載入 buffer。
    1105|                 // 每個 keyword 獨立分組回傳，重疊 context 自動合併去重，達上限截斷各組。
    1106|                 const gfPath = await resolvePathWithPriority(args.path);
    1107|                 const gfKws = Array.isArray(args.keywords)
    1108|                     ? args.keywords.map(String).filter(Boolean)
    1109|                     : [];
    1110|                 if (gfKws.length === 0) {
    1111|                     return '錯誤：keywords 為空';
    1112|                 }
    1113|                 const gfCtx = args.context_lines ? Math.max(0, Number(args.context_lines)) : 3;
    1114|                 const gfMaxPerKw = args.max_matches_per_kw ? Math.max(1, Number(args.max_matches_per_kw)) : 30;
    1115|                 const gfMaxKb = args.max_kb ? Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_kb))) : 128;
    1116|                 const gfCaseSens = args.case_sensitive === true;
    1117|                 const gfMaxBytes = gfMaxKb * 1024;
    1118|                 try {
    1119|                     const nodefs = require('fs');
    1120|                     const readline = require('readline');
    1121|                     let stat;
    1122|                     try {
    1123|                         stat = nodefs.statSync(gfPath);
    1124|                     }
    1125|                     catch {
    1126|                         return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${gfPath}`;
    1127|                     }
    1128|                     const fileSizeMb = (stat.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1);
    1129|                     // 每個關鍵字建立獨立 regex 與匹配記錄
    1130|                     const gfFlag = gfCaseSens ? '' : 'i';
    1131|                     const groups = gfKws.map(kw => ({
    1132|                         kw,
    1133|                         re: new RegExp(kw, gfFlag),
    1134|                         matches: [],
    1135|                         totalHits: 0,
    1136|                         capped: false,
    1137|                     }));
    1138|                     // ring buffer（前置 context）與後置 context 追蹤
    1139|                     const ring = [];
    1140|                     // pendingCtx[kwIdx] = Set of future line numbers to capture as context
    1141|                     const pendingCtx = groups.map(() => new Set());
    1142|                     let totalFileLines = 0;
    1143|                     await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    1144|                         const rl = readline.createInterface({
    1145|                             input: nodefs.createReadStream(gfPath, { encoding: 'utf8' }),
    1146|                             crlfDelay: Infinity,
    1147|                         });
    1148|                         let lineNo = 0;
    1149|                         rl.on('line', (line) => {
    1150|                             lineNo++;
    1151|                             for (let gi = 0; gi < groups.length; gi++) {
    1152|                                 const g = groups[gi];
    1153|                                 // 後置 context
    1154|                                 if (pendingCtx[gi].has(lineNo)) {
    1155|                                     pendingCtx[gi].delete(lineNo);
    1156|                                     // 若此行也是 match，不重複加；等下面 match 邏輯加
    1157|                                     if (!g.re.test(line)) {
    1158|                                         if (!g.matches.find(m => m.lineNo === lineNo)) {
    1159|                                             g.matches.push({ lineNo, text: line, isCtx: true });
    1160|                                         }
    1161|                                     }
    1162|                                 }
    1163|                                 // 命中檢查
    1164|                                 if (g.re.test(line)) {
    1165|                                     g.totalHits++;
    1166|                                     if (!g.capped) {
    1167|                                         if (g.totalHits <= gfMaxPerKw) {
    1168|                                             // 前置 context：從 ring buffer 補
    1169|                                             if (gfCtx > 0) {
    1170|                                                 const ringStart = Math.max(0, ring.length - gfCtx);
    1171|                                                 for (let ri = ringStart; ri < ring.length; ri++) {
    1172|                                                     const ctxNo = lineNo - (ring.length - ri);
    1173|                                                     if (ctxNo >= 1 && !g.matches.find(m => m.lineNo === ctxNo)) {
    1174|                                                         g.matches.push({ lineNo: ctxNo, text: ring[ri], isCtx: true });
    1175|                                                     }
    1176|                                                 }
    1177|                                             }
    1178|                                             // 本行 match（先移除若已由後置 context 加過）
    1179|                                             const existing = g.matches.findIndex(m => m.lineNo === lineNo);
    1180|                                             if (existing !== -1) {
    1181|                                                 g.matches.splice(existing, 1);
    1182|                                             }
    1183|                                             g.matches.push({ lineNo, text: line, isCtx: false });
    1184|                                             // 後置 context
    1185|                                             for (let j = 1; j <= gfCtx; j++)
    1186|                                                 pendingCtx[gi].add(lineNo + j);
    1187|                                         }
    1188|                                         else {
    1189|                                             g.capped = true;
    1190|                                         }
    1191|                                     }
    1192|                                 }
    1193|                             }
    1194|                             // 維護 ring buffer
    1195|                             ring.push(line);
    1196|                             if (ring.length > gfCtx + 1)
    1197|                                 ring.shift();
    1198|                         });
    1199|                         rl.on('close', () => { totalFileLines = lineNo; resolve(); });
    1200|                         rl.on('error', reject);
    1201|                     });
    1202|                     // 組裝輸出
    1203|                     const allHits = groups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.totalHits, 0);
    1204|                     const hdr = `📄 ${gfPath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalFileLines.toLocaleString()} 行)\n` +
    1205|                         `🔍 Keywords: ${gfKws.map(k => `"${k}"`).join(', ')}  |  context=${gfCtx}  |  total hits: ${allHits}\n`;
    1206|                     const sections = [];
    1207|                     let outputBytes = hdr.length;
    1208|                     for (const g of groups) {
    1209|                         if (outputBytes >= gfMaxBytes) {
    1210|                             sections.push(`…（已達 ${gfMaxKb}KB 上限）`);
    1211|                             break;
    1212|                         }
    1213|                         // 排序並去重（多個 keywords 可能標記同一行為 context）
    1214|                         const sorted = g.matches.sort((a, b) => a.lineNo - b.lineNo);
    1215|                         const deduped = [];
    1216|                         for (const m of sorted) {
    1217|                             if (!deduped.length || deduped[deduped.length - 1].lineNo !== m.lineNo) {
    1218|                                 deduped.push(m);
    1219|                             }
    1220|                             else if (!m.isCtx) {
    1221|                                 // 若已有同行 context，升格為 match
    1222|                                 deduped[deduped.length - 1].isCtx = false;
    1223|                             }
    1224|                         }
    1225|                         const capNote = g.capped ? ` (顯示前 ${gfMaxPerKw}，共 ${g.totalHits} 處)` : ` (${g.totalHits} 處)`;
    1226|                         let section = `\n━━━ "${g.kw}" ${g.totalHits === 0 ? '— 無匹配' : capNote} ━━━\n`;
    1227|                         if (deduped.length === 0) {
    1228|                             section += '（無匹配行）\n';
    1229|                         }
    1230|                         else {
    1231|                             // 分布摘要：列出 match 的 % 位置
    1232|                             const matchNos = deduped.filter(m => !m.isCtx).map(m => m.lineNo);
    1233|                             const distrib = matchNos.map(n => `${(n * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%`).join(', ');
    1234|                             if (matchNos.length > 0) {
    1235|                                 section += `   📍 分布位置：${distrib}\n`;
    1236|                             }
    1237|                             let prevLineNo = -999;
    1238|                             for (const m of deduped) {
    1239|                                 if (m.lineNo > prevLineNo + 1 && prevLineNo !== -999) {
    1240|                                     section += '   ——\n';
    1241|                                 }
    1242|                                 const pct = totalFileLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
    1243|                                 section += `${m.isCtx ? '  ' : '▶ '}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}\n`;
    1244|                                 prevLineNo = m.lineNo;
    1245|                             }
    1246|                         }
    1247|                         if (outputBytes + section.length > gfMaxBytes) {
    1248|                             section = section.slice(0, gfMaxBytes - outputBytes) + '\n…（截斷）\n';
    1249|                         }
    1250|                         sections.push(section);
    1251|                         outputBytes += section.length;
    1252|                     }
    1253|                     return hdr + sections.join('');
    1254|                 }
    1255|                 catch (e) {
    1256|                     return `grep_file 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
    1257|                 }
    1258|             }
    1259|             case 'read_files': {
    1260|                 const rawPaths = Array.isArray(args.paths) ? args.paths.map(String).filter(Boolean) : [];
    1261|                 if (rawPaths.length === 0) {
    1262|                     return '錯誤：paths 為空陣列';
    1263|                 }
    1264|                 const MAX_FILES = 30;
    1265|                 const truncatedPaths = rawPaths.slice(0, MAX_FILES);
    1266|                 const overflowFiles = rawPaths.length > MAX_FILES ? rawPaths.length - MAX_FILES : 0;
    1267|                 const maxPerFileKb = Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_per_file_kb) || 64));
    1268|                 const maxTotalKb = Math.max(maxPerFileKb, Math.min(2048, Number(args.max_total_kb) || 256));
    1269|                 const maxPerBytes = maxPerFileKb * 1024;
    1270|                 const maxTotalBytes = maxTotalKb * 1024;
    1271|                 const FILE_HARD_MAX = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
    1272|                 const parts = [];
    1273|                 let totalBytes = 0;
    1274|                 let stoppedAt = -1;
    1275|                 for (let i = 0; i < truncatedPaths.length; i++) {
    1276|                     if (totalBytes >= maxTotalBytes) {
    1277|                         stoppedAt = i;
    1278|                         break;
    1279|                     }
    1280|                     const p = truncatedPaths[i];
    1281|                     const fpath = resolvePath(p);
    1282|                     let header = `=== ${p} ===\n`;
    1283|                     let body = '';
    1284|                     try {
    1285|                         const stat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
    1286|                         if (stat.size > FILE_HARD_MAX) {
    1287|                             body = `（檔案過大 ${(stat.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB > 5 MB，跳過）\n`;
    1288|                         }
    1289|                         else {
    1290|                             const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
    1291|                             let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
    1292|                             if (text.length > maxPerBytes) {
    1293|                                 text = text.slice(0, maxPerBytes) + `\n…（已截斷至 ${maxPerFileKb}KB，原始 ${Math.round(text.length / 1024)}KB）\n`;
    1294|                             }
    1295|                             const remaining = maxTotalBytes - totalBytes - header.length;
    1296|                             if (text.length > remaining) {
    1297|                                 text = text.slice(0, Math.max(0, remaining)) + `\n…（達總量上限 ${maxTotalKb}KB，本檔截斷）\n`;
    1298|                             }
    1299|                             body = text + (text.endsWith('\n') ? '' : '\n');
    1300|                         }
    1301|                     }
    1302|                     catch {
    1303|                         body = `（找不到檔案：${fpath}）\n`;
    1304|                     }
    1305|                     parts.push(header + body);
    1306|                     totalBytes += header.length + body.length;
    1307|                 }
    1308|                 const summary = [];
    1309|                 const readCount = stoppedAt === -1 ? truncatedPaths.length : stoppedAt;
    1310|                 summary.push(`📚 read_files: 已讀取 ${readCount}/${rawPaths.length} 個檔案，總 ${(totalBytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`);
    1311|                 if (stoppedAt !== -1) {
    1312|                     const skipped = truncatedPaths.slice(stoppedAt).concat(rawPaths.slice(MAX_FILES));
    1313|                     summary.push(`⚠️ 達總量上限（${maxTotalKb}KB），未讀取：${skipped.slice(0, 10).join(', ')}${skipped.length > 10 ? ` …(+${skipped.length - 10})` : ''}`);
    1314|                     summary.push(`💡 請對剩餘檔案再次呼叫 read_files 並調整 max_total_kb，或改用 search_regex 縮小範圍。`);
    1315|                 }
    1316|                 else if (overflowFiles > 0) {
    1317|                     summary.push(`⚠️ paths 數量超過上限 ${MAX_FILES}，未處理 ${overflowFiles} 個檔案。`);
    1318|                 }
    1319|                 return summary.join('\n') + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n');
    1320|             }
    1321|             case 'write_file': {
    1322|                 const fpath = resolvePath(args.path);
    1323|                 const content = args.content ?? '';
    1324|                 let wfBefore = '';
    1325|                 try {
    1326|                     wfBefore = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
    1327|                 }
    1328|                 catch { /* new file */ }
    1329|                 // Conflict detection: file modified externally since last read
    1330|                 const wfReadTime = this._fileReadTimes.get(fpath);
    1331|                 if (wfReadTime !== undefined && wfBefore) {
    1332|                     try {
    1333|                         const wfStat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
    1334|                         if (wfStat.mtime > wfReadTime) {
    1335|                             return `⚠️ 衝突：${path.basename(fpath)} 自上次讀取後已被外部程式修改（可能是 linter）。請先重新呼叫 read_file 再編輯。`;
    1336|                         }
    1337|                     }
    1338|                     catch { /* file might be new */ }
    1339|                 }
    1340|                 const wfDiff = { filePath: fpath, before: wfBefore, after: content, mode: 'write' };
    1341|                 const allowed = await this.requestPermission('write', `寫入檔案: ${path.basename(fpath)}（${content.length} 字元）`, 'write_file', wfDiff);
    1342|                 if (!allowed) {
    1343|                     return '使用者已拒絕寫入操作';
    1344|                 }
    1345|                 await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(content, 'utf8'));
    1346|                 this._cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
    1347|                 this._fileReadTimes.delete(fpath);
    1348|                 const wfStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(wfDiff.before, wfDiff.after, fpath);
    1349|                 this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'write', ts: Date.now(), ...wfStats });
    1350|                 return `已寫入 ${fpath}（${content.length} 字元）`;
    1351|             }
    1352|             case 'replace_in_file': {
    1353|                 const fpath = resolvePath(args.path);
    1354|                 const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
    1355|                 const original = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
    1356|                 const oldStr = args.old_str;
    1357|                 const newStr = args.new_str ?? '';
    1358|                 // Conflict detection
    1359|                 const rifReadTime = this._fileReadTimes.get(fpath);
    1360|                 if (rifReadTime !== undefined) {
    1361|                     try {
    1362|                         const rifStat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
    1363|                         if (rifStat.mtime > rifReadTime) {
    1364|                             return `⚠️ 衝突：${path.basename(fpath)} 自上次讀取後已被外部程式修改。請先重新呼叫 read_file 再編輯。`;
    1365|                         }
    1366|                     }
    1367|                     catch { /* ignore */ }
    1368|                 }
    1369|                 if (!original.includes(oldStr)) {
    1370|                     // Fuzzy hint: find lines sharing keywords with old_str

    1372|                     const hints = original.split('\n')
    1373|                         .map((l, i) => ({ i: i + 1, t: l.trim(), hits: keywords.filter(k => l.toLowerCase().includes(k.toLowerCase())).length }))
    1374|                         .filter(l => l.hits > 0)
    1375|                         .sort((a, b) => b.hits - a.hits)

    1378|                         .join('\n');
    1379|                     const hintText = hints ? `\n\n類似內容可能在：\n${hints}` : '';
    1380|                     return `錯誤：在 ${path.basename(fpath)} 中找不到指定的字串。請先呼叫 outline_file 或 read_file_smart 確認確切內容再編輯。${hintText}`;
    1381|                 }
    1382|                 const matchCount = original.split(oldStr).length - 1;
    1383|                 if (matchCount > 1) {
    1384|                     return `錯誤：在 ${path.basename(fpath)} 中找到 ${matchCount} 處相符字串。old_str 必須在檔案中唯一。請加入更多前後文字來唯一定位，或用 replace_all_in_file 取代所有 ${matchCount} 處。`;
    1385|                 }
    1386|                 const rifDiff = { filePath: fpath, before: original, after: original.replace(oldStr, newStr), mode: 'replace', oldStr, newStr };
    1387|                 const allowed = await this.requestPermission('write', `編輯檔案: ${path.basename(fpath)}`, 'replace_in_file', rifDiff);
    1388|                 if (!allowed) {
    1389|                     return '使用者已拒絕編輯操作';
    1390|                 }
    1391|                 await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(original.replace(oldStr, newStr), 'utf8'));
    1392|                 this._cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
    1393|                 this._fileReadTimes.delete(fpath);
    1394|                 const rifStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(rifDiff.before, rifDiff.after, fpath);
    1395|                 this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'replace', ts: Date.now(), ...rifStats });
    1396|                 return `已更新 ${fpath}`;
    1397|             }
    1398|             case 'insert_in_file': {
    1399|                 // 在指定行號後插入內容（1-based；line=0 表示在最前面插入）
    1400|                 const fpath = resolvePath(args.path);
    1401|                 const lineNum = Math.max(0, Number(args.line) || 0);
    1402|                 const insertContent = args.content ?? '';
    1403|                 let original;
    1404|                 try {
    1405|                     const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
    1406|                     original = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
    1407|                 }
    1408|                 catch {
    1409|                     return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`;
    1410|                 }
    1411|                 // 保留原始行尾（CRLF 或 LF）
    1412|                 const hasCrlf = original.includes('\r\n');
    1413|                 const lineEnding = hasCrlf ? '\r\n' : '\n';

    1415|                 if (lineNum > lines.length) {
    1416|                     return `錯誤：行號 ${lineNum} 超過檔案總行數 ${lines.length}`;
    1417|                 }
    1418|                 const insertLines = insertContent.split(/\r?\n/);
    1419|                 lines.splice(lineNum, 0, ...insertLines);
    1420|                 const newContent = lines.join(lineEnding);
    1421|                 const ifDiff = { filePath: fpath, before: original, after: newContent, mode: 'replace', oldStr: '', newStr: insertContent };
    1422|                 const ifAllowed = await this.requestPermission('write', `插入檔案: ${path.basename(fpath)} 第 ${lineNum} 行後（${insertLines.length} 行）`, 'insert_in_file', ifDiff);
    1423|                 if (!ifAllowed) {
    1424|                     return '使用者已拒絕插入操作';
    1425|                 }
    1426|                 await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(newContent, 'utf8'));
    1427|                 this._cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
    1428|                 const ifStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(ifDiff.before, ifDiff.after, fpath);
    1429|                 this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'insert', ts: Date.now(), ...ifStats });

    1431|             }
    1432|             case 'glob': {
    1433|                 // 列出符合 glob 樣式的檔案（類似 OpenHarness GlobTool）
    1434|                 const globPattern = args.pattern || '**/*';
    1435|                 const globRoot = args.root ? resolvePath(args.root) : wsRoot;
    1436|                 const globLimit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.limit) || 200, 1), 5000);
    1437|                 const globExclude = '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**,**/build/**,**/__pycache__/**}';

    1446|                         .map(u => path.relative(globRoot, u.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/'))

    1453|             }
    1454|             case 'outline_file': {

    1456|                 const ofPath = resolvePath(args.path);

    1477|                     }

    1480|                     // C/C++：函式定義（回傳型別 + EFIAPI/OPTIONAL + 函式名稱(）、typedef、struct、enum

    1500|                         }
    1501|                     }
    1502|                 }

    1507|             }
    1508|             case 'todo_write': {

    1705|                     return '請提供 pattern 與 replace 參數';
    1706|                 }

    1708|                 if (!brAllowed) {
    1709|                     return '使用者已拒絕操作';
    1710|                 }
    1711|                 let brRe;
    1712|                 try {
    1713|                     brRe = new RegExp(brPattern, brFlags);
    1714|                 }
    1715|                 catch (e) {
    1716|                     return `正規表達式錯誤: ${e}`;
    1717|                 }

    1719|                 const brResults = [];

    1723|                         const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
    1724|                         const original = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
    1725|                         const updated = original.replace(brRe, brReplace);

    1730|                             this._callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: uri.fsPath, op: 'replace', ts: Date.now(), ...brStats });
    1731|                             const count = (original.match(new RegExp(brPattern, brFlags)) || []).length;
    1732|                             brResults.push(`  ${path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/')}  (${count} 處)`);
    1733|                             brTotalFiles++;
    1734|                         }
    1735|                     }
    1736|                     catch { /* skip binary / unreadable */ }
    1737|                 }
    1738|                 if (brTotalFiles === 0) {
    1739|                     return `找不到符合的內容 (/${brPattern}/ in ${brGlob})`;
    1740|                 }

    1742|             }
    1743|             case 'file_info': {
    1744|                 // 取得檔案資訊（大小、行數、BOM/編碼、最後修改時間）
    1745|                 const fiPath = resolvePath(args.path || '');
    1746|                 if (!fiPath) {

    1758|                     if (buf[0] === 0xEF && buf[1] === 0xBB && buf[2] === 0xBF) {
    1759|                         encoding = 'UTF-8 BOM';
    1760|                     }
    1761|                     else if (buf[0] === 0xFF && buf[1] === 0xFE) {
    1762|                         encoding = 'UTF-16 LE BOM';
    1763|                     }
    1764|                     else if (buf[0] === 0xFE && buf[1] === 0xFF) {
    1765|                         encoding = 'UTF-16 BE BOM';
    1766|                     }
    1767|                     const text = buf.toString('utf8');
    1768|                     const lineCount = text.split('\n').length;
    1769|                     const crlf = (text.match(/\r\n/g) || []).length;
    1770|                     const lf = (text.match(/(?<!\r)\n/g) || []).length;
    1771|                     const eol = crlf > lf ? 'CRLF' : 'LF';
    1772|                     const mtime = new Date(stat.mtime).toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
    1773|                     const isDir = (stat.type & vscode.FileType.Directory) !== 0;
    1774|                     return [
    1775|                         `路徑: ${fiPath}`,
    1776|                         `類型: ${isDir ? '目錄' : '檔案'}`,
    1777|                         `大小: ${stat.size} bytes (${sizeKb} KB)`,
    1778|                         `行數: ${lineCount}`,
    1779|                         `行尾: ${eol} (CRLF:${crlf} / LF:${lf})`,
    1780|                         `編碼: ${encoding}`,
    1781|                         `修改時間: ${mtime} UTC`,
    1782|                     ].join('\n');
    1783|                 }
    1784|                 catch (e) {
    1785|                     return `file_info 錯誤: ${e}`;
    1786|                 }
    1787|             }
    1788|             case 'list_dir': {

    3930| function runDockerPython(pyCode, dockerImage, timeoutMs) {
    3931|     return new Promise(res => {
    3932|         try {
    3933|             const { spawn } = require('child_process');
    3934|             const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '-i', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'python', '-']);
    3935|             let out = '', err = '';
    3936|             proc.stdout.on('data', (d) => { out += d.toString(); });
    3937|             proc.stderr.on('data', (d) => { err += d.toString(); });
    3938|             proc.on('close', () => {
    3939|                 const combined = (out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim();
    3940|                 res(combined.slice(0, 10000) || '(無輸出)');
    3941|             });
    3942|             proc.on('error', (e) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行`));
    3943|             const timer = setTimeout(() => { try {
    3944|                 proc.kill();
    3945|             }
    3946|             catch { /* noop */ } res('逾時 (' + timeoutMs + 'ms)'); }, timeoutMs);
    3947|             proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
    3948|             proc.stdin.write(pyCode, 'utf-8');
    3949|             proc.stdin.end();
    3950|         }
    3951|         catch (e) {
    3952|             res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    3953|         }
    3954|     });
    3955| }
    3956| /** 沙箱 Shell 執行助手：透過 `docker run --rm -i <image> sh -c "<cmd>"` 執行 shell 指令。
    3957|  *  容器沒有工作區檔案（純命令執行隔離）。
    3958|  */
    3959| function runDockerShell(cmd, dockerImage, timeoutMs) {
    3960|     return new Promise(res => {
    3961|         try {
    3962|             const { spawn } = require('child_process');
    3963|             const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'sh', '-c', cmd]);
    3964|             let out = '', err = '';
    3965|             proc.stdout.on('data', (d) => { out += d.toString(); if ((out + err).length > 512000) {
    3966|                 try {
    3967|                     proc.kill();
    3968|                 }
    3969|                 catch { /* noop */ }
    3970|             } });
    3971|             proc.stderr.on('data', (d) => { err += d.toString(); });
    3972|             proc.on('close', () => {
    3973|                 const combined = (out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim();
    3974|                 const r = combined.length > 10000 ? combined.slice(0, 10000) + '\n…（已截斷）' : combined || '(無輸出)';
    3975|                 res(r);
    3976|             });
    3977|             proc.on('error', (e) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行且已拉取影像`));
    3978|             const timer = setTimeout(() => { try {
    3979|                 proc.kill();
    3980|             }
    3981|             catch { /* noop */ } res(`逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`); }, timeoutMs);
    3982|             proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
    3983|         }
    3984|         catch (e) {
    3985|             res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    3986|         }
    3987|     });
    3988| }
