      53| const _NET_EFFECT = new Set(['http_request', 'fetch_url', 'browser_navigate', 'browser_screenshot', 'browser_script']);
      54| function _getEffect(toolName) {
      55|     if (_WRITE_EFFECT.has(toolName))
      56|         return 'write';
      57|     if (_SHELL_EFFECT.has(toolName))
      58|         return 'shell';
      59|     if (_NET_EFFECT.has(toolName))
      60|         return 'network';
      61|     if (toolName === 'delete_file')
      62|         return 'delete';
      63|     return null;
      64| }
      65| /** Minimal glob: * = any non-separator chars, ** = anything including /. */
      66| function _globMatch(pattern, value) {
      67|     const v = value.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      68|     const re = pattern
      69|         .replace(/\\/g, '/')
      70|         .replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]]/g, '\\$&')
      71|         .replace(/\*\*/g, '\x00')
      72|         .replace(/\*/g, '[^/]*')
      73|         .replace(/\x00/g, '.*');
      74|     // match against full path or path suffix (allows `src/**` to match `C:/ws/src/foo.ts`)
      75|     return new RegExp(`(^|/)${re}$`, 'i').test(v) || new RegExp(`^${re}$`, 'i').test(v);
      76| }
      77| /** Evaluate ordered rules; returns first matching action or null. */
      78| function evaluatePolicyRules(rules, effect, value) {
      79|     for (const rule of rules) {
      80|         if (rule.effect !== effect && rule.effect !== 'any')
      81|             continue;
      82|         if (!rule.pattern)
      83|             return rule.action;
      84|         if (effect === 'write' || effect === 'delete') {
      85|             if (_globMatch(rule.pattern, value))
      86|                 return rule.action;
      87|         }
      88|         else {
      89|             if (value.toLowerCase().includes(rule.pattern.toLowerCase()))
      90|                 return rule.action;
      91|         }
      92|     }
      93|     return null;
      94| }
      95| /**
      96|  * 工具權限政策：alwaysAllow 集合 + 一次性確認佇列（pending promise）。
      97|  * 把 forceConfirm / WA agent auto-allow / agentAutoApproveWrite / config alwaysAllowList
      98|  * 這幾條規則整合在 requestPermission 內。
      99|  */
     100| class ToolPolicies {
     101|     constructor(_cb) {
     102|         this._cb = _cb;
     103|         this._alwaysAllow = new Set();
     104|         this._pendingPermission = null;
     105|     }
     106|     getAlwaysAllow() {
     107|         return this._alwaysAllow;
     108|     }
     109|     addAlwaysAllow(category) {
     110|         this._alwaysAllow.add(category);
     111|     }
     112|     hasPending() {
     113|         return this._pendingPermission !== null;
     114|     }
     115|     resolvePending(allow) {
     116|         if (!this._pendingPermission) {
     117|             return false;
     118|         }
     119|         const resolve = this._pendingPermission;
     120|         this._pendingPermission = null;
     121|         resolve(allow);
     122|         return true;
     123|     }
     124|     async requestPermission(category, description, toolName = '', diff) {
     125|         // ── Effect-based rule DSL（最優先）───────────────────────────────────────
     126|         if (toolName) {
     127|             const ruleCfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     128|             const rules = ruleCfg.get('toolPolicyRules') ?? [];
     129|             if (rules.length > 0) {
     130|                 const effect = _getEffect(toolName);
     131|                 if (effect) {
     132|                     let matchValue = description;
     133|                     if (effect === 'write' || effect === 'delete') {
     134|                         matchValue = diff?.filePath ?? '';
     135|                     }
     136|                     else if (effect === 'network') {
     137|                         const m = description.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
     138|                         if (m)
     139|                             matchValue = m[0];
     140|                     }
     141|                     const ruleDecision = evaluatePolicyRules(rules, effect, matchValue);
     142|                     if (ruleDecision === 'allow') {
     143|                         this._cb.log(`Rule DSL allow: ${toolName} [${effect}] ${matchValue.slice(0, 60)}`);
     144|                         return true;
     145|                     }
     146|                     if (ruleDecision === 'deny') {
     147|                         this._cb.log(`Rule DSL deny: ${toolName} [${effect}] ${matchValue.slice(0, 60)}`);
     148|                         return false;
     149|                     }
     150|                     // 'ask' 跳過 AutoPilot，直接展示對話框
     151|                     if (ruleDecision === 'ask')
     152|                         return new Promise((resolve) => {
     153|                             this._pendingPermission = resolve;
     154|                             this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'permissionRequest', category, description, forceConfirm: true, diff });
     155|                         });
     156|                 }
     157|             }
     158|         }
     159|         // ── AutoPilot gateway（次優先，短路後續所有邏輯）───────────────────────
     160|         if ((0, AutoPilotState_1.isAutoPilotActive)() && this._cb.getAutoPilotServices) {
     161|             const services = this._cb.getAutoPilotServices();
     162|             const transcript = this._cb.getRecentTranscript?.() ?? [];
     163|             const wsFolders = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? []).map(f => f.uri.fsPath);
     164|             try {
     165|                 // Build full toolArgs for classifier (was: only filePath)
     166|                 const apArgs = {};
     167|                 if (diff) {
     168|                     apArgs.path = diff.filePath;
     169|                     if (diff.oldStr)
     170|                         apArgs.old_str = diff.oldStr;
     171|                     if (diff.newStr)
     172|                         apArgs.new_str = diff.newStr;
     173|                     if (diff.mode)
     174|                         apArgs.mode = diff.mode;
     175|                 }
     176|                 if ((toolName === 'run_command' || toolName === 'run_terminal') && !apArgs.command) {
     177|                     apArgs.command = description.replace(/^[^:：]+[：:]\s*/, '');
     178|                 }
     179|                 if (!apArgs.url) {
     180|                     const urlM = description.match(/https?:\/\/\S+/);
     181|                     if (urlM)
     182|                         apArgs.url = urlM[0];
     183|                 }
     184|                 const decision = await (0, AutoPilotPolicy_1.decideAutoPilotAction)({
     185|                     toolName,
     186|                     toolArgs: apArgs,
     187|                     toolDisplay: description,
     188|                     recentTranscript: transcript,
     189|                     workspaceFolders: wsFolders,
     190|                     services,
     191|                 });
     192|                 if (decision.kind === 'allow') {
     193|                     this._cb.log(`AutoPilot allow: ${toolName} — ${decision.reason}`);
     194|                     (0, AutoPilotDenials_1.recordAutoPilotSuccess)();
     195|                     return true;
     196|                 }
     197|                 if (decision.kind === 'deny') {
     198|                     this._cb.log(`AutoPilot deny: ${toolName} — ${decision.reason}`);
     199|                     (0, AutoPilotDenials_1.recordAutoPilotDenial)({ toolName: toolName || category, display: description, reason: decision.reason, timestamp: Date.now() });
     200|                     this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'autoPilotDenied', tool: toolName, reason: decision.reason });
     201|                     return false;
     202|                 }
     203|                 // pass-through / fallback-ask → 繼續走下面原本邏輯
     204|             }
     205|             catch (e) {
     206|                 this._cb.log(`AutoPilot gateway error（fallback to manual）: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
     207|             }
     208|         }
     209|         // ── 原本邏輯（不變）──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     210|         const pcfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     211|         const alwaysAllowList = pcfg.get('toolAlwaysAllow') ?? [];
     212|         const alwaysConfirmList = pcfg.get('toolAlwaysConfirm') ?? [];
     213|         const forceConfirm = toolName ? alwaysConfirmList.includes(toolName) : false;
     214|         if (this._cb.isWaAgentMode() && !forceConfirm && category !== 'delete') {
     215|             this._cb.log(`WA agent: auto-allow tool category=${category} tool=${toolName || '(none)'}`);
     216|             return Promise.resolve(true);
     217|         }
     218|         if (pcfg.get('agentAutoApproveWrite', false) && (category === 'write' || (toolName && AUTO_WRITE_TOOLS.has(toolName)))) {
     219|             return Promise.resolve(true);
     220|         }
     221|         if ((toolName && alwaysAllowList.includes(toolName)) || alwaysAllowList.includes(category)) {
     222|             return Promise.resolve(true);
     223|         }
     224|         if (!forceConfirm && this._alwaysAllow.has(category)) {
     225|             return Promise.resolve(true);
     226|         }
     227|         return new Promise((resolve) => {
     228|             this._pendingPermission = resolve;
     229|             this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'permissionRequest', category, description, forceConfirm, diff });
     230|         });
     231|     }
     232| }
     233| exports.ToolPolicies = ToolPolicies;

     186| // ── TF-IDF tool search ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     187| function _tokenize(text) {
     188|     return text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(t => t.length > 1);
     189| }
     190| /** Smoothed IDF: log((N+1)/(df+1)) + 1, computed once at module load. */
     191| const _idf = (() => {
     192|     const N = exports.EXTRA_TOOLS.length;
     193|     const df = new Map();
     194|     for (const tool of exports.EXTRA_TOOLS) {
     195|         const terms = new Set(_tokenize(`${tool.function.name} ${tool.function.description}`));
     196|         for (const t of terms)
     197|             df.set(t, (df.get(t) ?? 0) + 1);
     198|     }
     199|     const idf = new Map();
     200|     for (const [term, count] of df)
     201|         idf.set(term, Math.log((N + 1) / (count + 1)) + 1);
     202|     return idf;
     203| })();
     204| function _tfidfVec(tokens) {
     205|     const tf = new Map();
     206|     for (const t of tokens)
     207|         tf.set(t, (tf.get(t) ?? 0) + 1);
     208|     const vec = new Map();
     209|     const len = tokens.length || 1;
     210|     // unseen terms get IDF = log((N+1)/1)+1 ≈ high weight for novel query terms
     211|     const unseenIdf = Math.log(exports.EXTRA_TOOLS.length + 2) + 1;
     212|     for (const [t, count] of tf)
     213|         vec.set(t, (count / len) * (_idf.get(t) ?? unseenIdf));
     214|     return vec;
     215| }
     216| function _cosine(a, b) {
     217|     let dot = 0, normA = 0, normB = 0;
     218|     for (const [t, v] of a) {
     219|         dot += v * (b.get(t) ?? 0);
     220|         normA += v * v;
     221|     }
     222|     for (const v of b.values())
     223|         normB += v * v;
     224|     return normA === 0 || normB === 0 ? 0 : dot / (Math.sqrt(normA) * Math.sqrt(normB));
     225| }
     226| /** Pre-computed TF-IDF vectors for all EXTRA_TOOLS (avoids recompute per query). */
     227| const _toolVecs = (() => {
     228|     const m = new Map();
     229|     for (const tool of exports.EXTRA_TOOLS) {
     230|         m.set(tool.function.name, _tfidfVec(_tokenize(`${tool.function.name} ${tool.function.description}`)));
     231|     }
     232|     return m;
     233| })();
     234| /**
     235|  * TF-IDF + cosine similarity search over EXTRA_TOOLS.
     236|  * Returns up to topK tool definitions ranked by semantic relevance.
     237|  */
     238| function searchExtraTools(query, topK = 5) {
     239|     const queryTokens = _tokenize(query);
     240|     if (queryTokens.length === 0)
     241|         return exports.EXTRA_TOOLS.slice(0, topK);
     242|     const queryVec = _tfidfVec(queryTokens);
     243|     const scored = exports.EXTRA_TOOLS.map(tool => ({
     244|         tool,
     245|         score: _cosine(queryVec, _toolVecs.get(tool.function.name)),
     246|     }));
     247|     return scored
     248|         .filter(s => s.score > 0)
     249|         .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
     250|         .slice(0, topK)
     251|         .map(s => s.tool);
     252| }

     455|         const hm = timeStr.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*h/i);
     456|         const mm = timeStr.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*m(?!s)/i);
     457|         const sm = timeStr.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*s(?!\w)/i);
     458|         if (dm)
     459|             secs += parseFloat(dm[1]) * 8 * 3600;
     460|         if (hm)
     461|             secs += parseFloat(hm[1]) * 3600;
     462|         if (mm)
     463|             secs += parseFloat(mm[1]) * 60;
     464|         if (sm)
     465|             secs += parseFloat(sm[1]);
     466|         if (!dm && !hm && !mm && !sm) {
     467|             const b = parseFloat(timeStr);
     468|             if (!isNaN(b))
     469|                 secs = b;
     470|             else
     471|                 return `無法解析時間格式: "${timeStr}"`;
     472|         }
     473|         if (secs <= 0)
     474|             return '時間必須大於 0';
     475|         const dateStr = (args.date || 'today').trim().toLowerCase();
     476|         let d = new Date();
     477|         if (dateStr === 'yesterday')
     478|             d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1);
     479|         else if (dateStr !== 'today' && dateStr)
     480|             d = new Date(dateStr);
     481|         if (isNaN(d.getTime()))
     482|             return `無法解析日期: "${dateStr}"`;
     483|         const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
     484|         const started = `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T09:00:00.000+0000`;
     485|         const auth = await this._resolveAuth(true);
     486|         if (typeof auth === 'string')
     487|             return auth;
     488|         const { apiBase, header } = auth;
     489|         const isAtlas = apiBase.includes('/api/3') || !apiBase.includes('/rest');
     490|         const url = isAtlas ? `${apiBase}/issue/${key}/worklog` : `${apiBase}/api/3/issue/${key}/worklog`;
     491|         const body = JSON.stringify({ timeSpentSeconds: Math.round(secs), started, ...(args.comment ? { comment: args.comment } : {}) });
     492|         const { status, data } = await this._jiraRequest(url, 'POST', header, body);
     493|         if (status === 401 || status === 403) {
     494|             this._jiraCred = null;
     495|             return `Jira 認證失敗 (HTTP ${status})`;
     496|         }
     497|         if (status === 404)
     498|             return `找不到 Issue ${key}`;
     499|         if (status !== 201)
     500|             return `Jira Log Time 失敗 HTTP ${status}: ${data.slice(0, 200)}`;
     501|         try {
     502|             const j = JSON.parse(data);
     503|             const hrs = (secs / 3600).toFixed(1);
     504|             return `✅ 已記錄 ${key} 工時 ${hrs}h，日期: ${dateStr === 'today' ? '今天' : dateStr}${args.comment ? `，備註: ${args.comment}` : ''}，worklog ID: ${j.id}`;
     505|         }
     506|         catch {
     507|             return `Jira Log Time 完成但無法解析回應: ${data.slice(0, 200)}`;
     508|         }

     510|     // ── rovo_ask ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     511|     async _rovoAsk(args, ctx) {
     512|         const q = (args.question || '').trim();
     513|         if (!q)
     514|             return '請提供 question 參數';
     515|         try {
     516|             const r = await this._callRovoApi(q);
     517|             if (r)
     518|                 return `[Rovo Dev 回覆]\n${r}`;
     519|         }
     520|         catch { /* fall through */ }
     521|         try {
     522|             await vscode.commands.executeCommand('atlascode.rovodev.askInteractive', q);
     523|             return '已在 Rovo Dev 面板提問（無法直接取回回覆），請查看 Rovo Dev 面板。';
     524|         }
     525|         catch (e) {
     526|             return `失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
     527|         }
     528|     }
     529|     async _discoverRovo() {
     530|         if (this._rovoCache && Date.now() < this._rovoCache.expiry)
     531|             return { url: this._rovoCache.url, token: this._rovoCache.token };
     532|         if (!this._rovoCache && Date.now() < this._rovoNullUntil)
     533|             return null;
     534|         const envToken = process.env['ROVODEV_SERVE_SESSION_TOKEN'] ?? '';

     536|             try {
     537|                 const u = new url_1.URL('/healthcheck', url);
     538|                 const req = http.request({ hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'), path: u.pathname, method: 'GET', headers: envToken ? { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${envToken}` } : {} }, res => { res.resume(); resolve(res.statusCode === 200); });

     541|                 req.end();
     542|             }
     543|             catch {
     544|                 resolve(false);
     545|             }

     549|             const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${envPort}`;
     550|             if (await tryUrl(url)) {
     551|                 this._rovoCache = { url, token: envToken, expiry: Date.now() + 5 * 60000 };
     552|                 return { url, token: envToken };
     553|             }
     554|         }
     555|         if (process.platform === 'win32') {
     556|             try {

     559|                 if (!pidM)

     566|                     if (!m)

     570|                         const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${p}`;
     571|                         if (await tryUrl(url)) {
     572|                             this._rovoCache = { url, token: envToken, expiry: Date.now() + 5 * 60000 };
     573|                             return { url, token: envToken };
     574|                         }
     575|                     }
     576|                 }
     577|             }
     578|             catch { /* not found */ }
     579|         }
     580|         this._rovoCache = undefined;
     581|         this._rovoNullUntil = Date.now() + 30000;
     582|         return null;
     583|     }
     584|     async _callRovoApi(question) {
     585|         const target = await this._discoverRovo();
     586|         if (!target)
     587|             return null;
     588|         const { url, token } = target;
     589|         const hdrs = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'accept': 'text/event-stream', ...(token ? { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) };
     590|         const body = JSON.stringify({ message: question, context: [] });
     591|         const step1 = await new Promise(resolve => {
     592|             try {
     593|                 const u = new url_1.URL('/v3/set_chat_message', url);
     594|                 const req = http.request({ hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'), path: u.pathname, method: 'POST', headers: { ...hdrs, 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) } }, res => { res.resume(); resolve((res.statusCode ?? 0) < 400); });

     596|                 req.setTimeout(10000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(false); });
     597|                 req.write(body);
     598|                 req.end();
     599|             }
     600|             catch {
     601|                 resolve(false);
     602|             }
     603|         });
     604|         if (!step1) {
     605|             this._rovoCache = undefined;
     606|             this._rovoNullUntil = 0;
     607|             return null;
     608|         }
     609|         return new Promise(resolve => {
     610|             try {
     611|                 const u = new url_1.URL('/v3/stream_chat?pause_on_call_tools_start=false&enable_deferred_tools=true', url);
     612|                 const req = http.request({ hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'), path: u.pathname + u.search, method: 'GET', headers: hdrs }, res => {
     613|                     if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
     614|                         res.resume();
     615|                         resolve(null);
     616|                         return;
     617|                     }
     618|                     let buf = '';
     619|                     const parts = [];
     620|                     res.on('data', (c) => { buf += c.toString('utf8'); const blocks = buf.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/g); buf = blocks.pop() ?? ''; for (const b of blocks) {
     621|                         if (b.startsWith(': ping'))
     622|                             continue;
     623|                         const m = b.match(/^event: ([^\r\n]+)\r?\ndata: ([\s\S]*)$/);
     624|                         if (!m)
     625|                             continue;
     626|                         const kind = m[1].trim();
     627|                         let data = {};
     628|                         try {
     629|                             data = JSON.parse(m[2]);
     630|                         }
     631|                         catch {
     632|                             continue;
     633|                         }
     634|                         if (kind === 'text') {
     635|                             const c = (data['content'] ?? data['content_delta'] ?? '');
     636|                             if (c)
     637|                                 parts.push(c);
     638|                         }
     639|                         else if (kind === 'part_start') {
     640|                             const p = (data['part'] ?? {});
     641|                             if (p['part_kind'] === 'text' && p['content'])
     642|                                 parts.push(p['content']);
     643|                         }
     644|                         else if (kind === 'part_delta') {
     645|                             const d = (data['delta'] ?? {});
     646|                             if (d['part_delta_kind'] === 'text' && d['content_delta'])
     647|                                 parts.push(d['content_delta']);
     648|                         }
     649|                     } });
     650|                     res.on('end', () => resolve(parts.join('').trim() || null));
     651|                     res.on('error', () => resolve(null));
     652|                 });
     653|                 req.on('error', () => resolve(null));
     654|                 req.setTimeout(60000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(null); });
     655|                 req.end();
     656|             }
     657|             catch {
     658|                 resolve(null);
     659|             }
     660|         });
     661|     }

     145|         }
     146|         catch {
     147|             return `（輸出檔案尚未建立，任務狀態: ${task.status}）`;
     148|         }

     165|         }
     166|         catch (e) {
     167|             return `終止失敗：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
     168|         }
     169|     }

      71|         const tmpFile = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ami_computer_${Date.now()}.py`);
      72|         try {
      73|             fs.writeFileSync(tmpFile, code, 'utf8');
      74|         }
      75|         catch (e) {
      76|             return Promise.resolve(`錯誤：無法建立暫存檔案 — ${e}`);
      77|         }
      78|         return new Promise(resolve => {
      79|             const cmds = process.platform === 'win32'
      80|                 ? ['py', 'python', 'python3']
      81|                 : ['python3', 'python'];
      82|             let tried = 0;
      83|             const tryNext = () => {
      84|                 if (tried >= cmds.length) {
      85|                     _cleanup(tmpFile);
      86|                     resolve('錯誤：找不到 Python（pip install pyautogui pillow mss）');
      87|                     return;
      88|                 }
      89|                 const c = cmds[tried++];
      90|                 (0, child_process_1.exec)(`${c} "${tmpFile}"`, { timeout: 20000 }, (err, stdout, stderr) => {
      91|                     if (err && err.code === 'ENOENT') {
      92|                         tryNext();
      93|                         return;
      94|                     }
      95|                     _cleanup(tmpFile);
      96|                     const out = (stdout || '').trim();
      97|                     const err2 = (stderr || '').trim();
      98|                     resolve(out || (err2 ? `[stderr] ${err2}` : '✅ 完成'));
      99|                 });
     100|             };
     101|             tryNext();
     102|         });
     103|     }
     104|     // ── computer_screenshot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
     105|     async _screenshot(args) {
     106|         const wsRoot = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [])[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? process.cwd();
     107|         const rawPath = args.save_path
     108|             || path.join(wsRoot, '.amiclaw', 'outputs', `screenshot_${Date.now()}.png`);
     109|         const savePath = rawPath.replace(/\\/g, '/'); // Python accepts forward slashes on Windows
     110|         const outputDir = path.dirname(rawPath);
     111|         try {
     112|             fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });
     113|         }
     114|         catch { /* ignore */ }
     115|         // Optional region: [left, top, width, height]
     116|         const region = args.region;
     117|         const regionArg = region && region.length === 4
     118|             ? `region=(${region[0]},${region[1]},${region[2]},${region[3]})`
     119|             : '';
     120|         const code = [
     121|             'import pyautogui',
     122|             `img = pyautogui.screenshot(${regionArg})`,
     123|             `img.save('${savePath}')`,
     124|             `print(f"Saved: ${savePath} ({img.width}x{img.height})")`,
     125|         ].join('\n');
     126|         const result = await this._pyauto(code);
     127|         return result.startsWith('錯誤') ? result : `📸 ${result}`;
     128|     }
     129|     // ── computer_type ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     130|     async _type(args, ctx) {
     131|         const text = String(args.text ?? '');
     132|         if (!text)
     133|             return 'text 為必填';
     134|         const allowed = await ctx.requestPermission('any', `電腦輸入文字（${text.slice(0, 40)}）`, 'computer_type');
     135|         if (!allowed)
     136|             return '使用者已拒絕';
     137|         const interval = Number(args.interval ?? 0.02);
     138|         // Use clipboard paste for unicode compatibility
     139|         const code = [
     140|             'import pyperclip, pyautogui',
     141|             `pyperclip.copy(${JSON.stringify(text)})`,
     142|             'pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "v")',
     143|             'print("done")',
     144|         ].join('\n');
     145|         // Fallback to typewrite if pyperclip unavailable
     146|         const fallback = [
     147|             'import pyautogui',
     148|             `pyautogui.write(${JSON.stringify(text)}, interval=${interval})`,
     149|             'print("done")',
     150|         ].join('\n');
     151|         const result = await this._pyauto(code);
     152|         if (result.includes('ModuleNotFoundError') || result.includes('No module')) {
     153|             return this._pyauto(fallback);
     154|         }
     155|         return result;
     156|     }
     157|     // ── computer_key ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     158|     async _key(args, ctx) {
     159|         const key = String(args.key ?? '').trim();
     160|         if (!key)
     161|             return 'key 為必填（例如 "enter", "ctrl+s", "alt+f4"）';
     162|         const allowed = await ctx.requestPermission('any', `按鍵: ${key}`, 'computer_key');
     163|         if (!allowed)
     164|             return '使用者已拒絕';

     168|             code = `import pyautogui\npyautogui.hotkey(${parts})\nprint("done")`;
     169|         }
     170|         else {
     171|             code = `import pyautogui\npyautogui.press(${JSON.stringify(key)})\nprint("done")`;
     172|         }
     173|         return this._pyauto(code);
     174|     }

     355|     static _collectImages(rootDir, limit) {
     356|         const exts = new Set(['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.webp', '.bmp', '.gif']);
     357|         const out = [];
     358|         const walk = (dir) => { if (out.length >= limit)
     359|             return; let entries; try {
     360|             entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
     361|         }
     362|         catch {
     363|             return;
     364|         } for (const e of entries) {
     365|             if (out.length >= limit)
     366|                 return;
     367|             const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
     368|             if (e.isDirectory()) {
     369|                 if (e.name.startsWith('.') || e.name === 'node_modules')
     370|                     continue;
     371|                 walk(full);
     372|             }
     373|             else if (exts.has(path.extname(e.name).toLowerCase()))
     374|                 out.push(full);
     375|         } };
     376|         walk(rootDir);
     377|         return out;
     378|     }

     382|     static _visionChat(baseUrl, model, prompt, imagesB64, timeoutMs) {
     383|         return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     384|             let url;
     385|             try {
     386|                 url = new url_1.URL('/api/chat', baseUrl);
     387|             }
     388|             catch {
     389|                 reject(new Error(`Ollama URL 無效: ${baseUrl}`));
     390|                 return;
     391|             }
     392|             const proto = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
     393|             const buf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ model, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt, images: imagesB64 }], stream: false, options: { temperature: 0 } }), 'utf8');
     394|             const opts = { hostname: url.hostname, port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434), path: url.pathname, method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': buf.length } };
     395|             const req = proto.request(opts, res => {
     396|                 let data = '';
     397|                 res.setEncoding('utf8');
     398|                 res.on('data', (d) => { data += d; });
     399|                 res.on('end', () => { try {
     400|                     const j = JSON.parse(data);
     401|                     if (j.error)
     402|                         reject(new Error(j.error));
     403|                     else
     404|                         resolve((j.message?.content ?? '').trim());
     405|                 }
     406|                 catch {
     407|                     reject(new Error(`回應解析失敗: ${data.slice(0, 200)}`));
     408|                 } });
     409|             });
     410|             req.on('error', (e) => reject(e));
     411|             req.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => { req.destroy(); reject(new Error(`Ollama 視覺推論逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`)); });
     412|             req.write(buf);
     413|             req.end();
     414|         });
     415|     }
     416|     static _extractJson(text) {
     417|         if (!text)
     418|             return null;
     419|         const fenced = text.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
     420|         const candidate = fenced ? fenced[1] : text;
     421|         const m = candidate.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
     422|         if (!m)
     423|             return null;
     424|         try {
     425|             return JSON.parse(m[0]);
     426|         }
     427|         catch {
     428|             return null;
     429|         }
     430|     }

      43|     const m = aLines.length, n = bLines.length;

     315|                 rl.on('error', reject);
     316|             });
     317|             const hdr = `📄 ${fpath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalLines.toLocaleString()} 行)${pattern ? `  pattern="${pattern}"` : ''}${startLine ? `  lines=${startLine}-${endLine ?? '∞'}` : ''}${head ? `  head=${head}` : ''}${tail ? `  tail=${tail}` : ''}  matched=${matched.length} 行\n`;
     318|             if (matched.length === 0)
     319|                 return hdr + '（無匹配行）';
     320|             let totalOut = 0;
     321|             const outputLines = matched.map(m => {
     322|                 totalOut += m.text.length + 1;
     323|                 const pct = totalLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo * 100 / totalLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
     324|                 return `${m.isContext ? '  ' : ''}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}`;
     325|             });
     326|             return hdr + outputLines.join('\n') + (totalOut > maxBytes ? `\n…（已達 ${maxKb}KB 上限）` : '');
     327|         }
     328|         catch (e) {
     329|             return `read_file_smart 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
     330|         }
     331|     }
     332|     // ── grep_file ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     333|     async _grepFile(args, ctx) {
     334|         const gfPath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(args.path);
     335|         const kws = Array.isArray(args.keywords) ? args.keywords.map(String).filter(Boolean) : [];
     336|         if (kws.length === 0)
     337|             return '錯誤：keywords 為空';
     338|         const gfCtx = args.context_lines ? Math.max(0, Number(args.context_lines)) : 3;
     339|         const maxPerKw = args.max_matches_per_kw ? Math.max(1, Number(args.max_matches_per_kw)) : 30;
     340|         const maxKb = args.max_kb ? Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_kb))) : 128;
     341|         const caseSens = args.case_sensitive === true;
     342|         const maxBytes = maxKb * 1024;
     343|         try {
     344|             const nodefs = require('fs');
     345|             const readline = require('readline');
     346|             let stat;
     347|             try {
     348|                 stat = nodefs.statSync(gfPath);
     349|             }
     350|             catch {
     351|                 return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${gfPath}`;
     352|             }
     353|             const fileSizeMb = (stat.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1);
     354|             const flag = caseSens ? '' : 'i';
     355|             const groups = kws.map(kw => ({ kw, re: new RegExp(kw, flag), matches: [], totalHits: 0, capped: false }));
     356|             const ring = [];
     357|             const pendingCtx = groups.map(() => new Set());
     358|             let totalFileLines = 0;
     359|             await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     360|                 const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: nodefs.createReadStream(gfPath, { encoding: 'utf8' }), crlfDelay: Infinity });
     361|                 let lineNo = 0;
     362|                 rl.on('line', (line) => {
     363|                     lineNo++;
     364|                     for (let gi = 0; gi < groups.length; gi++) {
     365|                         const g = groups[gi];
     366|                         if (pendingCtx[gi].has(lineNo)) {
     367|                             pendingCtx[gi].delete(lineNo);
     368|                             if (!g.re.test(line) && !g.matches.find(m => m.lineNo === lineNo))
     369|                                 g.matches.push({ lineNo, text: line, isCtx: true });
     370|                         }
     371|                         if (g.re.test(line)) {
     372|                             g.totalHits++;
     373|                             if (!g.capped) {
     374|                                 if (g.totalHits <= maxPerKw) {
     375|                                     if (gfCtx > 0) {
     376|                                         const rs = Math.max(0, ring.length - gfCtx);
     377|                                         for (let ri = rs; ri < ring.length; ri++) {
     378|                                             const cn = lineNo - (ring.length - ri);
     379|                                             if (cn >= 1 && !g.matches.find(m => m.lineNo === cn))
     380|                                                 g.matches.push({ lineNo: cn, text: ring[ri], isCtx: true });
     381|                                         }
     382|                                     }
     383|                                     const ex = g.matches.findIndex(m => m.lineNo === lineNo);
     384|                                     if (ex !== -1)
     385|                                         g.matches.splice(ex, 1);
     386|                                     g.matches.push({ lineNo, text: line, isCtx: false });
     387|                                     for (let j = 1; j <= gfCtx; j++)
     388|                                         pendingCtx[gi].add(lineNo + j);
     389|                                 }
     390|                                 else {
     391|                                     g.capped = true;
     392|                                 }
     393|                             }
     394|                         }
     395|                     }
     396|                     ring.push(line);
     397|                     if (ring.length > gfCtx + 1)
     398|                         ring.shift();
     399|                 });
     400|                 rl.on('close', () => { totalFileLines = lineNo; resolve(); });
     401|                 rl.on('error', reject);
     402|             });
     403|             const allHits = groups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.totalHits, 0);
     404|             const hdr = `📄 ${gfPath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalFileLines.toLocaleString()} 行)\n🔍 Keywords: ${kws.map(k => `"${k}"`).join(', ')}  |  context=${gfCtx}  |  total hits: ${allHits}\n`;
     405|             const sections = [];
     406|             let outBytes = hdr.length;
     407|             for (const g of groups) {
     408|                 if (outBytes >= maxBytes) {
     409|                     sections.push(`…（已達 ${maxKb}KB 上限）`);
     410|                     break;
     411|                 }
     412|                 const sorted = g.matches.sort((a, b) => a.lineNo - b.lineNo);
     413|                 const deduped = [];
     414|                 for (const m of sorted) {
     415|                     if (!deduped.length || deduped[deduped.length - 1].lineNo !== m.lineNo)
     416|                         deduped.push(m);
     417|                     else if (!m.isCtx)
     418|                         deduped[deduped.length - 1].isCtx = false;
     419|                 }
     420|                 const capNote = g.capped ? ` (顯示前 ${maxPerKw}，共 ${g.totalHits} 處)` : ` (${g.totalHits} 處)`;
     421|                 let section = `\n━━━ "${g.kw}" ${g.totalHits === 0 ? '— 無匹配' : capNote} ━━━\n`;
     422|                 if (deduped.length === 0) {
     423|                     section += '（無匹配行）\n';
     424|                 }
     425|                 else {
     426|                     const matchNos = deduped.filter(m => !m.isCtx).map(m => m.lineNo);
     427|                     if (matchNos.length > 0)
     428|                         section += `   📍 分布位置：${matchNos.map(n => `${(n * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%`).join(', ')}\n`;
     429|                     let prev = -999;
     430|                     for (const m of deduped) {
     431|                         if (m.lineNo > prev + 1 && prev !== -999)
     432|                             section += '   ——\n';
     433|                         const pct = totalFileLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
     434|                         section += `${m.isCtx ? '  ' : '▶ '}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}\n`;
     435|                         prev = m.lineNo;
     436|                     }
     437|                 }
     438|                 if (outBytes + section.length > maxBytes) {
     439|                     section = section.slice(0, maxBytes - outBytes) + '\n…（截斷）\n';
     440|                 }
     441|                 sections.push(section);
     442|                 outBytes += section.length;
     443|             }
     444|             return hdr + sections.join('');
     445|         }
     446|         catch (e) {
     447|             return `grep_file 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
     448|         }
     449|     }
     450|     // ── read_files ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     451|     async _readFiles(args, ctx) {
     452|         const rawPaths = Array.isArray(args.paths) ? args.paths.map(String).filter(Boolean) : [];
     453|         if (rawPaths.length === 0)
     454|             return '錯誤：paths 為空陣列';
     455|         const MAX_FILES = 30;
     456|         const maxPerKb = Math.max(1, args.max_per_file_kb || 64) * 1024;
     457|         const maxTotalKb = Math.max(1, args.max_total_kb || 256) * 1024;
     458|         const truncated = rawPaths.slice(0, MAX_FILES);
     459|         const overflow = rawPaths.length > MAX_FILES ? rawPaths.length - MAX_FILES : 0;
     460|         const parts = [];
     461|         let totalBytes = 0;
     462|         const summary = [];
     463|         for (const p of truncated) {
     464|             if (totalBytes >= maxTotalKb) {
     465|                 summary.push(`⚠️ 已達總量上限 ${(maxTotalKb / 1024)}KB，後續檔案跳過`);
     466|                 break;
     467|             }
     468|             const fpath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(p);
     469|             try {
     470|                 const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
     471|                 let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
     472|                 if (text.length > maxPerKb) {
     473|                     text = text.slice(0, maxPerKb) + `\n…（${path.basename(fpath)} 已截斷 ${Math.round(maxPerKb / 1024)}KB）`;
     474|                 }
     475|                 parts.push(`=== ${fpath} ===\n${text}`);
     476|                 totalBytes += text.length;
     477|             }
     478|             catch {
     479|                 parts.push(`=== ${fpath} ===\n錯誤：找不到或無法讀取`);
     480|             }
     481|         }
     482|         if (overflow > 0)
     483|             summary.push(`⚠️ paths 數量超過上限 ${MAX_FILES}，未處理 ${overflow} 個檔案。`);
     484|         return summary.join('\n') + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n');
     485|     }
     486|     // ── write_file ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     487|     async _writeFile(args, ctx) {
     488|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path);
     489|         const content = args.content ?? '';
     490|         let before = '';
     491|         try {
     492|             before = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
     493|         }
     494|         catch { /* new file */ }
     495|         const diff = { filePath: fpath, before, after: content, mode: 'write' };
     496|         if (!await ctx.requestPermission('write', `寫入檔案: ${path.basename(fpath)}（${content.length} 字元）`, 'write_file', diff))
     497|             return '使用者已拒絕寫入操作';
     498|         await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(content, 'utf8'));
     499|         ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
     500|         const wfStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(before, content, fpath);
     501|         ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'write', ts: Date.now(), ...wfStats });
     502|         return `已寫入 ${fpath}（${content.length} 字元）`;
     503|     }
     504|     // ── replace_in_file ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     505|     async _replaceInFile(args, ctx) {
     506|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path);
     507|         const original = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
     508|         const oldStr = args.old_str;
     509|         const newStr = args.new_str ?? '';
     510|         if (!original.includes(oldStr))
     511|             return `錯誤：在 ${fpath} 中找不到指定的字串`;
     512|         const after = original.replace(oldStr, newStr);
     513|         const diff = { filePath: fpath, before: original, after, mode: 'replace', oldStr, newStr };
     514|         if (!await ctx.requestPermission('write', `編輯檔案: ${path.basename(fpath)}`, 'replace_in_file', diff))
     515|             return '使用者已拒絕編輯操作';
     516|         await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(after, 'utf8'));
     517|         ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
     518|         const rifStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(original, after, fpath);
     519|         ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'replace', ts: Date.now(), ...rifStats });
     520|         return `已更新 ${fpath}`;
     521|     }
     522|     // ── insert_in_file ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     523|     async _insertInFile(args, ctx) {
     524|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path);
     525|         const lineNum = Math.max(0, Number(args.line) || 0);
     526|         const content = args.content ?? '';
     527|         let original;
     528|         try {
     529|             original = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
     530|         }
     531|         catch {
     532|             return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`;
     533|         }
     534|         const lineEnding = original.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n';
     535|         const lines = original.split(/\r?\n/);
     536|         if (lineNum > lines.length)
     537|             return `錯誤：行號 ${lineNum} 超過檔案總行數 ${lines.length}`;
     538|         const insertLines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
     539|         lines.splice(lineNum, 0, ...insertLines);
     540|         const newContent = lines.join(lineEnding);
     541|         const diff = { filePath: fpath, before: original, after: newContent, mode: 'replace', oldStr: '', newStr: content };
     542|         if (!await ctx.requestPermission('write', `插入檔案: ${path.basename(fpath)} 第 ${lineNum} 行後（${insertLines.length} 行）`, 'insert_in_file', diff))
     543|             return '使用者已拒絕插入操作';
     544|         await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(newContent, 'utf8'));
     545|         ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
     546|         const ifStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(original, newContent, fpath);
     547|         ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'insert', ts: Date.now(), ...ifStats });
     548|         return `已在 ${fpath} 第 ${lineNum} 行後插入 ${insertLines.length} 行`;
     549|     }
     550|     // ── replace_all_in_file ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     551|     async _replaceAllInFile(args, ctx) {
     552|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path || '');
     553|         const oldStr = args.old_str;
     554|         const newStr = args.new_str;
     555|         if (!fpath || oldStr === undefined)
     556|             return '請提供 path、old_str、new_str 參數';
     557|         if (!await ctx.requestPermission('write', `全部取代 in ${fpath}: "${oldStr.slice(0, 40)}"`, 'replace_all_in_file'))
     558|             return '使用者已拒絕操作';
     559|         const original = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
     560|         if (!original.includes(oldStr))
     561|             return `找不到字串: "${oldStr.slice(0, 60)}" 於 ${fpath}`;
     562|         const count = original.split(oldStr).length - 1;
     563|         const raUpdated = original.split(oldStr).join(newStr);
     564|         await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(raUpdated, 'utf8'));
     565|         ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
     566|         const raStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(original, raUpdated, fpath);
     567|         ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'replace', ts: Date.now(), ...raStats });
     568|         return `已取代 ${count} 處於 ${fpath}`;
     569|     }
     570|     // ── batch_replace ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     571|     async _batchReplace(args, ctx) {
     572|         const brPattern = args.pattern;
     573|         const brReplace = args.replace;
     574|         const brGlob = args.include || '**/*';
     575|         const brFlags = (args.flags || 'g').includes('g') ? (args.flags || 'g') : (args.flags || 'g') + 'g';
     576|         if (!brPattern || brReplace === undefined)
     577|             return '請提供 pattern 與 replace 參數';
     578|         if (!await ctx.requestPermission('write', `批次取代: /${brPattern}/ → "${brReplace.slice(0, 40)}" (${brGlob})`, 'batch_replace'))
     579|             return '使用者已拒絕操作';
     580|         let brRe;
     581|         try {
     582|             brRe = new RegExp(brPattern, brFlags);
     583|         }
     584|         catch (e) {
     585|             return `正規表達式錯誤: ${e}`;
     586|         }
     587|         const uris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(new vscode.RelativePattern(ctx.wsRoot, brGlob), '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**}', 2000);
     588|         const results = [];
     589|         let total = 0;
     590|         for (const uri of uris) {
     591|             try {
     592|                 const original = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri)).toString('utf8');
     593|                 const updated = original.replace(brRe, brReplace);
     594|                 if (updated !== original) {
     595|                     await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(uri, Buffer.from(updated, 'utf8'));
     596|                     ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${uri.fsPath}`);
     597|                     const brStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(original, updated, uri.fsPath);
     598|                     ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: uri.fsPath, op: 'replace', ts: Date.now(), ...brStats });
     599|                     results.push(`  ${path.relative(ctx.wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/')}  (${(original.match(new RegExp(brPattern, brFlags)) || []).length} 處)`);
     600|                     total++;
     601|                 }
     602|             }
     603|             catch { /* skip binary */ }
     604|         }
     605|         return total === 0 ? `找不到符合的內容 (/${brPattern}/ in ${brGlob})` : `批次取代完成，共修改 ${total} 個檔案:\n${results.join('\n')}`;
     606|     }
     607|     // ── glob ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     608|     async _glob(args, ctx) {
     609|         const globPattern = args.pattern || '**/*';
     610|         const globRoot = args.root ? ctx.resolvePath(args.root) : ctx.wsRoot;
     611|         const globLimit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.limit) || 200, 1), 5000);
     612|         try {
     613|             const relPattern = path.isAbsolute(globPattern) ? path.relative(globRoot, globPattern) : globPattern;
     614|             const uris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(new vscode.RelativePattern(globRoot, relPattern), '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**,**/build/**,**/__pycache__/**}', globLimit);
     615|             if (uris.length === 0)
     616|                 return '(no matches)';
     617|             const sorted = uris.map(u => path.relative(globRoot, u.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/')).sort();
     618|             return sorted.join('\n') + `\n\n共 ${sorted.length} 個檔案`;
     619|         }
     620|         catch (e) {
     621|             return `glob 錯誤: ${e}`;
     622|         }
     623|     }
     624|     // ── outline_file ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     625|     async _outlineFile(args, ctx) {
     626|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path);
     627|         let bytes;
     628|         try {
     629|             bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
     630|         }
     631|         catch {
     632|             return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`;
     633|         }
     634|         const text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8').slice(0, 200000);
     635|         const lines = text.split('\n');
     636|         const ext = path.extname(fpath).toLowerCase();
     637|         const isCLike = ['.c', '.h', '.cpp', '.cc', '.cxx'].includes(ext);
     638|         const isUefi = ['.inf', '.dec', '.dsc', '.fdf'].includes(ext);
     639|         const results = [];
     640|         if (isUefi) {
     641|             for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
     642|                 const m = /^\[([A-Za-z][\w.]+)\]/.exec(lines[i]);
     643|                 if (m)
     644|                     results.push(`L${i + 1}  [${m[1]}]`);
     645|             }
     646|         }
     647|         else if (isCLike) {
     648|             const re = /^(?:[A-Z_a-z][\w*]+\s+)+(?:EFIAPI\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(|^typedef\s+.*?(\w+)\s*;|^(?:typedef\s+)?(?:struct|union|enum)\s+(\w+)|^#define\s+(\w+)/;
     649|             for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
     650|                 const m = re.exec(lines[i]);
     651|                 if (m) {
     652|                     const n = m[1] || m[2] || m[3] || m[4];
     653|                     if (n)
     654|                         results.push(`L${i + 1}  ${lines[i].trim().slice(0, 80)}`);
     655|                 }
     656|             }
     657|         }
     658|         else {
     659|             const re = /^\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:(?:async\s+)?function\*?\s+([\w$]+)|class\s+([\w$]+)|interface\s+([\w$]+)|type\s+([\w$]+)\s*(?:<[^>]*>)?\s*=|(?:const|let|var)\s+([\w$]+)\s*(?::[^=]+)?=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\([^)]*\)|[\w$]+)\s*=>|def\s+([\w_]+)|func\s+([\w_]+)\s*\(|public\s+(?:static\s+)?\S+\s+([\w_]+)\s*\()/;
     660|             for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
     661|                 const m = re.exec(lines[i]);
     662|                 if (m) {
     663|                     const n = m.slice(1).find(Boolean);
     664|                     if (n)
     665|                         results.push(`L${i + 1}  ${n}`);
     666|                 }
     667|             }
     668|         }
     669|         return results.length === 0 ? `${fpath}\n(未偵測到宣告)` : `=== ${path.basename(fpath)} 宣告摘要 (${results.length} 項) ===\n${results.join('\n')}`;
     670|     }
     671|     // ── todo_write ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     672|     async _todoWrite(args, ctx) {
     673|         const item = (args.item || '').trim();
     674|         if (!item)
     675|             return '請提供 item 參數';
     676|         const checked = !!args.checked;
     677|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path || 'TODO.md');
     678|         let text = '';
     679|         try {
     680|             text = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
     681|         }
     682|         catch {
     683|             text = '# TODO\n';
     684|         }
     685|         const unc = `- [ ] ${item}`, chk = `- [x] ${item}`, target = checked ? chk : unc;
     686|         let updated = text;
     687|         if (text.includes(unc) && checked)
     688|             updated = text.replace(unc, chk);
     689|         else if (!text.includes(target))
     690|             updated = text.trimEnd() + `\n${target}\n`;
     691|         else
     692|             return `無需更改 ${fpath}`;
     693|         await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(updated, 'utf8'));
     694|         ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
     695|         const twStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(text, updated, fpath);

     697|         return `已更新 ${fpath}: ${target}`;

     709|     // ── memory_write ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     710|     async _memoryWrite(args, ctx) {
     711|         const title = (args.title || '').trim();
     712|         const content = (args.content || '').trim();
     713|         const action = (args.action || 'append');
     714|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path || 'MEMORY.md');
     715|         if (!title && action !== 'replace')
     716|             return '請提供 title 參數';
     717|         let text = '';
     718|         try {
     719|             text = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
     720|         }
     721|         catch {
     722|             text = '# Memory\n';
     723|         }
     724|         const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
     725|         let updated = text;
     726|         if (action === 'delete') {
     727|             updated = text.replace(new RegExp(`## ${title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}[\\s\\S]*?(?=\n## |$)`, 'g'), '').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
     728|         }
     729|         else if (action === 'replace') {
     730|             updated = `# Memory\n${content}\n`;
     731|         }
     732|         else {
     733|             const entry = `\n## ${title}\n> ${ts}\n\n${content}\n`;
     734|             if (!text.includes(`## ${title}`))
     735|                 updated = text.trimEnd() + entry;
     736|             else {
     737|                 const re = new RegExp(`(## ${title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')})[\\s\\S]*?(?=\n## |$)`);
     738|                 updated = text.replace(re, `$1\n> ${ts}\n\n${content}\n`);
     739|             }
     740|         }
     741|         await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath), Buffer.from(updated, 'utf8'));
     742|         ctx.cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
     743|         const mwStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(text, updated, fpath);
     744|         ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: fpath, op: 'write', ts: Date.now(), ...mwStats });
     745|         return `已更新記憶：${fpath}（${action}）`;
     746|     }

     784|     // ── diff_files ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     785|     async _diffFiles(args, ctx) {
     786|         const dfA = ctx.resolvePath(args.a || args.path_a || '');
     787|         const dfB = ctx.resolvePath(args.b || args.path_b || '');
     788|         if (!dfA || !dfB)
     789|             return '請提供 a 與 b 參數';
     790|         try {
     791|             const [bytesA, bytesB] = await Promise.all([vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(dfA)), vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(dfB))]);
     792|             const linesA = Buffer.from(bytesA).toString('utf8').split('\n');
     793|             const linesB = Buffer.from(bytesB).toString('utf8').split('\n');
     794|             const diff = computeUnifiedDiff(linesA, linesB, path.relative(ctx.wsRoot, dfA), path.relative(ctx.wsRoot, dfB), Number(args.context) || 3);
     795|             return diff || '（兩個檔案完全相同）';
     796|         }
     797|         catch (e) {
     798|             return `diff_files 錯誤: ${e}`;
     799|         }
     800|     }
     801|     // ── file_info ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     802|     async _fileInfo(args, ctx) {
     803|         const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path || '');
     804|         if (!fpath)
     805|             return '請提供 path 參數';
     806|         try {
     807|             const [stat, bytes] = await Promise.all([vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath)), vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))]);
     808|             const buf = Buffer.from(bytes);
     809|             let encoding = 'UTF-8';
     810|             if (buf[0] === 0xEF && buf[1] === 0xBB && buf[2] === 0xBF)
     811|                 encoding = 'UTF-8 BOM';
     812|             else if (buf[0] === 0xFF && buf[1] === 0xFE)
     813|                 encoding = 'UTF-16 LE BOM';
     814|             else if (buf[0] === 0xFE && buf[1] === 0xFF)
     815|                 encoding = 'UTF-16 BE BOM';
     816|             const text = buf.toString('utf8');
     817|             const lineCount = text.split('\n').length;
     818|             const crlf = (text.match(/\r\n/g) || []).length;
     819|             const lf = (text.match(/(?<!\r)\n/g) || []).length;
     820|             const mtime = new Date(stat.mtime).toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
     821|             return [`路徑: ${fpath}`, `類型: ${(stat.type & vscode.FileType.Directory) ? '目錄' : '檔案'}`, `大小: ${stat.size} bytes (${(stat.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`, `行數: ${lineCount}`, `行尾: ${crlf > lf ? 'CRLF' : 'LF'} (CRLF:${crlf} / LF:${lf})`, `編碼: ${encoding}`, `修改時間: ${mtime} UTC`].join('\n');
     822|         }
     823|         catch (e) {
     824|             return `file_info 錯誤: ${e}`;
     825|         }
     826|     }
     827|     // ── list_dir ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     828|     async _listDir(args, ctx) {
     829|         const dirArg = args.path || '';
     830|         const ldKey = `ld:${dirArg}`;
     831|         const cached = ctx.cache.get(ldKey);
     832|         if (cached !== undefined)
     833|             return cached;
     834|         let result;
     835|         if (!dirArg && ctx.folders.length > 1) {
     836|             const parts = [];
     837|             for (const f of ctx.folders) {
     838|                 const entries = await vscode.workspace.fs.readDirectory(f.uri);
     839|                 parts.push(`=== ${f.uri.fsPath} ===\n${entries.map(([n, t]) => t === vscode.FileType.Directory ? n + '/' : n).sort().join('\n')}`);
     840|             }
     841|             result = parts.join('\n\n');
     842|         }
     843|         else {
     844|             const entries = await vscode.workspace.fs.readDirectory(vscode.Uri.file(ctx.resolvePath(dirArg)));
     845|             result = entries.map(([n, t]) => t === vscode.FileType.Directory ? n + '/' : n).sort().join('\n');
     846|         }
     847|         ctx.cache.set(ldKey, result);
     848|         return result;
     849|     }

     866|     // ── read_workspace ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     867|     async _readWorkspace(args, ctx) {
     868|         const include = args.include || '**/*.{ts,js,tsx,jsx,py,cs,java,go,rs,cpp,c,h,inf,dec,dsc,fdf,uni,nasm,asm,asl,md,json,yaml,yml,txt}';
     869|         const extraExclude = (args.exclude || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
     870|         const excludeGlob = '{' + ['**/node_modules/**', '**/.git/**', '**/dist/**', '**/out/**', '**/build/**', '**/.next/**', '**/__pycache__/**', '**/*.min.js', '**/*.map', ...extraExclude].join(',') + '}';
     871|         const maxFileBytes = Math.max(1, args.max_file_kb || 128) * 1024;
     872|         const maxTotalBytes = Math.max(1, args.max_total_kb || 512) * 1024;
     873|         const offset = Math.max(0, Number(args.offset) || 0);
     874|         const allUris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(include, excludeGlob, 2000);
     875|         const binaryExts = new Set(['.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.ico', '.webp', '.bmp', '.vsix', '.zip', '.tar', '.gz', '.exe', '.dll', '.so', '.dylib', '.wasm', '.pdf', '.db', '.sqlite']);
     876|         const candidates = allUris.filter(u => !binaryExts.has(path.extname(u.fsPath).toLowerCase()));
     877|         const sliced = candidates.slice(offset);
     878|         const parts = [];
     879|         let totalBytes = 0;
     880|         let truncated = false;
     881|         let processed = 0;
     882|         for (const uri of sliced) {
     883|             processed++;
     884|             if (processed % 10 === 0)
     885|                 ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentStepProgress', text: `📂 read_workspace 進度 ${processed}/${sliced.length} (≈${Math.round(totalBytes / 1024)}KB)` });
     886|             let content;
     887|             try {
     888|                 const raw = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri));
     889|                 content = raw.length > maxFileBytes ? raw.toString('utf8', 0, maxFileBytes) + `\n…（已截斷，原始檔案 ${Math.round(raw.length / 1024)} KB）` : raw.toString('utf8');
     890|             }
     891|             catch {
     892|                 continue;
     893|             }
     894|             const entry = `### ${vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(uri)}\n\`\`\`\n${content}\n\`\`\``;
     895|             if (totalBytes + Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8') > maxTotalBytes) {
     896|                 truncated = true;
     897|                 processed--;
     898|                 break;
     899|             }
     900|             totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8');
     901|             parts.push(entry);
     902|         }
     903|         const nextOffset = offset + processed;
     904|         const remaining = Math.max(0, candidates.length - nextOffset);
     905|         const header = `工作區共 ${candidates.length} 個檔案，本批讀取 ${parts.length} 個（offset=${offset}→${nextOffset}，合計 ≈${Math.round(totalBytes / 1024)} KB）${truncated ? '，已達容量上限提早停止' : ''}`;
     906|         const hint = remaining > 0 ? `\n💡 剩餘 ${remaining} 個檔案未讀取，如需繼續請再次呼叫 read_workspace 並使用 offset=${nextOffset}。` : '\n✅ 所有符合條件的檔案已讀取完畢。';
     907|         return header + hint + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n\n');
     908|     }
     909| }

     216|     async _status(args, ctx) {
     217|         const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
     218|         if (cfg.get('jenkinsUseVscodeCommand', true)) {
     219|             const cmdId = cfg.get('jenkinsHistoryCommand', 'visualebios.jenkins.showBuildHistory');
     220|             const allowed = await ctx.requestPermission('read', `透過 VS Code 外掛查詢 Jenkins 狀態: ${cmdId}`, 'jenkins_status');
     221|             if (!allowed)
     222|                 return '使用者已拒絕 Jenkins Status';
     223|             try {
     224|                 const all = await vscode.commands.getCommands(true);
     225|                 if (!all.includes(cmdId))
     226|                     return `❌ 找不到 VS Code 指令 "${cmdId}"。請確認 VisualeBios 外掛已安裝。`;
     227|                 const ret = await vscode.commands.executeCommand(cmdId);
     228|                 return `✅ 已透過 VS Code 外掛查詢 Jenkins 狀態: ${cmdId}${ret !== undefined ? `\n回傳: ${typeof ret === 'string' ? ret : JSON.stringify(ret).slice(0, 500)}` : '\n（建置歷史已開啟在 VS Code 視窗中）'}`;
     229|             }
     230|             catch (e) {
     231|                 return `❌ 執行 VS Code 指令 "${cmdId}" 失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
     232|             }
     233|         }
     234|         const base = cfg.get('jenkinsUrl', 'http://localdev.visualebios').replace(/\/+$/, '');
     235|         const user = cfg.get('jenkinsUser', '').trim();
     236|         const tok = cfg.get('jenkinsToken', '').trim();
     237|         const job = (args.job || cfg.get('jenkinsDefaultJob', 'SeamlessBuild')).trim();
     238|         const bNum = args.build_number ? String(args.build_number) : 'lastBuild';
     239|         const inclLog = args.include_log !== false;
     240|         const logLines = Math.min(Number(args.log_lines || 100), 500);
     241|         const auth = (user && tok) ? 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(`${user}:${tok}`).toString('base64') : '';
     242|         const jr = await this._http(`${base}/job/${encodeURIComponent(job)}/${bNum}/api/json`, 'GET', auth);
     243|         if (jr.status === 0)
     244|             return `無法連線 Jenkins: ${jr.body}`;
     245|         if (jr.status === 404)
     246|             return `找不到 Jenkins Job "${job}" 或 Build #${bNum}`;
     247|         if (jr.status >= 400)
     248|             return `Jenkins 查詢失敗 HTTP ${jr.status}: ${jr.body.slice(0, 300)}`;
     249|         let info = jr.body.slice(0, 2000);
     250|         try {
     251|             const j = JSON.parse(jr.body);
     252|             info = [`Job: ${job} #${j.number ?? bNum}`, `狀態: ${j.result ?? '進行中'}`, `時間: ${j.timestamp ? new Date(j.timestamp).toLocaleString() : 'N/A'}`, j.duration ? `耗時: ${Math.round(Number(j.duration) / 1000)}s` : '', `URL: ${j.url ?? ''}`].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
     253|         }
     254|         catch { /* use raw */ }
     255|         if (!inclLog)
     256|             return info;
     257|         const lr = await this._http(`${base}/job/${encodeURIComponent(job)}/${bNum}/logText/progressiveText?start=0`, 'GET', auth);
     258|         const log = lr.status === 200 ? lr.body.split('\n').slice(-logLines).join('\n').slice(0, 8000) : '(無法取得 log)';
     259|         return `${info}\n\n=== Console Log (後 ${logLines} 行) ===\n${log}`;
     260|     }

      87|         const filePath = String(args.path ?? '');
      88|         if (!filePath)
      89|             return 'path 為必填';
      90|         const includeDecl = args.include_declaration !== false;
      91|         try {
      92|             const locs = await vscode.commands.executeCommand('vscode.executeReferenceProvider', this._toUri(filePath, ctx), this._pos(args.line, args.col), { includeDeclaration: includeDecl }) ?? [];
      93|             if (!locs.length)
      94|                 return '找不到參考';
      95|             const lines = locs.map(loc => `${vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(loc.uri)}:${loc.range.start.line + 1}:${loc.range.start.character + 1}`);
      96|             return `共 ${lines.length} 個參考：\n${lines.join('\n')}`;
      97|         }
      98|         catch (e) {
      99|             return `LSP 錯誤：${e}`;
     100|         }
     101|     }
     102|     // ── lsp_hover ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     103|     async _hover(args, ctx) {
     104|         const filePath = String(args.path ?? '');
     105|         if (!filePath)
     106|             return 'path 為必填';
     107|         try {
     108|             const hovers = await vscode.commands.executeCommand('vscode.executeHoverProvider', this._toUri(filePath, ctx), this._pos(args.line, args.col)) ?? [];
     109|             if (!hovers.length)
     110|                 return '無 hover 資訊（語言伺服器未回應或游標位置無 symbol）';
     111|             const text = hovers
     112|                 .flatMap(h => h.contents.map(c => (typeof c === 'string' ? c : c.value)))
     113|                 .join('\n---\n');
     114|             return text.slice(0, 4000);
     115|         }
     116|         catch (e) {
     117|             return `LSP 錯誤：${e}`;
     118|         }
     119|     }
     120|     // ── lsp_diagnostics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     121|     async _diagnostics(args, ctx) {
     122|         const filePath = String(args.path ?? '');
     123|         const severityFilter = String(args.severity ?? 'all');
     124|         const SNAME = ['ERROR', 'WARNING', 'INFO', 'HINT'];
     125|         const minSev = severityFilter === 'error' ? 0 : severityFilter === 'warning' ? 1 : 4;
     126|         let pairs;
     127|         if (filePath) {
     128|             const uri = this._toUri(filePath, ctx);
     129|             pairs = [[uri, vscode.languages.getDiagnostics(uri)]];
     130|         }
     131|         else {
     132|             pairs = vscode.languages.getDiagnostics();
     133|         }
     134|         const lines = [];
     135|         for (const [uri, diags] of pairs) {
     136|             const rel = vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(uri);
     137|             for (const d of diags) {
     138|                 if (d.severity > minSev)
     139|                     continue; // lower number = higher severity
     140|                 lines.push(`${rel}:${d.range.start.line + 1} [${SNAME[d.severity] ?? 'HINT'}] ${d.message}`);
     141|             }
     142|         }
     143|         if (!lines.length)
     144|             return '無診斷問題 ✓';
     145|         return lines.slice(0, 300).join('\n');
     146|     }
     147|     // ── lsp_rename_symbol ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     148|     async _renameSymbol(args, ctx) {
     149|         const filePath = String(args.path ?? '');
     150|         const newName = String(args.new_name ?? '').trim();
     151|         if (!filePath)
     152|             return 'path 為必填';
     153|         if (!newName)
     154|             return 'new_name 為必填';
     155|         const allowed = await ctx.requestPermission('write', `LSP 重新命名 symbol → "${newName}"（影響多個檔案）`, 'lsp_rename_symbol');
     156|         if (!allowed)
     157|             return '操作已取消';
     158|         try {
     159|             const edit = await vscode.commands.executeCommand('vscode.executeDocumentRenameProvider', this._toUri(filePath, ctx), this._pos(args.line, args.col), newName);
     160|             if (!edit || edit.size === 0)
     161|                 return '找不到可重新命名的 symbol（語言伺服器未回應）';
     162|             await vscode.workspace.applyEdit(edit);
     163|             const affected = Array.from(edit.entries()).map(([u]) => vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(u));
     164|             return `已重新命名，共影響 ${affected.length} 個檔案：\n${affected.join('\n')}`;
     165|         }
     166|         catch (e) {
     167|             return `LSP 錯誤：${e}`;
     168|         }
     169|     }
     170|     // ── lsp_document_symbols ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
     171|     async _documentSymbols(args, ctx) {
     172|         const filePath = String(args.path ?? '');
     173|         if (!filePath)
     174|             return 'path 為必填';
     175|         try {
     176|             const symbols = await vscode.commands.executeCommand('vscode.executeDocumentSymbolProvider', this._toUri(filePath, ctx)) ?? [];
     177|             if (!symbols.length)
     178|                 return '找不到 symbol（語言伺服器尚未啟動或不支援此檔案類型）';
     179|             const kindName = (k) => vscode.SymbolKind[k] ?? 'Unknown';
     180|             const lines = [];
     181|             const isDocSym = (s) => s.children !== undefined;
     182|             const flatten = (syms, depth) => {
     183|                 for (const s of syms) {
     184|                     lines.push(`${'  '.repeat(depth)}${kindName(s.kind)} ${s.name}  L${s.range.start.line + 1}`);
     185|                     if (s.children.length)
     186|                         flatten(s.children, depth + 1);
     187|                 }
     188|             };
     189|             if (isDocSym(symbols[0])) {
     190|                 flatten(symbols, 0);
     191|             }
     192|             else {
     193|                 for (const s of symbols) {
     194|                     lines.push(`${kindName(s.kind)} ${s.name}  ${vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(s.location.uri)}:L${s.location.range.start.line + 1}`);
     195|                 }
     196|             }
     197|             return lines.slice(0, 500).join('\n');
     198|         }
     199|         catch (e) {
     200|             return `LSP 錯誤：${e}`;
     201|         }
     202|     }

     254|                         if (_e && _e.code === 'ENOENT') {

     260|                 };
     261|                 tryNext();
     262|             });
     263|         }
     264|         finally {
     265|             try {

     146|                 score += keywords.reduce((s, kw) => s + Math.min((cl.match(new RegExp(kw.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g')) || []).length, 5), 0);
     147|                 score += decls.reduce((s, d) => s + keywords.reduce((ss, kw) => ss + (d.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ? 4 : 0), 0), 0);
     148|             }
     149|             catch { /* skip binary */ }
     150|             if (score > 0 || decls.length > 0)
     151|                 scores.push({ rel, score, decls });
     152|         }
     153|         scores.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
     154|         const top = scores.slice(0, afTopK);
     155|         if (top.length === 0)
     156|             return `找不到與「${afQuery}」相關的檔案`;
     157|         return `=== 語意搜尋「${afQuery}」結果 (前 ${top.length}/${scores.length} 個相關檔案) ===\n${top.map((f, i) => `${i + 1}. ${f.rel} (相關度:${f.score})${f.decls.length > 0 ? `\n  宣告: ${f.decls.slice(0, 20).join(', ')}${f.decls.length > 20 ? ` …(+${f.decls.length - 20})` : ''}` : ''}`).join('\n')}`;
     158|     }
     159| }

     107|             item.done = true;
     108|             ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [...this._todos] });
     109|             return `✅ Todo #${id} 已完成: ${item.text}`;
     110|         }
     111|         if (action === 'clear') {
     112|             this._todos = [];
     113|             ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [] });
     114|             return 'Todo 清單已清空';
     115|         }
     116|         if (this._todos.length === 0)
     117|             return 'Todo 清單是空的，請先用 add 新增任務';
     118|         return this._todos.map(t => `${t.done ? '✅' : '⏳'} #${t.id}: ${t.text}`).join('\n');
     119|     }
     120| }
