     812|       function inferProviderFromModelId(modelId) {
     813|         if (!modelId) return 'ollama';
     814|         if (modelId.indexOf('copilot::') === 0 || modelId.indexOf('copilot/') === 0) return 'copilot';
     815|         if (modelId.indexOf('openai::') === 0) return 'openai';
     816|         return 'ollama';
     817|       }
     818| 
     819|       // 判斷模型是否支援 thinking（與 ollama-chat.ts 的 supportsThinking 邏輯保持同步）
     820|       // 注意：本檔位於 TS template literal 內，regex 中的反斜線需用 \\ 雙跳脫
     821|       function modelSupportsThinking(modelId, label) {
     822|         function check(s) {
     823|           if (!s) return false;
     824|           var raw = String(s).toLowerCase();
     825|           // strip provider prefixes and ollama multi-server encoding
     826|           raw = raw.replace(/^copilot::/, '');
     827|           if (raw.indexOf('openai::') === 0) { var pp = raw.indexOf('||'); raw = pp !== -1 ? raw.slice(pp + 2) : raw.slice(8); }
     828|           var sp = raw.indexOf('||'); if (sp !== -1) raw = raw.slice(sp + 2);
     829|           if (raw.charAt(0) === '[') { var rb = raw.indexOf(']'); if (rb !== -1) raw = raw.slice(rb + 1).replace(/^\\s+/, ''); }
     830|           // check for reasoning models (o1/o3/o4 series and thinking/reasoning keywords)
     831|           if (raw.indexOf('thinking') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('reasoning') !== -1) return true;
     832|           var _rm = raw.replace(/^[a-z0-9]+[/:._-]/, ''); // strip prefix for shortname check
     833|           if (_rm.indexOf('o1') === 0 || _rm.indexOf('o3') === 0 || _rm.indexOf('o4') === 0) return true;
     834|           if (raw.indexOf('/o1') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('/o3') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('/o4') !== -1) return true;
     835|           if (raw.indexOf(':o1') !== -1 || raw.indexOf(':o3') !== -1 || raw.indexOf(':o4') !== -1) return true;
     836|           // strip hf.co/<user>/ prefix and any path prefix for shortname check
     837|           var m = raw;
     838|           if (raw.indexOf('hf.co/') !== -1) { var hfSlash = raw.lastIndexOf('/'); m = hfSlash !== -1 ? raw.slice(hfSlash + 1) : raw; }
     839|           else { var lastSlash = raw.lastIndexOf('/'); if (lastSlash !== -1) m = raw.slice(lastSlash + 1); }
     840|           if (m.indexOf('coder') !== -1 || m.indexOf('-instruct') !== -1 || m.indexOf(':instruct') !== -1) return false;
     841|           return m.indexOf('deepseek-r1') === 0 || m.indexOf('deepseek-r2') === 0 ||
     842|             m.indexOf('qwq') === 0 ||
     843|             (m.indexOf('qwen3') === 0 && m.indexOf('coder') === -1) ||
     844|             m.indexOf(':thinking') !== -1 || m.indexOf('-thinking') !== -1 ||
     845|             m.indexOf('think') !== -1 || m.indexOf('-r1') !== -1 || m.indexOf(':r1') !== -1 ||
     846|             m.indexOf('r1-') !== -1 || /^r1[:.-]/.test(m);
     847|         }
     848|         return check(modelId) || check(label);
     849|       }

    1397|       function switchChatSession(sessionId) {

    1422|         persistSessionState();

    1457| 
    1458|           console.log('[DEBUG] Last session branch triggered. Clearing all.');
    1459|         if (_chatSessions.length <= 1) {
    1460|           // 最後一個 session：全部清除，自動建立新空白 session
    1461|           chat.innerHTML = ''; _streamNode = null; _agentStepNode = null; _pendingBubble = null;

    1471|         _chatSessions = _chatSessions.filter(function(s) { return s.id !== deletedId; });
    1472|         console.log('[DEBUG] Filter complete. New length:', _chatSessions.length, 'Target ID was:', deletedId);

    1476|         resetTransientNodes();
    1477|         chat.innerHTML = (next && next.html) || '';
    1478|         clearFiles();
    1479|         renderChatSessionSelect();
    1480|         vscode.postMessage({ type: 'switchChatSession', sessionId: _activeChatSessionId });

    1762|       function showSlashPopup(filter) {
    1763|         if (!_slashPopup) return;
    1764|         var f = filter.toLowerCase();
    1765|         var matched = _slashCmds.filter(function(c) { return c.cmd.indexOf(f) === 0; });
    1766|         if (!matched.length) { hideSlashPopup(); return; }
    1767|         _slashPopup.innerHTML = matched.map(function(c) {
    1768|           return '<div class="slash-item" data-cmd="' + c.cmd + '">'
    1769|             + '<span>' + c.icon + '</span>'
    1770|             + '<span class="slash-cmd">' + c.cmd + '</span>'
    1771|             + '<span class="slash-desc">' + c.desc + '</span>'
    1772|             + '</div>';
    1773|         }).join('');
    1774|         _slashPopup.querySelectorAll('.slash-item').forEach(function(el) {
    1775|           el.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
    1776|             e.preventDefault();
    1777|             execSlashCommand(el.getAttribute('data-cmd'));
    1778|           });
    1779|         });
    1780|         _slashActive = -1;
    1781|         _slashPopup.style.display = 'block';
    1782|       }
    1783| 
    1784|       function hideSlashPopup() {
    1785|         if (_slashPopup) { _slashPopup.style.display = 'none'; _slashPopup.innerHTML = ''; }
    1786|         _slashActive = -1;
    1787|       }

    1789|       function _slashMoveActive(dir) {
    1790|         var items = _slashItems();
    1791|         if (!items.length) return;
    1792|         items[Math.max(0, _slashActive)]?.classList?.remove('slash-active');
    1793|         _slashActive = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, _slashActive + dir));
    1794|         items[_slashActive].classList.add('slash-active');
    1795|         items[_slashActive].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    1796|       }

    1821|       function tryHandleSlash(text) {

    1843|           }
    1844|         }
    1845|         if (cfgSendKey === 'Ctrl+Enter') {
    1846|           if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.ctrlKey) { e.preventDefault(); doSend(); }
    1847|         } else {
    1848|           if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey) { e.preventDefault(); doSend(); }
    1849|         }

    2060|       // -- Markdown 渲染工具函式 -------------------------------------------
    2061|       function escHtml(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
    2062|       function renderInline(txt) {
    2063|         // 先跳脫 HTML，再套用 inline 語法
    2064|         txt = escHtml(txt);
    2065|         // $$...$$ → 行內數學（保護，避免後面 $...$ 匹配）
    2066|         var PH = '\x02';
    2067|         txt = txt.replace(/\\$\\$([^$\\n]+?)\\$\\$/g, function(_,m){ return '<code class="math-inline">'+m+'</code>'; });
    2068|         // $...$ → 行內數學
    2069|         txt = txt.replace(/\\$([^$\\n]{1,80}?)\\$/g, function(_,m){ return '<code class="math-inline">'+m+'</code>'; });
    2070|         // **bold**
    2071|         txt = txt.replace(/\\*\\*([^*\\n]+?)\\*\\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
    2072|         txt = txt.replace(/__([^_\\n]+?)__/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
    2073|         // *italic*  (skip *** and **)
    2074|         txt = txt.replace(/(?<!\\*)\\*([^*\\n]+?)\\*(?!\\*)/g, '<em>$1</em>');
    2075|         // inline code (backtick)
    2076|         var BTCK = String.fromCharCode(96);
    2077|         var btRe = new RegExp(BTCK + '([^' + BTCK + '\\n]+?)' + BTCK, 'g');
    2078|         txt = txt.replace(btRe, function(_,c){ return '<code>'+c+'</code>'; });
    2079|         return txt;
    2080|       }
    2081|       function renderMdTable(tblLines) {
    2082|         var spl = function(r){ var c=r.split('|'); if(!c[0].trim())c.shift(); if(c.length&&!c[c.length-1].trim())c.pop(); return c; };
    2083|         var h='<table class="md-table"><thead><tr>';
    2084|         spl(tblLines[0]).forEach(function(c){ h+='<th>'+renderInline(c.trim())+'</th>'; });
    2085|         h+='</tr></thead><tbody>';
    2086|         for(var r=2;r<tblLines.length;r++){ if(!tblLines[r].trim())continue; h+='<tr>'; spl(tblLines[r]).forEach(function(c){ h+='<td>'+renderInline(c.trim())+'</td>'; }); h+='</tr>'; }
    2087|         return h+'</tbody></table>';
    2088|       }
    2089|       function renderTextBlock(raw) {
    2090|         var lines=raw.split('\\n'), html='', i=0, mathBuf='', inMath=false;
    2091|         while(i<lines.length){
    2092|           var ln=lines[i];
    2093|           // $$ 區塊
    2094|           if(ln.trim()==='$$'){ if(!inMath){inMath=true;mathBuf='';i++;continue;}else{inMath=false;html+='<code class="math-block">'+escHtml(mathBuf.trim())+'</code>';mathBuf='';i++;continue;} }
    2095|           if(inMath){mathBuf+=ln+'\\n';i++;continue;}
    2096|           // 表格
    2097|           if(ln.includes('|')&&i+1<lines.length&&/^\\|?[\\s:|-]+\\|/.test(lines[i+1])){
    2098|             var tl=[ln],j=i+1; while(j<lines.length&&lines[j].includes('|')){tl.push(lines[j]);j++;}
    2099|             html+=renderMdTable(tl); i=j; continue;
    2100|           }
    2101|           // 任務清單
    2102|           var tm=ln.match(/^(\\s*)-\\s+\\[([ xX])\\]\\s*(.*)/);
    2103|           if(tm){ var ck=tm[2].toLowerCase()==='x'; html+='<div class="task-item"><span style="font-family:monospace;color:'+(ck?'#4ec94e':'rgba(128,128,128,0.55)')+'">'+(ck?'[x]':'[ ]')+'</span> <span style="'+(ck?'text-decoration:line-through;opacity:0.55':'')+'">'+renderInline(tm[3])+'</span></div>'; i++;continue; }
    2104|           // 無序清單
    2105|           var um=ln.match(/^(\\s*)[-*+] (.*)/);
    2106|           if(um){ html+='<div style="padding-left:'+(um[1].length*8+14)+'px;margin:1px 0">&bull; '+renderInline(um[2])+'</div>'; i++;continue; }
    2107|           // 有序清單
    2108|           var om=ln.match(/^(\\s*)(\\d+)\\. (.*)/);
    2109|           if(om){ html+='<div style="padding-left:'+(om[1].length*8+16)+'px;margin:1px 0">'+om[2]+'. '+renderInline(om[3])+'</div>'; i++;continue; }
    2110|           // 標題
    2111|           var hm=ln.match(/^(#{1,4})\\s+(.*)/);
    2112|           if(hm){ var lv=hm[1].length,fs=['1.2em','1.1em','1em','0.95em'][lv-1]; html+='<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:'+fs+';margin:6px 0 2px;'+(lv<=2?'border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.2)':'')+'">'+renderInline(hm[2])+'</div>'; i++;continue; }
    2113|           // 空行
    2114|           if(!ln.trim()){html+='<div style="height:5px"></div>';i++;continue;}
    2115|           // 一般行
    2116|           html+='<div style="line-height:1.55;white-space:pre-wrap">'+renderInline(ln)+'</div>';
    2117|           i++;
    2118|         }
    2119|         if(inMath&&mathBuf) html+='<code class="math-block">'+escHtml(mathBuf.trim())+'</code>';
    2120|         return html;
    2121|       }
    2122|       function rerenderBubbleMd(bubble) {

    2133|       // -- parseBlocks + makeCodeBlock + highlightCode --------------------------
    2134|       function parseBlocks(text) {
    2135|         var TICK = String.fromCharCode(96, 96, 96);
    2136|         var parts = []; var rest = text;
    2137|         while (true) {
    2138|           var s = rest.indexOf(TICK);
    2139|           if (s === -1) { if (rest) parts.push({ t: 'text', v: rest }); break; }
    2140|           if (s > 0) parts.push({ t: 'text', v: rest.slice(0, s) });
    2141|           rest = rest.slice(s + 3);
    2142|           var nl = rest.indexOf('\\n');
    2143|           var lang = nl !== -1 ? rest.slice(0, nl).trim() : '';
    2144|           if (nl !== -1) rest = rest.slice(nl + 1);
    2145|           var e = rest.indexOf(TICK);
    2146|           var code = e !== -1 ? rest.slice(0, e) : rest;
    2147|           parts.push({ t: 'code', lang: lang, v: code });
    2148|           rest = e !== -1 ? rest.slice(e + 3) : '';
    2149|         }
    2150|         return parts.length ? parts : [{ t: 'text', v: text }];
    2151|       }

    2153|       // -- 語法高亮（輕量內嵌 tokenizer，支援 JS/TS/Python/Shell/CSS/JSON）------
    2154|       function highlightCode(code, lang) {
    2155|         var L = (lang || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9#+]/g, '');
    2156|         var isJS  = /^(js|ts|jsx|tsx|javascript|typescript|mjs|cjs|node)$/.test(L);
    2157|         var isPy  = /^(py|python|python3)$/.test(L);
    2158|         var isSh  = /^(sh|bash|shell|zsh|fish|ps|ps1|powershell|cmd|bat)$/.test(L);
    2159|         var isCss = /^(css|scss|less|sass|styl)$/.test(L);
    2160|         var isJson= /^(json|jsonc)$/.test(L);
    2161|         if (!isJS && !isPy && !isSh && !isCss && !isJson) {
    2162|           return code.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
    2163|         }
    2164|         var KW_JS = 'break,case,catch,class,const,continue,debugger,default,delete,do,else,export,extends,finally,for,function,if,import,in,instanceof,let,new,null,of,return,static,super,switch,throw,try,typeof,undefined,var,void,while,yield,async,await,from,as,type,interface,enum,implements,namespace,declare,abstract,readonly,override,public,private,protected,true,false,this,constructor,get,set,keyof,infer,never,any,unknown,string,number,boolean,object,symbol,bigint'.split(',');
    2165|         var KW_PY = 'and,as,assert,async,await,break,class,continue,def,del,elif,else,except,False,finally,for,from,global,if,import,in,is,lambda,None,nonlocal,not,or,pass,raise,return,True,try,while,with,yield,self,cls,print,super,range,len,list,dict,set,tuple,str,int,float,bool,isinstance,hasattr,property,staticmethod,classmethod'.split(',');
    2166|         var KW_SH = 'if,then,else,elif,fi,for,while,do,done,case,esac,in,function,return,export,local,declare,readonly,echo,printf,exit,break,continue,set,unset,read,true,false'.split(',');
    2167|         var kwMap = {}; (isJS||isJson ? KW_JS : isPy ? KW_PY : isSh ? KW_SH : []).forEach(function(k){kwMap[k]=1;});
    2168|         var isPyOrSh = isPy || isSh;
    2169|         var TK = String.fromCharCode(96);
    2170|         var html='', i=0, n=code.length;
    2171|         function esc(s){return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');}
    2172|         function sp(cls,s){return '<span class="'+cls+'">'+esc(s)+'</span>';}
    2173|         while(i<n){
    2174|           var c=code[i];
    2175|           // Python/Shell # comment
    2176|           if(c==='#'&&isPyOrSh){ var e1=code.indexOf('\\n',i); if(e1===-1)e1=n; html+=sp('hl-cmt',code.slice(i,e1)); i=e1; continue; }
    2177|           // // comment
    2178|           if(c==='/'&&code[i+1]==='/'&&!isPy){ var e2=code.indexOf('\\n',i); if(e2===-1)e2=n; html+=sp('hl-cmt',code.slice(i,e2)); i=e2; continue; }
    2179|           // /* ... */
    2180|           if(c==='/'&&code[i+1]==='*'){ var e3=code.indexOf('*/',i+2); var ce=e3!==-1?e3+2:n; html+=sp('hl-cmt',code.slice(i,ce)); i=ce; continue; }
    2181|           // Python triple-quote
    2182|           if(isPy&&(code.slice(i,i+3)==='"""'||code.slice(i,i+3)==="'''")){var q3=code.slice(i,i+3),e4=code.indexOf(q3,i+3);var se=e4!==-1?e4+3:n;html+=sp('hl-str',code.slice(i,se));i=se;continue;}
    2183|           // string " or '
    2184|           if(c==='"'||c==="'"){var q=c,ss=q,si=i+1;while(si<n){var sc=code[si];if(sc==='\\\\'){ss+=sc+(code[si+1]||'');si+=2;continue;}ss+=sc;si++;if(sc===q)break;}html+=sp('hl-str',ss);i=si;continue;}
    2185|           // template literal (backtick)
    2186|           if(c===TK&&isJS){var ss2=TK,si2=i+1;while(si2<n){var sc2=code[si2];if(sc2==='\\\\'){ss2+=sc2+(code[si2+1]||'');si2+=2;continue;}ss2+=sc2;si2++;if(sc2===TK)break;}html+=sp('hl-str',ss2);i=si2;continue;}
    2187|           // number
    2188|           if(c>='0'&&c<='9'){var ns='',ni=i;while(ni<n&&/[0-9._xXa-fA-FbBoOpP]/.test(code[ni])){ns+=code[ni];ni++;}html+=sp('hl-num',ns);i=ni;continue;}
    2189|           // identifier → keyword / Type / function()
    2190|           if(/[a-zA-Z_$]/.test(c)){var id='',ii=i;while(ii<n&&/[\\w$]/.test(code[ii])){id+=code[ii];ii++;}
    2191|             if(kwMap[id]){html+=sp('hl-kw',id);}
    2192|             else if(/^[A-Z]/.test(id)&&id.length>1&&!/^[A-Z_]+$/.test(id)){html+=sp('hl-type',id);}
    2193|             else{var ni2=ii;while(ni2<n&&(code[ni2]===' '||code[ni2]==='\\t'))ni2++;html+=(code[ni2]==='('?sp('hl-fn',id):id);}
    2194|             i=ii;continue;}
    2195|           if(c==='<'){html+='&lt;';i++;continue;}
    2196|           if(c==='>'){html+='&gt;';i++;continue;}
    2197|           if(c==='&'){html+='&amp;';i++;continue;}
    2198|           html+=c;i++;
    2199|         }
    2200|         return html;
    2201|       }

    2531|       function finalizeCompactBar(bar, msg) {

    3251|       function updateModelSelect(models, current) {
    3252|         if (!modelSelect) return;
    3253|         // 優先保留使用者目前在 UI 已選的值，避免 fetchModels race condition 覆蓋選擇
    3254|         var prevUiValue = modelSelect.value;
    3255|         modelSelect.innerHTML = '';
    3256|         var hasAny = false;
    3257|         var providerGroups = {};
    3258|         var providerOrder = [];
    3259|         var allIds = [];
    3260|         (models || []).forEach(function(model) {
    3261|           var provider = model.provider || inferProviderFromModelId(model.id);
    3262|           var groupKey = model.providerLabel || getProviderAppearance(provider).label;
    3263|           if (!providerGroups[groupKey]) { providerGroups[groupKey] = []; providerOrder.push(groupKey); }
    3264|           providerGroups[groupKey].push(model);
    3265|           allIds.push(model.id);
    3266|         });
    3267|         // 決定目標選擇：UI 原選擇 → msg.current → 第一個
    3268|         var targetValue = (prevUiValue && allIds.indexOf(prevUiValue) !== -1) ? prevUiValue : current;
    3269|         providerOrder.forEach(function(groupKey) {
    3270|           var grp = document.createElement('optgroup');
    3271|           grp.label = groupKey;
    3272|           providerGroups[groupKey].forEach(function(model) {
    3273|             var opt = document.createElement('option');
    3274|             opt.value = model.id;
    3275|             var thinkMark = modelSupportsThinking(model.id, model.label) ? ' \uD83D\uDCAD' : '';
    3276|             opt.textContent = model.label + thinkMark + (model.multiplier ? '  ' + model.multiplier : '');
    3277|             opt.dataset.provider = model.provider || inferProviderFromModelId(model.id);
    3278|             opt.dataset.providerLabel = model.providerLabel || getProviderAppearance(opt.dataset.provider).label;
    3279|             if (model.multiplier) opt.dataset.multiplier = model.multiplier;
    3280|             if (thinkMark) opt.dataset.thinking = '1';
    3281|             if (model.id === targetValue || model.label === targetValue) opt.selected = true;
    3282|             grp.appendChild(opt);
    3283|             hasAny = true;
    3284|           });
    3285|           modelSelect.appendChild(grp);
    3286|         });
    3287|         if (!modelSelect.value && hasAny) { var firstOpt = modelSelect.querySelector('option'); if (firstOpt) modelSelect.value = firstOpt.value; }
    3288|         // 同步影子督促模型選單（保留目前選擇）
    3289|         var shadowModelSelect = document.getElementById('shadowModelSelect');
    3290|         if (shadowModelSelect) {
    3291|           var prevShadow = shadowModelSelect.value;
    3292|           shadowModelSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">\uD83D\uDD75\uFE0F \u540c\u4e3b\u4eba\u683c</option>';
    3293|           providerOrder.forEach(function(groupKey) {
    3294|             var sGrp = document.createElement('optgroup'); sGrp.label = groupKey;
    3295|             providerGroups[groupKey].forEach(function(model) {
    3296|               var sOpt = document.createElement('option'); sOpt.value = model.id;
    3297|               sOpt.textContent = model.label + (model.multiplier ? '  ' + model.multiplier : '');
    3298|               if (model.id === prevShadow) sOpt.selected = true;
    3299|               sGrp.appendChild(sOpt);
    3300|             });
    3301|             shadowModelSelect.appendChild(sGrp);
    3302|           });
    3303|           if (prevShadow && shadowModelSelect.value !== prevShadow) shadowModelSelect.value = '';
    3304|         }
    3305|         // 更新倍數標籤
    3306|         (function() {
    3307|           var selOpt = modelSelect.options[modelSelect.selectedIndex];
    3308|           var multEl = document.getElementById('modelMultiplier');
    3309|           if (multEl) multEl.textContent = selOpt && selOpt.dataset.multiplier ? selOpt.dataset.multiplier : '';
    3310|           applyProviderInfo({
    3311|             id: selOpt && selOpt.dataset.provider ? selOpt.dataset.provider : inferProviderFromModelId(modelSelect.value),
    3312|             label: selOpt && selOpt.dataset.providerLabel ? selOpt.dataset.providerLabel : '',
    3313|             modelId: modelSelect.value,
    3314|             displayName: selOpt ? selOpt.textContent : modelSelect.value
    3315|           });
    3316|         })();
    3317|         // 只有當選擇被迫 fallback（原 UI 選擇不在新清單中）才寫回設定，避免 race condition 覆蓋使用者選擇
    3318|         if (modelSelect.value && modelSelect.value !== prevUiValue) { vscode.postMessage({ type: 'saveModel', model: modelSelect.value }); }
    3319|       }

    3394|       function renderLatencyChart(log) {
    3395|         _latencyLog = log || [];
    3396|         var wrap = document.getElementById('statsLatencyWrap');
    3397|         if (!wrap) return;
    3398|         if (!_latencyLog.length) { wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;opacity:0.55;margin:2px 0">\u5c1a\u7121\u8cc7\u6599</p>'; return; }
    3399|         // Aggregate by model: avg + min + max
    3400|         var byModel = {};
    3401|         _latencyLog.forEach(function(e) {
    3402|           if (!byModel[e.model]) byModel[e.model] = { sum:0, count:0, min:Infinity, max:0 };
    3403|           var m = byModel[e.model];
    3404|           m.sum += e.ms; m.count++; m.min = Math.min(m.min,e.ms); m.max = Math.max(m.max,e.ms);
    3405|         });
    3406|         var maxAvg = 0;
    3407|         Object.keys(byModel).forEach(function(k) { var avg = byModel[k].sum/byModel[k].count; if(avg>maxAvg) maxAvg=avg; });
    3408|         var html = '';
    3409|         Object.keys(byModel).sort(function(a,b){ return byModel[a].sum/byModel[a].count - byModel[b].sum/byModel[b].count; }).forEach(function(k) {
    3410|           var m = byModel[k]; var avg = Math.round(m.sum/m.count); var pct = maxAvg > 0 ? Math.round(avg/maxAvg*100) : 0;
    3411|           var color = avg < 3000 ? '#89d185' : avg < 10000 ? '#f7cc65' : '#f87070';
    3412|           html += '<div class="latency-bar-row"><div class="latency-bar-label" title="' + k + '">' + k + '</div>' +
    3413|             '<div class="latency-bar-track"><div class="latency-bar-fill" style="width:' + pct + '%;background:' + color + '"></div></div>' +
    3414|             '<div class="latency-bar-val">' + (avg >= 1000 ? (avg/1000).toFixed(1)+'s' : avg+'ms') + '</div>' +
    3415|             '<div style="font-size:10px;opacity:0.5;flex-shrink:0">\xd7' + m.count + '</div>' +
    3416|             '</div>';
    3417|         });
    3418|         // Recent 20 requests timeline
    3419|         var recent = _latencyLog.slice(-20);
    3420|         html += '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:10px;opacity:0.6">\u6700\u8fd1 ' + recent.length + ' \u7b46\uff1a</div>';
    3421|         html += '<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:flex-end;height:32px;margin-top:2px">';
    3422|         var rMax = 0; recent.forEach(function(e){ if(e.ms>rMax) rMax=e.ms; });
    3423|         recent.forEach(function(e) {
    3424|           var h = rMax > 0 ? Math.max(2, Math.round(e.ms/rMax*32)) : 2;
    3425|           var c = e.ms < 3000 ? '#89d185' : e.ms < 10000 ? '#f7cc65' : '#f87070';
    3426|           html += '<div title="' + e.model + ' ' + (e.ms >= 1000 ? (e.ms/1000).toFixed(1)+'s' : e.ms+'ms') + '" style="flex:1;height:' + h + 'px;background:' + c + ';border-radius:1px;min-width:2px;cursor:default"></div>';
    3427|         });
    3428|         html += '</div>';
    3429|         wrap.innerHTML = html;
    3430|       }

    3658|       function parseLtmToEntries(text) {
    3659|         var lines = (text || '').split('\\n'), entries = [];
    3660|         for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    3661|           var line = lines[i].trim(); if (!line) continue;
    3662|           var m = line.match(/^#(\S+)\s+([\s\S]*)$/);
    3663|           if (m) { entries.push({ tag: m[1], text: m[2] }); }
    3664|           else { entries.push({ tag: '', text: line }); }
    3665|         }
    3666|         return entries;
    3667|       }
    3668|       function entriesToLtm(entries) {
    3669|         return entries.map(function(e) { return e.tag ? '#' + e.tag + ' ' + e.text : e.text; }).join('\\n');
    3670|       }

    3768|       // ── Permission dialog ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    3769|       var _currentPermCategory = '';
    3770|       function buildUnifiedDiff(before, after) {
    3771|         var NO_BEFORE = !before && after;
    3772|         var bLines = NO_BEFORE ? [] : (before || '').split('\\n');
    3773|         var aLines = (after  || '').split('\\n');
    3774|         var result = [];
    3775|         var LIMIT = 300;
    3776|         var bi = 0, ai = 0;
    3777|         while (bi < bLines.length || ai < aLines.length) {
    3778|           if (result.length >= LIMIT) { result.push({ t: '~', s: '... (' + (bLines.length + aLines.length - bi - ai) + ' more lines)' }); break; }
    3779|           var bl = bi < bLines.length ? bLines[bi] : null;
    3780|           var al = ai < aLines.length ? aLines[ai] : null;
    3781|           if (bl === null) { result.push({ t: '+', s: al }); ai++; }
    3782|           else if (al === null) { result.push({ t: '-', s: bl }); bi++; }
    3783|           else if (bl === al) { result.push({ t: ' ', s: bl }); bi++; ai++; }
    3784|           else { result.push({ t: '-', s: bl }); result.push({ t: '+', s: al }); bi++; ai++; }
    3785|         }
    3786|         // Trim context: only keep lines near changes (+/-)
    3787|         var CTX = 3;
    3788|         var keep = {};
    3789|         for (var ri = 0; ri < result.length; ri++) {
    3790|           if (result[ri].t !== ' ') {
    3791|             for (var d = -CTX; d <= CTX; d++) { if (ri + d >= 0 && ri + d < result.length) keep[ri + d] = true; }
    3792|           }
    3793|         }
    3794|         var trimmed = [], lastKept = -1;
    3795|         for (var ri = 0; ri < result.length; ri++) {
    3796|           if (keep[ri]) {
    3797|             if (lastKept >= 0 && ri > lastKept + 1) trimmed.push({ t: '~', s: '' });
    3798|             trimmed.push(result[ri]);
    3799|             lastKept = ri;
    3800|           }
    3801|         }
    3802|         return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : [{ t: ' ', s: '(no changes)' }];
    3803|       }

    3805|       function showDiffPanel(diff) {
    3806|         var panel = document.getElementById('permDiffPanel');
    3807|         if (!panel) return;
    3808|         if (!diff) { panel.classList.remove('has-diff'); return; }
    3809|         panel.classList.add('has-diff');
    3810|         var before = diff.before || '';
    3811|         var after  = diff.after  || '';
    3812|         // Unified pane
    3813|         var unifiedPre = document.querySelector('#diffPaneUnified pre');
    3814|         if (unifiedPre) {
    3815|           unifiedPre.innerHTML = '';
    3816|           var lines = buildUnifiedDiff(before, after);
    3817|           for (var li = 0; li < lines.length; li++) {
    3818|             var item = lines[li];
    3819|             var span = document.createElement('span');
    3820|             var prefix = item.t === '+' ? '+  ' : item.t === '-' ? '-  ' : item.t === '~' ? '   ' : '   ';
    3821|             span.className = item.t === '+' ? 'diff-line-add' : item.t === '-' ? 'diff-line-del' : 'diff-line-ctx';
    3822|             span.textContent = prefix + (item.s || '') + '\\n';
    3823|             unifiedPre.appendChild(span);
    3824|           }
    3825|         }
    3826|         // Before pane
    3827|         var beforePre = document.querySelector('#diffPaneBefore pre');
    3828|         if (beforePre) { beforePre.textContent = before || '(new file)'; }
    3829|         // After pane
    3830|         var afterPre = document.querySelector('#diffPaneAfter pre');
    3831|         if (afterPre) { afterPre.textContent = after; }
    3832|       }
